po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng ①du chade nyid yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dkar po bsams la/ de las 'od zer byung nas gtsang ma'i gnas zhes bya ba nas/ sku'i rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyi cha lugs 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ de rnams kyis bza' ba la sogs pasnyebyen gyis rlob cing mi gtsang ba'i skyon gyi dri ma bsal ①te/byang chub kyi sems kyinyubadud 'i rang bzhin du mdzad ⑤par bsam mo/ yi ge lhags spel bar bya'o zhes pa ni/ lag pa g.yas pa nyi ma'i cha yin pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du āḥ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng du 'dzode nyid yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bsams la/ de las 'od zer byung bas sngon bzhin du gtsang ma'i gnas nas gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med ⑧kyi cha lugs 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ de rnams kyis bza' ba la sogs pa rnams mang bar byin gyis rlob par mdzad cing / bdud rtsi chags pa'i ro dang ldan par rtogs shing khong du chud par mdzad par bsam mo/ /yi ge hūṃ gis sbar bar bya'o zhes pa ni thal mo gnyis kha zab/ pa sgra gcan gyi cha yin pas/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du hūṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra gcan gyi ⑨'khor dang / de'i steng du hūṃ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa bsams la/ de lasa'od zer byung bas/ yang gtsang ma'i gnas nas thugs kyi rdo rje mi bskyong pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ de rnams kyis kyang bza' ba la sogs pa rnams 'bar zhing gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlob par bsam mo/ /yege hos bdud rtsir bya'o zhes pa ni/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya rdo rje sems 7—961

dpa'i rang bzhin yin pas/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya la ho ljang gu yongs su gyur pa las/ kha dog thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor rlum po ①dang / de'i steng du ho de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsams ka de las 'od byung bas yang gtsang ma'i gnas nas sdeye shes kyi dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la/ de rnams kyis yang bza' ba la sogs pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlob par mdzad par bsam mo/ /yi ge haṃ gis spyan drang bar bya'o zhes pa ni/ mthe'u chung gnyis mdud par byas pa 'gugs pa'i cha yin pas 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya la/haṃ bsam zhing de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/yi gehaṃ ngam hūṃ ①yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa las/ 'od zer byung bas mgron gang yin pa spyan drang bar bsam mo/ /yi ge k+ṣas gshegs su gsol lo zhes bya ba ni/ k+ṣa ni zad cing mthar gtugs pa zhes bya ba'i don yin pas| lag pa g.yon rmi rgyab kyis gshegs su gsol ba'i brda zhes bya ba'i don to| /de bas na g.yon gyis sbyang bar bya zhes bya ba nas/ lag pa g.yon rmis ni gshegs su gsol lo zhes bya ba yan chad kyi don yin no/ /chang la zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i gzugs su bsgoms la zhes pa la chang gis ④mtshon pa tsam yin dze+e gang dang gang bza' ⑤zhing 'thung ba de dang de'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsir bsam zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas lag pa g.yon gyi ming med kyisasum̐zhes bya ba nikhya g.yon gyi srin lag gis so/ /chang gi thigs pa blangs la zhes bya ba ni mtshon pa tsam mo/ /gang dang gang za zhing 'thung ba de shes rab stong pa nyid mtshon par byed pa'i gru gsum pa yid kyis bsams la ⑧mngon du bya'o zhes bya'o/ /de'i 7—962

dbus su thig le'i gzugs rlum po bya'o zhes pa ni mtshon par byed pa yin te/ de ltar bstan pa'i rim pas dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'chang rnams stong pa dang snying rje dbyer mi byed pa la bzhugs pa ston pa yin la/ de yang phyi dang nang dang gzhan kun las grub ①par gnas so zhes bya ba yang yin no/ /me long gi gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs par dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsams la zhes bya ba ni| gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gzung 'dzin dang bral zhing rnam par rtog pa'i dre masnyematha' dag spangs pa'i rang bzhin du bsam zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de yang edang ③waṃgyi dbus na bzhugs par bsamasasnyel ngo bo nyid kyisasnye'akhor ba'i dri ma dang bral zhing dben pas na logazhes smos so/ /tshim par bya ba ni zhes pa ni rnal 'byor pa bdag gis ⑦rtogs pas rdo rje 'chang de rnams tshim zhing dgyes pa lta bur bsam par bya'o/ /tshim byed kyi⑧sngags rnams bstan pa⑨/ oṃ.āḥhūṃ ⑩ho/ zhes bya ba yin la/ de nyid sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rdo rje'i rig sngags yin pas/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi lha rnams la mchod pa'i sngagasakyi tshigan de rnams kyis so/ /de nas de'i rjes la alga wīdze+e ṛ dzā/ u spru/ lo 4 zhes pa'i sngags rnams nam mkha' dang sanyam pa'i bar brjod par —bya ba'i phyir⑪/ rlung dang me dang / chu dang sa yis yongs su bsdus pa'i chos can te/ rnam par shes pa nam mkha'i khams kyi rigs zhes bya ba la sogs pa/phung po lnga'i chos can dang / nam mkha'i khams la sogs pa'i khams lnga ste/ de rnams la mchod par bya ba'i sngags kyi tshig rnams yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gzhan yang / chada.ā cu mju/ ar ston/ yongarmu mal lha / sa ā / zhes pa'i 'phel ba'i yi ge rnams kyis mig la sogs pa'i dbang po drug 7—963

dang —/ gzugs la sogs pa'i yul drug gle thabs dang shes rab kyi dngos po rnams mchod par byed pa'i sngags kyi tshig rnamasayin no zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang /ha hā/ ya yā/ ra rā/ dzowā la spa zhes pa rnams yang nana'i rkyen bsgyur ①ba'i yi ge rnams kyis ②thabs dang shes rab kyi rigs can bye skusnyekhro bo khro mo bcu'o/ /zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs pa'i rang bzhin las kyi dbang po dang las kyi dbang po'i bya bar gyur pa rnams mchod pa'i sngags so/ /bshan yangasnye/ kakā / kha khā/ ga gra gha ghā/ nga ngu/ tsa tsā/ tsha tsā/ dza 4 dzha tsā/nya hā/ ṭa ṭā/ ṭha ṣ+ṭha/ ḍa7/ rte / ṇa ṇ+ḍa/ ta tā/ tha thā/ da dā/dha jo/ na nā/ pa pā/ pha rdza/ ba bā/ bha bhā/ ma māsde/ sa ga ha hārjo—/ ṣa ṣā/ sha shā/ rka ṭ+wā/ ha hā/ la lhag/ ra rā/ 'a 'ang/ la lā—/ k+ṣa k+ṣu/ zhes bya ba rnams ni rdo rje kazhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rgyud ston par byed pa'i rjod byed kyi sngags kyi tshig sum cu rtsa drug ste/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rigs sum cu rtsa drug ces bya ba/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du gtogs ⑧pa thams cad kyi lha'i rigasashemachod par byed pa'i sngags tshig gi stoga'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de yang gsal byed gcig dang ldan pa ni thabs mtshon par byed pa'o/ /gong du gsal byed nyid ⑩dang ldan par byed pa ni shes rab mtshon par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du thung ngu thams cad ni thabs yin lnga ring po thams cad ni shes rab yin no/ /de bzhin du phywali ni thabs tā li ni shes rab/thig le ni thabs/ tsheg drag ni shes rab/ ces rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las gsungs pa yin la/ gzhan du yang ci rigasad+kupar sbyar ro/ /rkang gnyis gtso bos dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen gsungs/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon gyis kyang 7—964

—༄ / /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag bzhi pa zhes — bya bas༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭīkā la tsakra tsa tu ra i⑧ga sā dha no pi kā tsā ma/bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs yan lag bzhi pa zhes bya ba—/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag ①'tshal lo/ /mchog gi snying rje dag gis ni/ /'khor ba mi bzad sdug bsngal las/ /gdon phyir yeshes lam la ni/ /ston pa khyod ni nyid kyis bzhugs / /khyod ni rgan yang gzhon nu ma/ /rgyal ba mtha' dag gi ni sras—/ /dang po sangs rgyas kyi dang po/ /bud med sbyor la tshangs par spyod/ /mchog gi snying rje dag gis ni/ /'jig rten gnyen ni gshin rje'i dgra/ /khyod ni kho na'i rdo rje nyid/ /srid pa yis ni 'jigs sel ba/ /khyod ni rtag tu bdud kyi bdud/ /srid pa las ni rnam grol khyod/ /'gro ba smin pa'i don du ni/ /'jug pa yi ni gshin rje khyod/ /thub ⑤pa yis ni rigs 'dud pa/ /bram ze'i 7—976

rigs kyi nyi ma bdag /zhabs kyi pad+ma la⑥btud pa/ /sems can rnams ni groladon du/ /dus kyi 'khor lo mtha' dag ni/ /sa yi steng du gsal byed pa/ /snyigs ma can gyi rigs ni khyod/ /sa yi bdag pos phyag byas pa/ /ka khā pa ru dpal grags pa/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma ka /lag pa'i thal mo sbyar nas su/ /yan lag mchogal bzhagatsonas ga /spyi bo yis ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /mtha' dag ma tshang med pa ka /sgrub pa'i thabs ni bshad par bya/ /byed mos tshal dang ri bragasasnyidang / /rgyal ba dam pa wani gnas/ /khang stong lha shiganas dang ni/ /grub pa'i gnasadang dur khrod dang / /mtsho yi gnas dang gab pa'i sa/ /gang du yid ni dga' bar3/ /de ru bsgrub pa bya ba ru/ /'gyur ro mi yi bdag po sge /zab cing rgya tsheb shisems/ /glama'i nges pa la dga' zhing / /gtong ba'i sems dang yon tan shes/ /thar pa 'dod cing rgyud la dad/ /sems ni g.yo ba med pa dngaka /de nyid rnyed pa dang gsang zhing / /gdug pa rnams kyi tshogasabral ba/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur rim pa bzhin thob gang / /'jam pa nyid kyisanyumal cha 'am/ /stan bde ba la 'dugasnyipar bya/ /maṇ+ḍal skyang nul mdzes byas nag /rdzas bcur ldan pa'i mchod pa bshags / /phyag rgya bzang po'i rjes bye ba'i/ /dag pa rnam gsum dran par bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sa phyogs su/ /dang po kho nar chos skyong ba⑦| /gtor ma dag ni sbyin par bya/ /phyi nas rdo rje bzhi yis ni/ /phyogs dang mtshams sasong ba ni/ /bdud kyi tshogs rnams nges par bsreg /dpal gyi rdo rje'i sa phyogs na/ /gnas pa yilgeni bdud kyi tshogs/ /ma lus par ni nges par bsreg /phyi nas 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la/ /phyogs dang mtshalas su 7—977

song ba yi/ /khro bo'i tshogs ni bsgom par bya/ /sa yi mtshalas gyi mthar thug par—/ /ring po ru ni mthong gi bar/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ra ba gsum/ /sa yi 'khor ①bar song ba ni/ /sa 'og gnas dang nam mkhar ro/ /rdo rje khang par brtsegs par ni/ /dbus su 'dab ②skyes nyi ma'i khru/ /lte ba dang ni gdan la ni—/ /dus dang lag pa'i khrur gyur pa/ /de yi steng du bdag nyid ni/ /dri ma dang ni bral ba nyid/ /'khor lo'i dbus su khro ①dbang po/ /phyag di rgyal ba gnyis lhag pa/ /dus kyi zhal te rdo rje shugs/ /rnal 'byor ma ④yis bsgom par bya'o—/ /dang po snying ga'i zla dbus su/ /phyogs bcu ru ni sna tshogs la/ /de kho na yi 'od zer bsgom/ /kha la sogs pa dag byas te/ /slar la yang ni nam mkha' ru/ /'od zer spros pas rgyal ba dgugs /mchod pa sna tshogs byas nas dusu—/ /srid pa'i sdig pa mang po ni/ /bsags pa de ni bshags par bya/ /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /lus dang ngag dag ⑦sems dag pas/ /sgrub pa po yis bya ba yin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub semag /'phags pa'i dge 'dun gang mdzad pa'i/ /dge brnam pa dze+emang po dze+e /ma lus de la rjes yi rang / /nyon mongs— pa dang bral ba yi/ /byang chub spyod pa rjese su gnas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /srid pa yi ni 'jigs sel ba/ /byang chub thar par ⑨skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam 'debs pa dze+e /'di ni sems can don gyi phyir/ /'gro ba ma lus 'di dag ni/ /dngos po'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin no/ /dngos dang bral ba stong pa'o—/ /de phyir sangs rgyas byang chub med/ /ga na la phan pa'i snying —yi / /mtshan ma med par dam bcas pa'i/ /de ltar mtha' dag shes byas te/ /sku 7—978

gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /dpag tu med pa'i yon tan ldan/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor gtso/ /dang por 'di ni sdom brtson gyis/ /chu yis me ni 'jig7pa ni/ /lus kyi dbus su bya ba yin/ /phyis ni sa ni chu ru 'gyur/ /tshwa bzhin chu yi dbus su zhugs/ /rlung gis chu ni masas nas su/ /nam mkha' ru ni mi snang bar/ /myur du 'gro'o de nas ni/ /sems dang me ni mun pa'i mthar/ /yul dang rnam par bral ba ni/ /dbus kyi sa ru ga gasnyepar bya/ /stong pa rlung dang me dang chu/ /sa dang rgya mtsho ri pad+ma/ /zla ba nyi ma dang ni me/ /khang pa brtsegs ma kun nas ni/ /dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dzi /rdo rje las ni skyes pa'i gur②/ /de nang ④rdo rje'i sa gzhi la/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i 'od lta bu/ /dkyil 'khor la ni rnam 'phro ba/ /oṃgyi ye shes las skyes pa/ /rgyal ba dam pa'i pad+ma la/ /zla ba nyi ma dag gi gdan/ /nang du brgyad gnyis ka ba ni/ /rigs gtso yi sdeni rang bzhin te/ /rgyal ba'i longs spyod 'khor lo ni/ /rgyal po rig byed sgomakyirnams la/ /nor bu gser gyikhurang bzhin gi /rta babs dur khrod rnams kyis ⑧brgyan/ /asogs ka sogs nyi ma zla/ /rigs kyi gtso dang lhan cig pa/ /me long lta bu la sogs pa'ang / /dri ma med pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ /'od zer lnga ni 'byedashemadzad pa/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i rgyan ⑩dang ldan pa'i lus/ /rgyal ba yi ni phyag pad+ma/ /nyi ma'i dpung pa dus kyi zhal/ /mgrin gsum nyi ma yi ⑩ni spyan/ /zhal gdangs mche ba shacigs pa yi / /dpal ldan oṃlas skyes pa'o/ /nor gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /zla ba nyi ma me yi stengasnye/ /drag po 'dod lha gnyis kyi byani//snying gar shin tu rol ba'i zhabag /rgyal ba'i dbang po g.yas brkyang zhabs/ /7—979

phreng rim pa bzhin du'o/ /gamon na nya phyis zhags pa dang / /'dab ma brgyaspapa'i pad+ma dngaka /nor bu bzang po de bzhin te/ /g.yon brkyang ba la nyi ma'i spyan/ /rgyal ba'i bdag po'i cod pan can/ /phyag rgya rnams kyis rgyas btab bo| /phyogs kyi pad+mar sangs rgyas bzhi/ /nges pa kho nar spyan ni dgu/ /de yisaspyan dang dus kyi phyag /mtshams su sgrog ma sogs lha mo/ /ga na yang slar yang 'di dag gi /mtshams brgyad du ni bum pa brgyad/ /nag po dmar po ser po dang / /ri bong 'dzin pa dan po ni/ /lha dang lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /nag po dmar po zla ba ni/ /ga na yang phyogs bral du song ba/ /dmar po ser po nyi ma'i ste| /rtsig⑧pa'i phyogs mtshams song ba la/ /nam mkha' snying po la sogs dang / /reg bya'i rdo rje ma la sogag /shar gyi g.yas dang g.yon pa dang / /phyogs gzhan gyi ni pad+ma las/ /kun du bzang po de bzhin du/ /dpalaldan phyag na rdo rje dang / /sgra yerdo rje nyid dang ni/ /chosakyi dbyings ni rim pa bzhin/ /lkugs dang rengs dang nga rgyal can/ /rab stobs zhes pa 'di dag —/ /sgo skyong shar la sogs par ro| /ri bong 'dzin pa'i pad+ma ka /shes rab dang ni thabs byung ba/ /lha rnamasadang ni lha mo rnamag /phan tshun du ni dag pa gnyis/ /rang gi lag pa chu skyes ni/ /rang rang mtshan ma rnams dang ldan/ /gang gi g.yas su mtshan ma gang / /dang po yeni lagapa ka /de phyirasnyephyag rgya dang bral ba'o/ /shes rab thabs kyi 'khor lo yig /mchog tu bde ba 4ni gnas/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i gdan la sogag /nag po rnams kyisasteral gri gug /gnas rnams 'jigs par byed pa dang / /g.yas kyi lag na rtse gsum mo/ /g.yon na phub dang thod pa dang/ /kha ṭī ga ni dkar po ni/ /lag pa'i mthil na yod gyur te/ /dmar po rnams kyi de bzhin 7—981

du/ /mda' dang rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /sgra dang bcas pa'i cang te'u/ /g.yas kyi phyag na rim pa bzhin/ /g.yon ni gzhu dang zhags pa dang / /nor bu dri ma med 'phro ba/ /ser po rnams kyidzo'akhor lo dbyug /'jigs par byed pa'i rdo rje ni/ /g.yas kyi lag par rim pa bzhin/ /g.yon na snedapal ldan lu gu rgyud/ /dril bu'i sgra dang bcas par 'gyur/ /ri bong 'dzin pa dkar rnams kyi/ /g.yas na dpal gyi tho ba dang / /mdung ③dang rtse gsum pa ni nyid/ /g.yon na pad+ma dkar po nyid/ /'dab ma brgyad dang bcas pa dang / /me long dang ni bgrang phreng ngo / /ljang gu rnams kyi g.yas pa la/ /rdo rje gri gug dgra sta ni—/ /rim pa bzhin du 'gyur ba yin/ /g.yon na dril bu thod pa dang / /yon tan mtha' dag gi ④ni gter/ /ut+pa la ni de bzhin nyid/ /so so'i yon tan dbang gis na/ /sngon po rnams kyisasnyerig par bya/ /lha mo rnams ni de bzhin du—/ /nag po dmar po dkar po dang / /gser ni zhun ma 'dra ba dang / /shar gyi lha sogs lha mo'o/ /de ltar rdo rje can gyi yang / /srid pa gsum ni ma lus pa//dkyil 'khor gyi ༷ni rnam par gsungs/ /phyi dang lus dang ga na la ni/ /spros pa'i rang bzhin med pa ni/ /dngos po'i skyeb yang dag gnas/ /de la rtag par mkha' rdo rje/ /srid pa rnam pa gsum song ba/ /mi rtag par ni 'gro ba'o/ /'byung po'i tshogs ni rtag pa min/ /mig 'phrul dag ni ji bzhin no/ /rtag dang mi rtag par blta ba/ /de yang bems po'i blo can gri /sems dag pa yi don gyi phyir—/ /sgrub thabs nyid ni brjod par bya'o/ /khashelas snying du song ba dzi /bsgrub par nus pa nyid ma yin/ /rdo rje can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ /sgrub pos bsgrub par bya ba gang / /ma lus pa ni 'khrul ba'o/ /de phyir rgyal po rang gi 7—982

sems/ /nyon mongs pa dang bral ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /ho yig thog ma thara'i dbus / /yang dag bde ba'i 'bras ster ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /shes rab chags pas de zhu ba/ /ri bong can nyid lta bu ru/ /rdo rje can yang zhu mthong nag /lha mo rnams ni gru len byed/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rdo rje can/ /sum cu pa dang mi'i bla ma/ /sems can kun la bde mdzad pa/ /khyod kyis 'dod pa'i don gnyer ba/ /bdag cag rnams ni bsrung bar mdzad②/ /gru de⑧rdo rje can son nas/ /srid pa gsum ni ma lus pa④/ /mig 'phrul lta bu nyid du ni/ /gzigs nas babyed pa ru mdzad de/ /'od zer dri ma med pa 'phro/ /mtshan ma bcas pa spro bar mdzad⑤/ /rdo rje can ni rgyan dang ldan/ /rgyal ba'i bdagakyipo'i cod pan can/ /shes rab kyis ⑦ni 'ag pa nyid| /rgyal po shes rab thabs kyis te/ /sbar la yang ni dkyil 'khor ba/ /ma lus pa rnams 'byung bar bya/ /sngon po'i 'od 'phro 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rab tu bzhad pa yeni zhal/ /zla ba phyed pa'i mtshegatsigs pa/ /sgra ni sgogs pa me yinaspyan/ /gnyis lhag pa yi rgyal ba'i phyag /rig byed rgyal ⑧la zhabs gnyis pa| /shes rab thabs kyi yan lag can/ /mtshon cha rnams kyis yang dag mtshan/ /rdo rje shugs kyisad+kugazhug par bya/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta nas/ /rgyal ba'i dgra ni 'jigs byed de/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i rgyu ru'o/ /mdun du ye shes de mthong nag /rnam pa bcu yi mchod pa dang / /sngags rnams kun dang bstod pabyubya/ /lte bar lcags kyu yis btab nas/ /dri med pa yi 'od 'phro ba| /ye shes 'khor lo'i ⑪dbang phyug nyid/ /rigs gtso zhes pa'i gdong can gyi / /zhags pa de nyid rab tu bcing / /mtshon cha rnams kyis 'jigs byas 7—983

—te| /ma lus pa ni bsgrubs byas nas/ /slar la yang ni log nas ni/ /rang gi 'khor lo bskor byas te/ /gzhug dang bcing dang dgyes pa dang / /ro dag mnyam par byed pa ni/ /'gugs byed la sogs pa yis go /sems nyid rnal 'byor bskyed pa ni/ /nang gi pad+ma'i nyi stengs su/ /nam mkha' dang ni bcas pa'o—/ /shar du 'du byed dang ni ga /lho ru tshor ba dang ni sa /byang du 'du shes me ru 'gyur/ /nub tu gzugs ni gzhan nyid do/ /me ru rlung dang gzugs su 'gyur/ /bden bral me dang 'du shes gnyig /dbang ldan chu dang tshor ba gnyig /rlung du sa dang 'du byedaspaldan/ /sangs rgyas lha mo'i bar stong la/ /mtshan gyi phyogs su bdud rtsi'o/ /ro yis dze+ebanang ba'i bum pa brgyad/ /yang ni rim pa gzhan ma yin/ /steng du sna dang drir 'gyur te/ /lho ru mig dang gzugs dgod do/ /g.yon du lce dang ror 'gyur zhing / /nub tu lus dang reg bya ni/ /de bzhin du ni 'gyur ba yin/ /lho yi sgo yi g.yon du gle /'og tu rna ba dang ni sgrar/ /rigs kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba yin/ /shar ṅghasgo yi byang du ste//nam mkha' zu ni yid gnyisashedang / /chos kyi khams su 'gyur ba yin/ /dang po thabs ni rnam pa drug /dkyil 'khor rmi ni lhag pa'i lha/ /rigabla kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi nas shes rab la sogs drug /rang rang pad+ma'i gdan la ni//gsal ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /shar gyi sgo ru stobs po dze+e /rab gtum ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /de yi shes rab rengs byed ga /lho ru lkugs byed nga rgyal mar④/ /gyur te nor sbyin gyi phyogs sa /nga rgyal byed ma rmugs ma'o/ /⑤rengs byed brtson 'grus dpag med pa/ /chu lha ru ni gnas gyur pa/ /sgo yi dbusan pad+marakyiganag /lha rnams 'di dag g.yon brkyang ste/ /rdo rje can gyi 7byed984

athung du/ /ral gri can gyi tshekhothung ngu/ narin chen phyag rgya ṛ nyid 'gyuradze+e/ /'od dpag med pa u thung ngu/ /'gyur te slar yang layig ni/ /'di ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ /ring po'i dngos po'i dbye ba yis/ /dbyangs kyi tshogs ni ma lus pa/ /rigs drug rnams kyi ①rim pas so/ /dpal yum gyi ni mi shigs brjod/ /alas skyes pa nam make'i khams/ /zhidzā k+ṣiṃljo rim pa lag /rlung dang me da༄ chu dang ga /thams cad 'byung ba ru ni phogyur/ /rgyal ba dam pa'i bdag po dang / /sna tshogs yum gyi bde don du/ /lus kyi dngos po phan tshun du//mi bskyong pa ni stong ba'i khams/ /phyag gi pad+ma ral gri can/ /spyan ma rnams kyi dngos po'o/ /rin chen bdag mosnyemā ma tī/ /gzhan yang pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / /gos dkar mo ni lus kyi dngos/ /de bzhin 'khor lo can sgol ma/ /rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis ni⑤/ /thung dang ring ba'i dbyangs rnams kyis/ /ikyini kun du bzang po la/ /gyur te lus kyi dbang gis na/ /phyag na rdo rje yi ⑦ni zha /nam mkha'i snying po ethung ngushe/ /gyur te gzhan yang de bzhin du/ /sa yi snying porayi.ar ro ste/ /oṃni 'jig rten mgon po ste/ /de bzhin mal ⑩du gyur pa ste| /ded+kuni sgrib pa rnam sel lus/ /a ni chos kyi dbyings nyid du/ /de bzhin du ni nges par 'gyur/ /alas skyes pa sgra rdo rje/ /tshelas skyes pa regadzordo rje/ /ro yi rigs kyi gtso bo nyid/ /skelas skyes pas lus dbye bas/ /go las skyes pa gzugs rdo rje/ /gyur te de bzhin mi ⑫bdag po/ /a las skyes pa dri rdo rje/ /dpal gyi bzang mo chos kyi dbyings/ /sgra yi rigs kyi gtso mo dang / /phyag na rdo rje shini gzugs/ /nam mkha'i snying po dri rdo rje/ /ro yi mchog gi rigs gtso dang / /'jig rten mgon po yang ni zung / /sa asnying po gzugs 7—985

rdo rje/ /reg bya sgrib pa rnam sel dag /zung du yang ni 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar rigs ni drug po dag /rigs rnams yon tan dbang gis ni/ /yang dag par ni rig par bya/ /ya la zung gi rim pa yis/ /stobs dang gnod mdzes ma ni zung —/ /gsal ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /ra 'a lkugs ①dang nga rgyal ma/ /rigase kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba yin/ /thadang ra ni 'di nyid las/ /nga rgyal byed pa lkugs⑧byed ma/ / lo yang gnod⑧mdzes brtson 'grus ma/ /rigs kyi dbang gisakhya'agyur ba yin/ /shes rab thabs ri yan lag dngos/ /rigs kyi dbang gis ⑤'gyur ba yin/ /gang zhig gang la khas phyogs pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang dpal kun du bzang / /rigs kyi dbang gis ⑥'gyu ba yin/ /mi bskyong phyag na rdo rje dang / /don yod grub pa mkha'ashesnying po/ /dri med nor bu byed ⑧pa dang —/ /yang dag par na sa snying po/ /'khor lo'i phyag dang sgrib sel ba/ /rigs kyi dbang gis ⑨'gyur ba yin/ /'od dpag med dang 'jig rten mgon/ /rigs kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba yin/ /dpal byi yum dang chos kyi dbyings/ /rdo rje dbyings dang sgra rdo rje/ /rigs kyi dbang gis⑩'gyur ba yin/ /dpal gyi sgol ma reg rdo rje/ /gos dkar mo yi rigs dbye bag /ro yi rdo rje ma nyid do/ /wā ma⑩tī dang gzugs rdo rje/ /rigs kyi dbang gisasnye'agyur ba yin/ /spyan ma dri yi rdo rje ma/ /slar la yang ni stobs po dze+e /don yod grub pa'i rigs las byung / /rin chen phyag las lkugs ⑫pa nyid/ /rigs kyi dbang gisabyu'agyur ba yin/ /'od dpag med dang sgom byed ma/ /rengs pa nyid dang rnam snang mdzad/ /rlung dang me dang chu sa las/ /brtson 'grus lag med lkugasasnyem dang —/ /nga rgyal can ma rim pa bzhin/ /nges pa kho nar gsal bad+kuni/ /7—986

gnod ma ru ①ni rab tu grags/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni nang dbus su/ /ston pa lha mo sogs bum pa/ /lhan cig rgyal ba yi ni sku/ /sangs rgyas la sogs chos kyi sku//sgra rdor la sogs byang chub sems/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa yi ni sku/ /khro bo rnams ni sprul pa'i sku/ /yon tan gyi ni dbang gis 'gyur/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gnas pa dzi /sems can kun rmi don byed pa/ /sku yi rdo rje zung du 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang lhan cig tu/ /sku rdzogs pa yi rgyu ru'o/ /gsung gi rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /zung du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /chos rnams ston par byed pa yi—/ /sems dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dzi /zung du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sems can kun gyi don byed pa'o/ /ye shes dang ni sprul pa'i sku/ /srog chags rnams la thar pa ster/ /zung du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /shes rab thabs kyi yan lag dngog /mthun dang mi mthun pa yi rigs/ /nyi zla aka la sogs pa//srid pa rnam pa gsum song ba/ /ye shes rnam shes dbye ba ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rig par bya/ /rdo rje gsum po ②swā hār ldan/ /spyi bo⑧mgrin pa snying ga dang | /lte ba gsang ba spyi bo ru/ /'di rnams kyis ni lus byin brlab④/ /mchog gi rgyal pa'i bdag po ni/ /lha mo rnams kyis bkru bar bya⑤/ /rdo rje phan tshun rdo rje nyid/ /cod pan du ni 'gyur ba yin/ /res 'ga' 0sangs rgyas lnga yis ni/ /gzugs kyi steng du mi bskyod pa/ /g.yas pa ru ni pad mtshan gyi/ /rnam par snang mdzad nyid du 'gyur/ /rin chen lce yi pad+ma 'dzin/ /rab mchog nor bu byed pa ni/ /don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan no/ /drug gi cod pan ral pa mdzod/ /yon tan gyi ni dbang gisashe'agyur/ /lhag ma 'khor lo gzhan dag go//stong pa nyid dang chos kyi dbyingag /rigs gsum gyisatsoni dam tshig dang / /ye 7—987

shes mchod pa rjes chags dang / /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dze+e /de shirang bzhin bdag nyid ni/ /sgrub pa po yis mchod par bya/ /du ba la sogs bum pa rnams/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo dze+e /rtsa brgyad rnams kyisashedagapa yin/ /rig ma⑧rnams dang sangs rgyas rnamag /spyi bo 4ni lhan cig skyes/ /rtsibs ni bcu drug pa ru grags/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo dze+e /mi shibadag po nyis 'gyur ni/ /byang chub sems sogs dag pa'o/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo yi| /nor bushegadengs can gyis bgres pa'i/ /'jigs pa la sogs dag tu'o//lag pa rkang pa dag gi tshigs / /stong pa drug dang me yi grangs / /las kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams dag /klu dang gtum mo'i bcu drug rnamag /sor mo rnams kyi tshigs kyi mtshalasaX/ /bya ba'i 'khor lo dag par 'gyur/ /rdo rje can dpal dus dag par/ /mi yi bdag por 'gyur ba ni/ /lo dang zla sogs dbye bas so/ /sems nid+kusnang ba snang ba meg /nyi ma so so'i dbang gis ni/ /sna tshogs yul di rnam dag pa/ /du ba la sogs rlung dag pa/ /rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma ni/ /rtsa yi 'khor lor gnas pa'o/ /drag po chung ma bcas mnan pa/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud bcom mo/ /khyab bdag zhabs kyi mthil gyis ni/ /bdud mnan bdud tshogs bcom pa'o/ /dung dang gaji nor bu dang / /ljon shing zhes pa de bzhin du/ /sku yi rdo rje la sogs bzhin/ /bum brgyad lus ni bdud rtsi brgyad/ /rgyal ba rnam par rgyal bum pa/ /byang chub sems dang rdul bstan pa'o/ /'du byed don yod grub pa gle /tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan dang / /'du shes 'od dpag med pa'o/ /gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad desde//khu ba rkang dang khrag dang ni/ /dri chu dri chen rnam dag pa'i/ /khams drug rnam 7—988

dag lha mo drug /yul dang yul can rnam dag pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyar bcas/ /khro bo lnga ni stobs lnga nyid/ /gzhan ni dbang po lnga yin no/ /rgan byad la sogs brgyad dang 'khor/ /pad+ma'i 'dab mar song ba rnams/ /nyi dus chu tshod rnam dag pa'o/ /bden bral la sogs zla bcu gnyis/ /pad+ma'i 'dab mar song ba rnams/ /chu tshod kyi ni dbugs grangs tshad/ /klu dang gtum mo rnams gsang ba/ nami yi bdag po nyis 'gyur ro/ /rtsa rnams kyi ①ni dag—pa'o/ /de bzhin spyan ma la sogs pa/ /rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis ni/ /lus kyi bya ba dag pa'o/ /skyarnams grub pa ma lus pa/ /ba spu rnams ni 'byung ba'i tshogs/ /sa yi steng na gnas rnams so/ /de nyid rnams ni gtsospatshon mas/ /rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis ni/ /khams ③rnams dag pa'i phyag rgya'o| /rdo rje rnams ni nang phyag rgya/ /gtso bo yisnyeni snying du ni/ /zla steng yang dag gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje can dpal sna tshogs yum/ /srid pa rnam pa gsum song ba| /dus gsum yeshes sbyang bsra saso/ /dpal ⑤dag pa las chos kyi sku/ /chos lasakyilongs spyod rdzogs skur 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs las sprul pa'i skur/ /gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag por ni/ /sems can byu ni don gyi phyir/ /bzhi pa gnas nalgenyal ba dang / /slar la yang ni ga na ma gnyis/ /lus kyi dbye bas sad pa'o/ /de ltar lus kyi dbye ba yis/ /srog chags rnams kyi ⑧lus la yid/ /rnam pa bzhi ni gnas pa yin/ /sprul pa longs spyod rnams la yid/ /lus dang dbang gi rjes byed pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sems lta ba/ /rigs kyi dbang gis gyur pa yin/ /chos kyi sku aganyid log pa/ /dag pa'i bde bar gyur pa ste/ /'di ni nyin dang mtshan dag gis/ /thig le gsum gyi grol ba'i 7—989

mthar/ /de yis ①phyir ni mi 'dzag don/ /nyin dang mtshan gyi dus su ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ /g.yon du srog ni rgyas 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin g.yas su rdul ba dang / /de ni g.yon brkyang gnas pa'o/ /gtum mo lte ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /dgu pa sdelag 'gro yis bsnun pa/ /rgan byad lasogs pa yi lha| /snying po ha yi ye shes ni/ /skad cig ma ru snang ba ste/ /ye shes ga brjid sad pa'o/ /lte ba la ni rnam snang sogs/ /bsreg cing spyan ma mig la — —sogs/ /thams cad bsregasasnyinas spyi bor gang / /zla ba bzang las 'dzag pa ni/ /thig le de ni rdo rje can/ /shes rab chos 'byung la gnas pa/ /slar yang thig le nyid las ni/ /ma lus par ni spros pa dag /sna tshogs pa yi rgyan dang ldan—/ /me long nang song lta bu'o/ /ye shes 'khor lo rabasnye'abyung ba/ /'dod pa'i gzugs dang gzugs ⑤med paradu/ /srid pa rnam pa gsum zhe na⑦/ /rim pa yis ni sbyangs na4su/ /phyi nang ye shes mchod pa ni/ /srid pa gsum — ma lus pa/ /skad cig gcig gis dgug par bya/ /zla nyi adang ka la sogag /rnam pa gsum du 'gro 'ong ba/ /sku yi rdo rje sogs bzlas pa/ /so sor sdud pa la sogs drug /gser ni btso ma'i 'dab ma la/ /sku dang gsunge thugs sbyor ba yis| /rdo rje pad+ma dga' la sogs/ /ro ni mnyam par 'gyur ba dzi /rdo rje gsum ni bsgom par bya/ /shes rab pad+mar sems thig dze+e /lhan cig skyes la bde dbang gis/ /mi shigs paratsoni bsgom par 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa bdud rtsi lnga la sogs/ /rigs kyi gtso mo bzhi yi ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa la sogs pa/ /so sor sdud pa la sogs 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+ma las skyes pa'i/ /bdud rtsi nye bar bskul ba'o/ /dga' ba la sogs rdo rje gsum/ /pad+mah+phuro ni mnyam song ba/ /7—990

bsgom pa bsgrub par 'gyur ba'o/ /shes rab sbyor ba mi 'dzag gang / /sgrub pa chen po nyid 'gyur ro①/ /phra mo yi ni sbyor bas so/ /dang po stong pa'i byang chub nyid| /de nas thig le lasnye'adus pa/ /de nas sku ni babyed pa nyid/ /rab mchog ro yerigs kyis ni/ /yi ge rnams ni dgod pa nyid/ /'di rnams thun mong bsnyen pa ste/ /rdo rje rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /①dbu ma yi ni sgrub pa'o/ /'di ru thabs ni rnam pa bzhir/ / lag te chung ngu brtan pa yis/ /bsgrub pa'i yan lag de bzhin no/ /so sor sdud pa rnam pa bcu/ /rgyal ba yi ni dbang por 'gyur/ /de bzhin bsam gtan mi bskyong pa/ /srog dang rtsol ba ral gri can/ /slar la yang ni rnam pa bcu/ /gzung ⑤ba rin chen phyag rgya can/ /g.yung mo rjes su dran pa ni/ /pad+ma 'dzin pa ru ni 'gyur/ /dpal gyi ting 'dzin 'khor lo can/ /re re yang ni lnga ru dbye/ /slar la yang ni gang dbye ba/ /al sogs dang ka la sogs/ /so sor sdud pa yul can ni/ /yul can rnam pa bcu po rnams/ /yul la 'jug pa med pa'o/ /shes rab rtog pa dpyod pa rnams/ /dga' ba mi g.yo bde ba dang / /bsam gtan sems ni gcig pa'o//gtum mo 'di ni snang ba dgas /lus la nges par gsal bar 'gyur⑦/ /nam mkha' de ni rjes dran 'gyur/ /srog dang rtsol ba gnyis kyi lam/ / tsa 'khrug ⑧pa ru 'gyur ba ni/ /dbu mar srog ni 'jug pa'o/ /thig le ru ni srog 'jug cing —/ /gnyis kar 'gro dang 'ong ba dang / /gzung ba nyid ni sems gcig pa//shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid kyi/ /lhan cig skyes pa de dbang gis/ /ye shes sbu ni ting 'dzin pas/ /'di ni chu sogs dbye ba yis/ /gsum du yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sna tshogs bdag po'i sgrub thabs so/ /phyag rgya gsum dang tshad 7—991

ni gsum/ /rnam pa gsum ni srid dbang gis/ /las dang kun rtogs bzang mo yis| /so sor sdud pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /yul dang rnam par bral ba dang / /sngags rnams kyis ni byen brlabs nas/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba dag pa yis/ /mngon shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /srog dang rtsol ba dag pas na/ /zla ba nyi ma dag par ①bral/ /byang chub sems dpas mchod par 'gyur/ /gzungakub yi ni stobs kyis ni/ /nyon mongs la sogs bdud bcom zhing / /stobs bcu la ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /rjes dran gyis ni dag par 'gyur/ /dri med 'od 'phro'i dkyil 'khor te/ /ga na yang ye shes sku las so/ /de phyir dag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis—/ /nyi ma cung zad tsam gyis ni/ /ye shes sku ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /so sor sdud la sogs pa yis/ /gal te gzir bar ma gyur na/ /sngags pa rnams kyis sde'adod mi 'grub/ /sgra la sogs pa'i yan lag ma'i/ /pad+ma rdo rje nor bu ru| /thig le gzung ④bar bsgrub par bya/ /bsnyen pa dang po'i sbyor ba ni/ /nam mkha' ru ni rnam pa bcu/ /'khor lo can 'gro blta ba'o/ /bgegs ni mthar byed kyang blta ba/ /bdud rtsi'i lam du song ba yang / /nye ba'i bsnyen pa ⑤yan lag drug /shes rab la sbyor zla thig le/ /ga na yang rdo rje nor bu ste/ /yi ge gsum ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /bde ba ma nyams gcig zhi ba/ /lhan cig skyes pa ru ni 'gyur/ /bsgrub chen ye shesasbyor bas so/ /srog dang rtsol ba kun nas ni/ /mgo bo'i bar ni phan pa gle /mnyam pa'i bde ba 'bras ster ba/ /de las steng ni mi phan pa/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa byed pa'o/ /sems can nyes pas bzlog pa'i rgyu/ /gtsug tor sgo ni phug nas ga /mchog tu bde ba'i go 'phang du/ /'di ni sbyar bar bya ba nyid/ /phung po med pa'i rnal 7—992

rnams byon pa dang / /lhar baspyod dbang bskur byin brlabs pa'i/ /cho ga'i rim pas rdzogs par bya/ /mchod pa rnams dang gtor ma bsgo /oṃbrah+ma/be+eju/ ṣ+perje⑥t+ya/ bā yu/ yashem/ ari/ sa mu dra chasho ra/ in+d+ra yaste 7| sa pa ri bā re byug dze+erda ba ka gar+ghaṃ/ pu྾/ dhū paṃ dri paṃ ak+ṣa haṃ de da ma te teca tshe②na sa pa ri bā rā shī hūṃ charda ba mnyakṛsna tu kha dartse pi ban+tu/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hon san lngap+ta⑤/ sarba sa tā shā shārnyi puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣukyi4 ra na gudzhai kurbaskyo hūṃshehūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā ⑧pa ya ti swā hā/ slar yang mchod cing bstod pa dang / 0 ge ⑨brgyas phrin lasalgeso sor bshags/ /gtsug tor du ni rtse lnga pa'i| /rdo rje ru ni gyur pa yin/ /phyi nas rtse mo nyis 'gyur du/ /gyur pa chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /de ni nyisa'agyur du bsgres pa/ /lhan cig skyes par 'gyur ba dang | /de yi yang ni ga na nyis 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo dang / /sprul pa pini 'khor lo'o/ /de yi nang du rtse gcig go/ /mnyam pa'i bde ba'i 'bras ster ba/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma la gnas pa/ /phyag rgya bsgom pa'i don du 1sungag /nyin dang mawo mo'i dus su kyi/ /'dod chags zad don nyid du ni/ /gsung gi rdo rje myang don du/ /sngags pa rnams la gsungs pa nyid//nyes par bya ba kho na min/ /nyi ma so so'i dus su ni/ /zas kun bde ba'i don du ste—/ /mi 'a ga pad+kuyi rgyu ru ni/ /dpal gyi spyod pa dngos grub sgyur/ /ro bsregs gnas su mtshan mo ni/ /'gro la brtse ⑫ba'i don du min/ /rnal 'byor pa gang srog gcod pa'i/ /nyin dang mtshan du byed pa ni⑫/ /de ni srog 'jig pa ru gsungs/ /sgra gang kha dang bral ba ni/ /snying la yod par rab gyur pa/ /de ni brdzun du sab nyid/ /kun mkhyen gye ni ye shes sar/ /'dzin pa yang ni byed 7—995

pa gang / /rnal 'byor par yang de gsungs so/ /bde ba'i thigale ma lhung ba/ /gzhan byu bud med du ni 'gyur/ /bsten pa chags bral min pa'o/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i me yis ni/ /ri bong can yang zhu ba'o/ /btung ba chang gi btung ba'o//mthe bong tshigs nas gtsug tor du/ /tshes kyi dbang gis 'gro ba ni/ /nya mthar thug pa rang gi sems/ /gtsug tor nas ni rang gi semago /yang ni 'di ni 'gro 'gyur ba/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi bathar thug par/ /rnal 'byor pa 4spyod des| /nyi ma re re'i dus su ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub rab tu ster/ /spyod dang 'dod pa lus tshad pa/ /mchog gi kha pipad+ma las/ /tshig mi 'byung zhing gnyid log pa'o/ / 'di ①ni 'khrul dang rgyal ba ni/ /du ba la sogs rdo rje can//de rnams gsal ba rnam pa bcu/ /srog can lusakyi gnas skabs so/ /'jig rten 'dod pa'i gnas skabs di/ /nges pa kho nar gsal ba las/ /su zhig rgyal bar su 'dod pa/ /thig le dkar po'i rgyun ni gangaka /nyin dang mtshan mo'i lhung ba ni—/ /mā ma tī ni de chang ngesnye/ /go ṭul sogs mig la sogag /nyi ma re re bzhin spros pa/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsten pa ni/ /rang gi rigasakyi sar song ba—/ /lha rnams dag pa'i lus la'o/ /stong pa'i sems de brtson pa yis/ /lhan cig skyes pa khyab bde ba/ /de ni skyoganas 'khrig pa min/ /nor misbyin pa btang ba dang / /bud med sbyor ba yid kyis ni/ /mi 'dzag pa ni tshul khrims go/bzod pa sgra sogs mi 'jug pa/ /gnyis kar song ba'i le lo ni/ /rnam par 'jig pa brtson 'grus so/ /bsam gtan shes rab sems dang ni/ /bde ba lhan cig par song kun/ /'gro ba thams cad brjodashepa'o/ /sems can don du de rdzu 'phrul/ /srid pa'i don ni mi byed pa/ /thob pa gzhan ni bzhi pa'o/ /7—996

gyi skub thabs yan lag bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ dzinak+ṣa tra maṇ+ḍa la sā dha na me ka da saṃ ②ga nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor rmi sgrub thabs yan lag bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba/ dpal dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pashā ye shes sku/ /nyin mor byed pa'i 'od lte bu//pad+ma rgyas pa 'dra ba'i spyan/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /lha yi mchog la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /rgyu skar dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs bri/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /rgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rten dang yo byad bsags⑧nas ni/ /dngos grub yan lag bcu gcig bsgom/ /bsrung dang kha dogacidag pa dang / /bdag nyid dag bya bdag bsrung dang / /tshogs gnyis bsags dang dkyil 7—1001

'khor babyed/ /byin rmis ①brlabs dang dbang bskur dang / /phra mo'i thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / /mchod bstod rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /cho ga de dag re re la'ang / /cho ga dang ni ting 'dzin dang / /nga rgyal bzung ba gsum gsum mo//dang por tho rangs sngar langs nas/ /nam mkha'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i/ /rol mos gnyid bsangs pa ru bsams/ /thal sbyar sngags 'dis phyag bya'o/ /mkhasaza bī ra yo gi rī na maḥkā ya bāskru pra ṇa me ban+da rna ka ro yā mi/ de nas khams bsang ①maṇ+ḍal bya/ /me tog tshom bu lha grangs bzhin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten yang dgod/ /mchod pa rnams dang rol mo dang / /gtor ma dag kyang bsham par bya/ /bdag nyid rdo rje shugs su bsgom/ /spyi bo sogs su yi ge dgod/ /rdo rje bsams la bka' bsgo ④ba/ /hūṃ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ri dpal ldan rdo rje'i stobs—/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor ba⑤/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus 'di yis/ /sku gsum las byung dgas ༷par bya/ /gal te dam tshig las 'das na⑦/ /zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /rdo rje 'bar ba bde chen po/ /ye shes 'byung ba'i las rtsom gyis / /brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs/ /gnas 'dir ma gnas gzhan du dengs/ /rdo rje rnams las ⑨me dpung 'bar/ /sngags 'dis bgegs rnams sreg par byed/ /cha.āḥhūṃ ⑩hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥgrwaḥhwaḥhāḥhāḥr ra ra ra/ badzā na la saza ba ra ṇa dhas+thā pād+kul ya swa bhā ⑫ba mā ra ka yi ka bispyo bi nā ya ⑫ka dri shā/ da byasha di ka ga tā ram̐ kra ya bāskru shā/ da ha da ha/pa tsa pa tsa/ bha— ku ru ku ru hūṃ ⑫hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pas bdud rnams sreg ⑩par bsam/ /oṃ ā hūṃ⑩ra badz+ra tsan+d+ra srur+ya rā hu la kā la mchi yaḥkra ya bākyi 1 na 7—1002

lus dang ngag yid dang bas gsum la gus su mchi bar bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sna tshogs dge ba gang byas pa yi dge 'dun dang //de dag kun la rjes su yi rang nas ni sdig bral byang chub spyod la rjes su 'jugasangs rgyas rnams la chos kyi 'asar lo bskor bar bskul zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms dag la byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /'di ①ni sems can don phyir rdzogs pa'i byang chub bdag 'gyur smon lam gdab par bgyi/ /bsod nams rtsa ba gsum sogs dran/ /ye shes tshogs ni stong nyid bsgom/ /phyi nang snod bcud thams cad ni/ /dngos dang bral bas stong pa nyid/ /rgyu las ske'adas pas mtshan ma med/ /'bras bu med pas smon pa med/ /skye 'gag ①med pas 'dus ma byas/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā bāt+na ko3rjohaṃ/ oṃ a ni mit+tasnyedz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā bāt+na kophorjohaṃ/ oṃ a pra ti ha ⑦ta 1 na badz+ra swa bhā bād+ma kopho⑧haṃ/oṃ a na ji saṃ ska ra 1 na badz+ra swa bhā bād+ma kopho⑨haṃ/ rang nyid thugs mtshan yi ge sogs| /thig le'i bdag nyid skar mda' bzhin/ /rim pas bsdus te —'dzin med par/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams/ /rang bzhin zhugs pas yul dang bral/ /kun gzhi rnam shes 'od gsal bsgom/ /oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta shu n+ya tābyutshwa na badz+ra swa bhā bād+ma kopho⑪haṃ/ de yis nga rgyal gzung ⑫bar bya'o/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i yan lag ste lnga pa'o// //de nas stong nyid ngang las ni/ /nyi steng sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /rdo rje'i dra gur rtsibs bcu yi/ /lte ba ⑫a las chos 'byung ngo / /:/ hūṃ yo hūṃ/7—1007

hūṃ ram̐ hūṃ/ hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ lo hūṃ/ hūṃ me hūṃ/ hūṃ k+ṣe hūṃ/ hūṃ haṃ hūṃ/ rlung gnag byum po rgyal mtshan can/ /me dmar gru gsum g.yung drung mtshan/ /chu dkar rlum po pad+mas mtshan/ /sa ser gru bzhi 'khor los mtshan/ /de dag steng dang 'og tu yang / /sna tshogasu rdo rje'i rgya gram mo/ /de steng lhun po kha khyer ldan/ /nyi zla pad+ma sgra gcan bcas/ /de steng oṃme hūṃshelas ni/ /gzhal yas khang brtsegs mchod rten ni/ /rin chen rang bzhin gru bzhi ni/ /rin chen snam bu pha gu dang / /dra ba dra phyed mda' yang dang / /sgo dang rta babs bcu gnyis dang / /re khā gsum dang lnga po gnyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /snying po ye shes 'dab ma dag /rdo rje zeng bas bskor ba'o/ /phyi ma thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /pad sogs ka ba bcu drug dang / /chu skyes rdo rje ra bas mdzes/ /lha yi snam bu dag gis bskor/ /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor la/ /chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa brgyad/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /phyi rol sku yi dkyil 'khor lha/ /pad 'dab bzhi brgyad bcu drug pa/ /bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor/ /phyi rol gling ni bcu —gnyis dang / /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa dze+e /rnga bo che dang byang chub shing / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i phreng bas bskor/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba'i steng / /zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dang / /bdud dang drag po yab yum dang / /bdud ni gdong gcig kha dog dmar/ /lag bzhi mda' dang lcags kyu g.yas/ g.yon pas gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin/ /yum ni dga' mo dang bcas g.yas/ /drag po gdong gsum mdog dmar po/ /g.yon pas thod pa kha ṭī 'dzin/ /khrusnyema'i yum bcas g.yon du gdeng / /de steng⑧7—1008

mngon par byang chub pa/ /masa.i ṛ/ u 'gre/ a e ar yongamal/ ha ya ra wa la i shā lnga bā rā yā hā/ ā ma araskyem hā/ smyo khru dzā sminalga zla ba yi ges mtshar pa ste༄/ /me long ye shes dgakyipa'o/ /l+la sbra yā ṇ+ḍa l+la ⑤zla hra bo hrakyit+ta 31tsho sgo shā rngo/ t+ta sgra drwa : n+da/ za rnge sba — sma/ ṣ+ṭa khru ṇ+ḍa ṇ+ḍa/ rtso ts+tsha dz+dza rngo snya/ k+ka k+ṣa ga — jashe/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa che ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ṅka sha ṣa tha sa/ la ba ra ya ha/la wa ya ḍarte/ sgrom blu ges mtshan pa 'og /mnyam nyid ye shes gnyis pa'o/ /bar du dri za'i yi ge hūṃ/ /so so rtog pa gsum pa'o/ /nyi yig gcig gyur rdo rjer gyur/ /bya grub ye shes bzhi pa'o/ /phaṭa kyi cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /chos dbyings ye shes lnga pa'o/ /gtso bo sku mdog sngon po la/ /kha dog phyogs bzhi dag tu gsungs/ /zhal bzhi phyag ni nyer bzhi pa/ /mgrin gsum zhabs gnyis brkyang bzhugs pa/ /dbus zhal mthing ga mche gatshigs drag /g.yas pa dmar po chags pa dze+e /g.yon pa dkar po zhi ba'i zhal/ /rgyab ni ser po ting 'dzin bzhugs/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs bcu gnyis spyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed dang / — /rdo rje sems dpas dze+edabu brgyan pa'o/ — /glang chen stag wags na bza' can/ /mgrin gsum gnag dmar dkar po'o/ /dpung pa drug ni sngo dmar dkar/ /phyag ngar bcu gnyis de bzhin no/ /phyag mgo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /gnag dmar dkar po'i rim pa bzhin/ /mthe bong la sogs sor mo bcu/ /ser dkar dmar gnag snga bzhin nokhya/ /tshigs kyi phreng ba sngo dmar dkar/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum dang / /gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu dang / /ḍaru tho ba 'khor lo mdung / /dbyug pa dgra sta g.yas pas 'dzin/ /7byed1009

dril bu phub dang kha ṭī ga /thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa dang / /rin chen pad dkar dung dang ni/ /me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgo g.yon/ /cod pan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang / /gdu bu dpung rgyan ska rags dang / /zhabs gdub rnams ni rdo rjes brgyan/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal dang / /thal ba zeng ba gtsug nor bu/ /klu chen bcu yis de bzhin brgyan/ /g.yon dkar g.yas dmar brkyang ba'i zhabs/ /yum ser zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab zhal gnag /gri gug lcags kyu ḍashem ru/ /phreng ba g.yas pas 'dzin par mdzad/ /thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dang / /rin chen nor bu g.yon na 'dzin/ /rgyan rnams gtso bo dag dang mthun/ /g.yon brkyang gtso bo'i sku la 'ag/ /de nas 'khor lo drug po la/ /cha.āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥdagod| /de nas 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /bkug nas dkyil 'khor de la gzhug /yab yum mkha' gsang byin brlabs te/ /snyoms 'jug sgra yis rnam snang sogs/ /nang du bkug nas bzhugs par bsam/ /yab yum byang chub sems kyis ni/ /bha gar de la dbang bskur bya/ /sems can de rnams dkyil 'khor lha/ /zhal gsum phyag drug sogs su gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /mchog dga'i bde bas gang bar bsam/ /k+ṣa k+ṣi k+ṣ-i gru 1/ k+ṣu spyo spyo khyu 1/ k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣur khyo k+ṣal k+ṣelnga / k+ṣu k+ṣe k+ṣur k+ṣiṃ k+ṣal spyoḥ/lha ྾ — khyu/ : smyu ji smra 7/ de sogs lus kyi dkyil 'khor lha/ /phyung la dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya/ /spyi mgrin snying gar cha.ā hūṃ/ /gtsug tor haṃ bsam lte ba ru/ /hoḥlas gtum mo ye shes 'od/ rab 'bar gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ /bde chen 'od du zhu ba las/ /tshad med bzhi yi lha mo'isnyegrus/ /7—1010

'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pas bskul/ /spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i ma/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag chags mdzod/ /bdag ni sring ①mo mā ma tī/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag chags mdzod/ /gos dkar bdag ni bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag chags mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri med gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag chags mdzod/ /lha mos glu mdzad bcom ldan khrod//sems can kun la phan mdzad pa/ /rdo rje can gyis bdag bsrung mdzod/ /lha mo'i bla mas 'dod can 'dod pa mdzad don bzhengs/ /de ltar bskul ba gsan nas ni/ /chos sku stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ /mig 'phrul lta bur bzhengs mdzad de/ /hūṃ phre⑧spro zhing bskul bas zhu/ /rdo rje dang ni gri gug hūṃ du gyur/ /de bzhin gtso bo yab yum bzhengs/ /de nas 'khor gyi lha spror ①phyir| /rdo rje pad+mar byin brlabs la/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug sgras/ /chos kyi dbyengs nas sangs rgyas rnams/ /bkug la yab kyi zhal du thim/ /bha ga gnas brgyud yum gyisasnyeni/ /pad+mar zhugs te bha gar brgyud/ /yum gyi zhal nas yab zhal du/ /zhugs nas yab kyi rdo rje nas/ /sa bon yum gyi pad+ma ru/ /yi ge spros nas phyogs phyogs gnas/ /de nas phyag mtshan de las sku/ /de la phyir spros gdan la dgod/ /a dang rdo rje las gyur pa/ /mi bskyong zhal gsum phyag drug sngo/ /spros nas be+er yang gtso la thim/ /rdo rje 7—1011

dbyings phyug sku mdog sngo/ /spros nas slar yang gtso mor⑥thim/ /snying po ye shes 'khor lo yi/ /chu skyes 'dab brgyad zla ba'i steng/ /a āX.i bcaha hā haṃ haḥ| lha mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad de/ /shar du nag mo 'bar ma ste/ /sku dang mdun gyi zhal mthun ①gnag /g.yas dmar g.yon dkar rgyab ser zhal/ /spos dang tsan+dan gur gum snod/ /gla ba ga bur ldan snod g.yas/ /dril bu pad+ma lha shing gi /me tog dang ni phreng ba g.yon/ /nub tu ser 'bar mdun zhal ser/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab sngo zhal/ /dung dang nor bu gling bu dang / /ḍa ma ru ni phyag g.yas na/ /pi wang rgyud mangs dang ni mda'/ /dril bu khrol ba rang g.yon na④/ /byang du dkar 'bar dbus zhal dkar/ /g.yas gnag g.yon ser rgyab zhal dmar/ /'o ma'i snod dang chu sgod dang / /lha yi sman dang chang snod g.yas/ /bdud rtsi'i snod dang grub pa'i bcud/ /a ru ra dang 'bras zan g.yon/ /lho ru dmar 'bar dbus zhal dmar/ /g.yas ser g.yon sngo rgyab dkar zhal/ /mar me mu tig do shal dang / /cod pan gdu bu phyag g.yas na/ /na bza' dang ni sku regs dang / /rna cha dang ni rkang rgyan g.yon/ /shar lhor du ba nag mo dang / /nub byang mar me ser mo dang / /byang shar mkha' gsal dkar mo dang / /lho nub smig rgyu dmar po bzhi| /zhal ni phyogs bzhi'i lha mo mtshungs/ /phyag brgyad thams cad rnga yab bsnams/ /mnyam brkyang pa yi stabs kyis bzhugs/ /rdo rje byas mo krung gis yab/ /yum ni pad+ma'i bzhugs stabs so/ /mtshalas kyi gru chad bzhi dag la—/ /khro.āḥhūṃ ⑤hoḥ/ chos kyi dung dkar byang shar du/ /gaṇ+ḍi dmar po lho nub mtshalas/ /shar lhor yid bzhin nor bu gnag /dpag bsam shing ser 7—1012

rdo rje gri gug dgra sta g.yas/ /dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo g.yon/ /dbus nag g.yas dmar g.yon ser zhal/ /ral gri gri gug rtse gsum g.yas/ /phub dang thod pa kha ṭī g.yon/ /dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yon gnag zhal/ /mda' dang cang te'u lcags kyu g.yas/ /gzhu dang zhags pa rin chen g.yon/ /dbus dkar g.yas gnag g.yon dmar zhal/ /tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum g.yas—/ /pad+ma me long phreng ba g.yon/ /dbus ser g.yas dkar g.yon sngo zhal| /'khor lo dbyug pa rdo rje g.yas/ /dung dang lcags sgog dril bu g.yon| /yab yum yul la bsams pa ni/ /'du byed gzugs ni gnyis med yab yum ste/ /'du shes tshor ba de bzhin no/ /sna dang dri yin mig dang gzugs/ /lce dang ro yin reg dang lus/ /rna ba sgra yin sems dang chos/ /bgegs mthar byed dang rengs byed yong/ /shes rab mthar byed nga rgyal can/ /pad+ma mthar byed rmugs byed ma/ /gshin rje mthar byed brtson 'grus ma/ /yab bzhugs de ru yum 'ag cing / /yum bzhugs sa ru yab 'ag pa'o/ /kha khyer mchod pa'i lha mo dang / /'dod lha bdun cu rtsa gnyis so/ /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /shar gyi ro steng pad+ma la/ /ha nyi ya yi sngo nyi yu yī yo| /dbus su rgan byad pad 'dab la/ /'jigs ma drag ma dus mche ma/ /'bar zhal rlung shugs rab tu gtum/ /drag chenasnyesna chen brgyad kyis bskor/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag bzhi pa/ /nag mo gri gug rtse gsum g.yas/ /thod pa kha ṭī g.yon na'o/ /shar lho mkha' lding pad+ma la/ /gla spyi ya yī zhu k+ṣu⑧yu spyo yāḥ—/ lte bar khyab 'jug pad+ma la/ /dpal ldan sgyu ma grags ma dang ④/ /dpal mo dpal rgyal rnam rgyal mo/ /rgyal byed dpal ldan 'khor lo can/ /7—1014

nag moshe'akhor lo dbyug to g.yas/ /pad+ma dung ni g.yon na'o/ /lho ru ma nye pad+ma'i steng / /ha ri ṛ dzā rje z-i ru dṛ ②ram̐/ lte bar phag mo 'dab ma la/ /keng rus dus mtshan rab khro'i gdong / /dus kyi lce ma gatshigs ma dang / /dus ma mi bzad lus ngan ma/ /dmar mo dbyug pa ral gri g.yas/ /mdung thung lcags kyu g.yon na'o/ /lho nub rma bya pad steng na/ /glaḥ: rā dzā : spyo rū 1 rā / lte bar gzhon nu ma 'dab las/ /pad+ma lus med gzhon nu ma/ /ri dwags bdag 'gro rin chen phreng / mig bzangs rul ma bzang mos bskor/ /dmar mo mdung thung lcags kyu g.yas/ /rin chen zhags pa g.yon na'o/ /byang du khyu mchog pad steng du④/ haṃ hu wa wi skṛ hu lu khru shaṃ lte bar drag mo 'dab ma la/ dkar mo ge gā rtag ma dang / /myur ma dang ni thig le mchog /dpal skyong ser skya nag mos bskor/ /dkar mo rtse gsum cang te'u g.yas/ /kha ṭī dris zhags g.yon na'o/ /byang shar seng ge pad+ma'i steng / /k+ṣ-i gru wā yī sde1 gru lha 1 wā dbus su dpal chen 'dab ma la/ /dkar dpal zla ba'i ri mo dang / /zla zhal ngang mdog 'dzin ma dang / /pad+ma'i dbang phyug sgol ma'i mig /dri med ri bong 'dzin mas bskor/ /dkar mo pad+ma bgrang phreng g.yas/ /g.yon na me tog rin chen noX/ /nub tu glang chen pad+ma'i steng / /hā 1 lā lī : 1 lhuspyo /me/ lte bar dbang po'i 'dab ma la/ /rdo rje'i 'od dang rdo rje'i lus/ /gser can⑧ma dang 'dod dbang ma/ /ri mo 'dri dang rtsom ma dang //zug rngu med ma sgol ma bzang / /ser mo rdo rje mda' ni g.yas/ /dril bu gzhu ni g.yon na'o/ /byang nub ngang pa pad+ma'i steng / /k+ṣu rmā khā rje 1 lu 1 lhas⑨/lte bar tshangs ma 'dab ma la/ /gtsang sbra ma dang pad+ma'i mig /chu skyes can dang 7—1015

blo gros ma/ /ngag dbang glu ma klog dran ma/ /ser mo pad+ma dbyug pa g.yas/ /yul dang phub ni g.yon na'o/ /thams cad rol pa'i 'dug stangs so/ /sgo bzhir steng 'og shing rta la/ /haṃ hāḥha hāḥ/ shar sgor gtsug tor byang drag spyan/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog lnga/ /dgra sta rtse gsum g.yas gnyis na/ /sbrul zhags kha ṭī g.yon na'o/ /lho ru sngon mo nub sum̐ bha/ /ljang gu gri gug rdo rje g.yas/ /thod pa dril bu g.yon na'o/ /'dod log bdun cu rtsa gnyis po/ /kha khyer la gnas mchod pabyed/ /de nas sku adakyil 'khor gyi/ /shar smad ro steng pad gdan la//nya nyi⑥ dzo nyu 1 haṃ/ dzha rnyi — rtso : :③/ dza dzi j-i dzu rmi rdza/ tsha tshi 1 tshu rmi tsho/tsa tsirngo tsu dṛ rtsa/ dbus su bden bralartswa rdo rje/ /'dab mar rim par nya rdo rje| /nyi rdo rje dang ni dzo rdo rje/ /nyu rdo rje dang ni sh+lau rdo rje/ /nye rdo rje dang ni dzha ①rdo rje/ /lhasnyerdo rje dang 1 rdo rje/ /tshu rdo rje rmi rdo rje/ /rdzurdo rje la sogs pa sbyar/ /sa bon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ming / /sum cu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /nag po ral gri gre gug g.yas/ /phub dang thod pa g.yon na'o/ /shar lhor sha ba pad+ma'i steng / /tsā ṭī rngo tsu oṃ tsaḥ⑤/ tsā : : tshu ā+oṃ tsāḥ0/ dzā dzī 1 dz+nyā 1 dzāḥ/ tshwa rnyi spyo tsu 1 spyo⑦/ hā tī dzo nyu 1 hāḥ/ dbus su rlung lhadz+wa ⑧rdo rje/ /tsā 0rdo rje sogs sum cu po⑩/ /nag po dpag bsam me tog g.yas/ /in+d+ra me+e lalge.ut+pal g.yon/ /lho smad lug dang pad+ma'i steng / /ṇa ṇi rje khu 1 r+ṇa/rte bhi kṛ zu ⑫rmi snye/ ḍa ḍi j-i nu dzo ḍi/ ṭha ji 1 zu khre shā/ ṭa ṭi 1 ṭu 1 ṭi/lte bar me lha 3 rdo rje/ /ṇa rdo rje sogasalgesum cu po/ /dmar po mdung dang dbyug pa g.yas/ /pad+ma ril ba spyi blugs g.yon/ /lho nub rma bya pad+ma'i steng /ṭā ṭī 1 ṭu 1 ṭāḥ/ ṣ+ṭha khri 1 ju je ba / 7 ḍi dz+wa byuhā 7ཿ/ rwa sgyi : zla zla 7—1016

bhāḥ/ ṇ+ḍa tī 1 byu 1 ṇ+ḍaḥ/ dbus su gdong drug 1 rdo rje/ /ṭāsherdo rje sogs sum cu'o/ /dmar po pad+ma mdung thung g.yas/ /rin po che dang me long g.yon//byang smad chu srin pad+ma'i steng / /ma mi sngo mu bla rma/ bha rnyi : bhu rmi lha / ba ji dza bu bla baṃ/ pha tha sngo phu z-i paṃ/ pa pi spru pu bla paṃ/ lte bar rgya mtsho thra⑧rdo rje/ /ma rdo rje sogs sum cu'o④/ /dkar po zhags pa rin chen g.yas/ /klu zhags chu shel g.yon na'o/ /byang shar bye ba pad+ma'i steng / /pā spru bye pu spyo pāḥ/ phra shī : phu pho pāḥ/ bā bī spyo byu skṛ bāḥ/ bhā ji spyo byu : bhāḥ/ mā rī snro myu tshwa māḥ/ lte ba tshogs bdag hṝ rdo rje/ /pā rdo rje sogs sum cu po/ /dkar po dgra sta rdo rje g.yas/ /zhags pa rin chen nor bu g.yon/ /nub smad glang chen pad+ma'i steng / /na ni rje nu dṛ rna/ dha dhi dz+dza byu dz+nyā dhe/ da di dṛ du dṛ rda/ tha thi j-i thu dṛ rja/ ta ti rtu tu t+pa lta/ lte bar brgya byin dṛ rdo rje/ /na rdo rje sogs sum cu po/ /ser po g.yas pa rdo rje mda'/ /dril bu gzhu ni g.yon na'o/ /nub byang ngang pa pad+ma'i steng / /tā tī hṝ tū 1 tāḥ/ thā s+thā 1 byu 1 thāḥ/ dā dī hṝ dru bye rāḥ/ d+ma dhī 1 ja : ṅgāḥ/ nā nī dz+wa nu dz+nyā ṭ+wāḥ/ lte bar tshangs pa dṛ rdo rje/ /tā rdo rje sogs sum cu po/ /ser po khab dang bgrang phreng g.yas/ /pad+ma ril ba spyi blugs g.yon/ /shar stod mkha' lding pad+ma'i steng / /nga ji dz+dza ngu dṛ rnga / gha ghi smra ku 1 r+ghaṃ/ ga gi sngo gu bla gi/ kha khi dza khu/ khre khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ ku kṛ ke /lte bar khyab 'jug gre rdo rje/ /nga rdo rje sogs sum cu po/ /sngon po 'khor lo dbyug to g.yas/ /pad+ma lnga skyes dung ni g.yon/ /lho stod ma he pad+ma'i steng / kā shī 1 kyu 1 kāḥ/ khā khyi dzā khya k+ṣ-i sgo / shā smi dz+wa gyu 1 gas/ghā sgyu 1 byu 1 :ཿ/ ngu dri d+dhi ngu j-i nguḥ/ lte bar gshin rje shrīsnyerdo rje/ /kā rdo 7—1017

rje sogs sum cu po/ /sngon po dbyug pa ral gri g.yas/ /lcags sgrog zhags pa g.yon na'o/ /byang stod khyu mchog pad+ma'i steng / /ṅka rki kṛ sku skṛ rko①/ /sha shi 1 shu sh+lau shaṃ/ ṣa ji ṣ+ṭha 6 ṭī ṣe/ dzi khri dz+dza dzi khye paṃ/ sa si sngo su slo saṃ/lte b.ratsodrag po 1 rdo rje/ ṅka rdo rje sogs sum cu po/ /ljang gu g.yas pa rtse gsum mda'/ /g.yon pa sbrul bcas kha ṭī gzhu/ /nub stod glang po pad+ma'i steng / /sā sī spru sru tshwa nas/ /r+pā spri spyo(1 2 grwa / ṣā ྾ hṝ ju j-i ṣāḥ/ shā shī 1 shu shrī shāḥ/ ṭ+wā dhī spyo rku spyo ṭ+wāḥ/ lte bar gnod sbyin spyo rdo rje/ / sā rdo rje sogs ①sum cu po/ /sngon po rin chen be con g.yas/ /no'u le rkyal pa pad+ma g.yon/ /rdo rje skyil krung byed par bzhugs/ /shar sgor phag gi shing rta dang / /lho sgor rta dang byang seng ge /nub sgor glang chen shing rta'o/ /yo re waṃ lo/ laḥ'abyuraḥ56/ lcags sgog ma dang dbyug sngon shar/ /nag mo ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ /phub dang yul zhags g.yon na'o/ /khro gnyer can dang 'dod rgyal lho/ /dmar po mda' dang lcags kyu g.yas/ /gzhu dang zhags pa g.yon na'o/ /skul ④byed ma dang mi g.yo byang / /dkar mo tho ba mdung g.yas na—/ /pad+ma me long g.yon na'o/ /'od zer can dang stobs chen nub/ /ser mo 'khor lo dbyug pa g.yas/ /dung dang rin chen g.yon na'o/ /khro mo'i stabs ni sngar bshad zin/ /kha khyer la ni 'od ldog ⑤go/ /rta babs ka ba brgyad kyi 'og /phyi rol 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la/ /byu sgyu hra hwa hwa hā h+la 7| nag mo stobs rgyu pad+ma shar/ /dmar mo nor rgyas dung skyong lho/ /dkar po mtha' yas rigs ldan byang / /ser po 'jog po pad chen nub/ /bdud rtsi bum pa rdo rje g.yas/ /pad+ma rin chen g.yon na'o/ /de nas dur 7—1018

khrod ming dang gdan/ /shar du rtse gsum bse yi gdan/ /shar lhor mi bzad bhi ruṇ+ḍa/ /lho ru ro bsreg dom gyi gdan/ /byang du rus sbal g.yag gi gdan/ /byang shar byis shir pha wang gdan/ /nub tu rul pa'i drir seng ge /nub byang dzhairdo /sbal zo/dho /sdo rdo spya /rog // /ma sdu shārdo gdu 'kho/༵ ḍi dhido/nga bya/ sgo/ //sna sna mar| /stag gdong 'ug gdong ma gnyis dkar/ /ce spyang mkha' lding gdong ma ser/ /phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa bsnams/ /rol pa'i stabs kyis⑥gnas pa'o/ /rgan byad brgya byin yab yum yin/ /phag mo rgya mtsho yab yum mo//dbang mo bden bral yab yum mo/ /drag mo me lha yab yum mo/ /khyab 'jug ma dang tshangs pa mo/ /gdong drug ma dang tshogs bdag mo/ /khyab 'jug dang ni nor byin mos/ /gshin rje dang ni chu ma'o/ /nor sbyin ma dang khyab 'jug ma/ /rgya mtsho dang ni gshin rje mo/ /phan tshun 'ag pa sngar bzhin bshad/ /pad+ma ce spyang yab yum yin/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang mkha' lding gdong / /nor rgyas klu dang stag gdong ma/ /dung skyong klusnyedang 'ug gdong ma/ /mtha' yas klu dang phag gdong ma/ /rigs ldan klu dang bya rgod gdong / /'jog po klu dang khyi gdong ma/ /pad+ma che dang bya rog gdong / /yab yum sngar bshad bzhin du'o/ /gzhan yang dur khrod brgyad po ni/ /ma mo klu dang srin dang bcu/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong zhing chen gza'④/ /ri me lha chen mchod rten dang / /rnal 'byor dpa' bo brgyad brgyad sogs/ /ro dang ce spyang dur khrod sogs/ /lo zla zhag dus rgyu skar sogs/ /dga' byed dril rna nag po che/ / jiṅgi ri ti ⑤zhing skyong dang / /pho nya 'phrog ma grub pa sogs/ /bye ba phrag ni byed dang 7—1019

bzhi'o/ /sngar gyi kha khyer 'dod log ni/ /tsaḥchadzaḥskenyaḥṭaḥṭhaḥ9cheḥṇaḥpaḥphaḥbaḥbhaḥmaḥtaḥthaḥdaḥdhaḥnaḥ/ shar stod/ ཿtsokhogaṅkaḥlaḥdze+eḥyaḥkakha gaḥghaḥngaḥskaḥhaḥk+ṣaḥ| nye lha dze+e tsho rtsa/ rde rte ḍi shāṭa/ me sgo baṃ paṃ paṃ| rna dhe rda baṃ haṃ/ r+sha shaṃ ṣe hra /na yi ram̐ 47lo/ rnga r+ghaṃ ge khaṃ ke/ k+ṣe haṃ sko/ gsod 'dod sdang 'dod khengs 'dod ma/ /rgyal 'dod rengs 'dod skyed⑧'dod ma/ /rol mo 'dod dang rgyan 'dod ma/ /bza' ba 'dod dang dri 'dod ma/ /gos 'dod 'khrig pa 'dod pa mos/ /'phrug 'dod kha chu spang 'dod ma/ /yan lag dri 'dod gar 'dod ma/ /gdan 'dod 'o thug 'dod ma dang / /stan la nyal 'dod rgyal srid 'dod/ / 'gyod 'dod 'chingasnye'adod tshig 'jam 'dod/ /skam 'dod spod 'dod reg 'dod ma/ /'gugs par 'dod dang 'ching bar 'dod/ /phur bus 'debs 'dod 'dod ma'o/ /yan lag thams cad 'phrug bzhed ma/ /dri chen dri chu gtong bzhed ma/ /sems can bgru 'dod rtsod 'dod ma/ /lhag ma za 'dod g.yul 'dod ma/ /bcings bzhed byis pa khro bzhed do/ /'dod pa log pa log ma ste/ /gsod log zhe sdang log sogs sbyarang/ /thabs kyang shugs kyis shes par bya/ /gzhan yang zad par bcu dgadze+e/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor phyi ru bsrung / /gza' bcu gsung gi phyi ru ste/ /bum pa klu dang rab gtum gyi/ /steng 'og lha yang rta babs la'o/ /r+shasusnyebe+e shurtse dhaza0dh+wa tu su bhā bād+ma kophodze+ehaṃ/ zhes bya bas lha'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i yan lag ste drug pa'o// //de nas ye shes gzhugasnyepa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag dgyes 7—1020

pa'i mchog /sras bzangs grogs dang 'khor dang rtsa lag bcas/ /lha dang lha mo'i tshogs ri mang pos bskor/ /sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa dgongs su gsol| /chahūṃ baṃ hoḥ nyi/ rang nyid⑥zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /rdo rje hūṃ dang ldan pa la/ /dzaḥlas rdo rje shugs khro bo/ /zhal bzhi phyag ni nyi shu drug /mdog rgyan phyag mtshan gtso bo bzhin/ /nag po ser po'i phyag lhag gnyis/ /glang chen pags pa gyon pa bzung / /rkang brgyad shing rta la chibs nas/ /chos dbyings bzhugs pa'i ye shes sems/ /lte bar rdo rje lcags kyu yis/ /bzung la nga ros spyan drang ngo / /hūṃ las shes rab mthar byed kyis/ /rdo rje thogs te gzhugasnyepar mdzad/ /baṃ las gshin rje mthar byed kyis/ /zhags pa thogs te gcig tu byas/ /hoḥlas pad+ma mthar byed kyis/ /dril bu thogs te mnyes paracog /nyi las bgegs ni mthar byed kyis/ /dbyug pas gnyis med ro mnyam byas/ /de nas sngon bzhin lha mo rnams/ /spros la mchod bstod mnyes par byas/ /hā s+thā : snu 1 hā/ mig dang rna ba⑧sna dang lce/ /lus yid go cha'i lha yis brgyan/ /de nas gnas gsum byen gyis brlab④/ /dpral bar zla steng cho ga gsum/ /sku yirdo rje yab yum bskyed/ /dbus dkar g.yas gnag g.yon dmar zhal/ /'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma g.yas / /ral gri dril bu rin chen g.yon/ /spros nas phyogs bcur gang bar bsam/ /sems can kun 'dul don mdzad nas/ /tshul 'dus mdun bzhugs gsol ba gdab/ /cha.a rnyi ji rmā⑥shā lngabadz+ra dha ra/ de3sa sku rigs lha mo rnams//shel bum bdud rtsis bgangakhub yis/ /bdag la dbang ni bskur bar bsam/ /thob nas dmakha ba'i zla ba la/ /sku pirdo rje zhugs nas ni/ /byin gyis brlabasnye7—1021

cing 'di skad brjod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi byed gsum gyi bdag /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /sku yi rdo rje mdzad du gsol—/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi bdag /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /sku yi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /dpral bar zla steng r+ṣadakar bsgo / /mgrin par nyi ma cho ga gsum—/ /gsung gi rdo rje yab yum bsgom/ /dbus dmar g.yas dgan g.yon gnag zhal/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ /rin chen dril bu 'khor lo g.yon—/ /spro bsdu sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab/ /cha.a rnyi⑥ji n+tu rmāsnyebadz+ra badzi na/ sngar bzhin dbang bskur mgrin gnas pas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje gsung 'chang ba/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /gsung gi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi bdag /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /gsung gi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /mgrin par nyi ma āḥdamar bsgom/ /snying gar sgra gcan cho ga gsum/ /thugs kyi rdo rje yab yum babyed/ /dbus gnag g.yas dmar g.yon dkar zhal/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma g.yas/ /dril bu rin chen ral gri g.yon/ /spro bsdu sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ a rnyi ji n+tu rmā sdetsit+ta badzi na/ sngar bzhin dbang bskur thugs kar bzhugs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyisnyedangos/ /deng bdag byen gyis brlabs nas su/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi byed gsum byi bdag /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /thugs kyi rdo 7—1022

badz+ra badhe brnya tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃgyi sgyu badz+ra karko ṭa ka badz+ra pad+mo ①bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kuṇ+ḍa ②la yoḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ skahūṃnyahā badz+ra bā su ki shaṃ kha bā la bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ r+shahūṃ hā badz+ra anan+ta ku la kau me kha la kar+sā ka yoḥ④tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ru rgyu hā badz+ra tak+ṣa ko ma hā pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nu pu ra yoḥnyiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pas nga rgyal gzung ⑤bar bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba'i ⑥yan lag ste brgyad pa'o// //sngar bshad lha mo bcu gnyis kyi/ /sngags brngod mchodashepa dbul bar bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ s+thāḥphaṭa/ sngon du mchod yon dbul ba ni/ chapra ba ra saṅka ram̐ ma hā ra smin pra dze+etīts+tsha sru hā/ de nas me tog lah+phusogs dbul/ rin chen gser gyi me tog sna tshogs dri mchog spos sogs mar me dang / /dril bu me long bla re dang ni sna tshogs 'bras bu ba dan gar dang rol mo dang / /sna tshogs mchod pa byas te gzhan rnams bcu po bdag nus ji ltar gsungs bzhin dbul/ /bdud rtsi sngar bzhin byen bshad pa/ /hūṃ byung rdo rje'i lce yis myang / /chabur+sā⑫ ya na maḥ/ oṃ dhasmra ⑪ya na maḥ/ ru saṃ : ya na maḥ/ cha swa bhā⑫be+e ka ka yā ya na maḥ/ oṃ dhan+d+ra ⑫kā yā ya na maḥ/ skye saṃ sgo ga kā yā ya na maḥ/ oṃ nismrachaṇa kā yā ya na maḥ/ longabyusto badzāsnyeya na maḥ/ chubatshwa na badzā ⑫ya na maḥ/ ma bāka ⑫badzā ya na maḥ/ chi kā ya badzā ya na maḥ/⑫ chi shākya mu na ye na maḥ/chisakā ⑪la tsakrā ya na maḥ/ chubabadz+ra sa tā ya⑩na maḥ/ de bzhin lha yi sngags rnams la/ /na maḥbatags la bdud rtsi myang / /srin lag dag gis mchod par bya/ /de nas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod/ /gang la thog mtha' dbus 7—1026

med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri ste ro dang ni/ /reg bya gzugs dang sems te rang bzhinasheskyes bu med cing rtsa lag thar par byed pa med//sa bon gsal ba'i dus su ma lus srid pa ru ni bde dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin mi mnga' ba/ /mtshan med mya ngan 'das par bya ba bral zhing yon tan bral ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dpe zla med cing skyes bu med cingasnyespros pa med/ /brtsegs pa la gnas rna ba sna dang kha mig mgo bo lag pa rkang pa rnam kun du/ /'byung ba'i mtha' dang 'byung bo'i mgon te gnas pa'i srid pa 'dzin zhing bya ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /rig pa dang po rnal 'byor gyis bgrod go 'phang mchog gi⑧bde ba dus 'khor la 'dud do/ /skyes bu mdzad nus pa yisnyegazugs can dri med glog 'dra gzi brjid nyi ma bcu gnyis pa//ye shes rdo rje 'od zer mchog gi go 'phang la gnas tsheg drag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum mgon ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzegs 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems tsam sngags kyi gzugs la sum cus yongs sukyibaskor ba bde dang sdug bsngal ngo bo la/ /mkhas pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs kyis nyid ⑥mdzad nyams myong gdug pa rnams la mi gdug pa/ /gang zhig gang du rang gi yid la las byas de yi 'bras bu de ru skyedakhyapar byed/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sna tshogs srid gsum byedalgemadzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig dang du ma ma yin gcig ste mnyam dang mi mnyam mnyam pa g.yas dang g.yon dang mdun dang rgyab/ /steng 'og kun nas dkar dang ljang gu kha dog chen po sna tshogs gzugs can thung ngu ring po 7—1027

ste| /ring thung su dang yon tan med pa yon tan dang bcas skyes bu bugamed skyes bu min/ /gang zhig kun3sa brtenadzobyas gcig pulha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud/ /gzhan yang bstod pa ci rigs bya/ /chubasarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pu dza badz+ra swa ṅgā ba āt+pa ko ②haṃ/ mchod bstod nga rgyal gzung bar bya'o//mchod pa dang bstod pa'i yan lag ste dgu pa'o// //dpal ldan rdo rje can ni lo dang zla ba dbye ba'i dus kyis ①dag par 'gyur ro mi dbang kye/ /sems kyi rnam pa nyi ma ma yin nyin bzhin dbang gis sna tshogs rnam par dag /du ba la sogs rlung rnams dag par rang snying pad+mar gtso bo'i 'khor lo gnas pa'o/ /drag po nyon mongasatwas ④bcas bdud kyi tshogs kyisalgebadud kyi gtso bo zhabs kyi 'og /dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor bu spyon pa dag ni de bzhin sku 4rdo rje rdzogs/ /bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis ni bum pa brgyad de rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang sems sogs/ /'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med rin chen 'byung gnas 'du shes dpag med 'od/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo can te ri bong stobs dang khrag dang dri chu dri chen dag /lha mo drug gi khams rnams kyi ste yul dang yul can gyi nizung chub sems dpa'awas dang bcas/ /stobs kyis0khro bo lnga ste gzhan rnams las kyi dbang po lnga pos so//tsā muṇ+ḍa la sogs pa thun tshar brgyad kyis ⑦pad+ma'i 'dab gnas nyi ma'i dus sbyor chu tshod rnams/ /lha min la sogs zla ba bcu gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab gnas rtsa dang dbugs kyi grangs rnams so/ /klu dang gtum mo gsang ba la ste rgyal po nyiyo 'gyur rtsa rnams rnam par dag /de bzhin 'dod pa la sogs des ni rang 7—1028

bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus kyi bya ba dag /skra yis⑥sgrub pa ma lus dur khrod sa gnas ba spu rnams kyis 'byung po'i tshogs rnams so/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bor bsgom par bya/ /de nas pad+ma rnam par sbyang ②/ /a yis pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /hūṃ gi yi ge rdo rje bcas/ /shes rab la ni mthun phyir ro/ /hūṃ rigs rang gi yab kyi rdo rje ni/ /rtse mo lnga pa rnam par bsgom/ /de dbus alas pad 'dab brgyad/ /de nas rdo rje pad+mar dgod/ /de nas rnal 'byor hūṃ phaṭa brjod/ /bsrub cing bde chen bsgom par bya/ /gtum mo lte bar rgyus klu bcom/ /ho yis ye shes dbus nas su/ /dri med glog 'dra gzi brjid 'bar/ /phung khams skye mched la sogs bsregs/ /ri bong spyi bo las 'bab pa/ /thig le'i gzugs te rdo rje can| /gnas bzhi rim bcas slar steng 'og /rgyan ldan me long gnas lta bur| /dus gsum ye shes rang 'byung⑧ba/ /gsung dag ye shes 'bar bar gcig /dung can rgyan chen gtum mor brjod/ /lte steng rigs ngan sgru tī'i ④sna| /srog lnga sna rtser yungs kar bzhugs / /srog 'gags stong nyid ma bcos dang / /de la yid gzhag bsgom par bya/ /oṃsabyu0ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kopho⑦haṃ/ rnam dag dran pa'i thig le dang / /phra mo bsgom pa'i yan lag ste bcu pa'o// //de nas nga rgyal gzung dze+ebar bya'o/ /bsgom pas skyo na sngags bzlas te//las la shis pa'i phreng ba bzung / /sngags kyi sgra spangs grogs po ru/ /gang 'gyur ba yi sngags de bzlas/ /chan mo badz+ra satā ya/ na mo burta bo dhi satwa bh+yaḥ/7—1029

'khor stobs kyisashede bzhin shog /bsod nams de yis sems can mi 'gyur mchog gi bde bar gyur cig de la 'dud/ /spyi bor rdo rje rtse lnga ru/ /gtso bo yab yum gshegs su gsol/ /thugs kar rtse dgu du ba sogs/ /dpral bar rtse mo bcu drug bsgom/ /rigs lnga yab yum bum par gshegs/ /mgrin par rtse mo sum cu gsum/ /sems dpa' sems ma sgo ba gshegs/ /lte bar rtse mo drug cu lnga/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol/ /gsang bar phyi yi sgo srung gshegs/ /bya ba'i rdo rje gdan bral sogs/ /las la klu dang rab gtum gshegs| /de nas lha yi rnam par ldang / /cho gas gnas rnams bsrung bar bya| /oṃsaza ta thā ga te a sneti badz+ra satwa haṃ do daṇ+ḍa da ma ko hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā—/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba'i yan lag ste bcu gcig pa'o// //sangs rgyas byang sems rgyud 'grel las/ /dbri bsnan khrum byas cho ga bsdus / /dge ba bla med byang chub bsngo/ /nongs gyur bzod pa mdzad du gsol—/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //7—1037

thabs zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā la tsa kra sā dha na nā mas/ bod skad du/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan srid gsum mgon po mchog tu bde ba'i bdag nyid rnam par rtog pa ma lus rab tu spangs/ /spro dang sdud pa'i rgyur gyur dngos dang dngos med mnyam pa'i ye shes skye dang 'jig pa rnam par bral/ /byedabo rnams kyi bsam pa rnams la dgongs te hūṃ yig la sogs las byung dkyil 'khor gyis ni bskor/ /bden pa dag la gnas pa'i mchog gi snying rje dang ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam pa'i dpal rmis bsdus rgyud du/ /sgrub thabs gsungs pa de bzhin du/ /'jig rten mgon gyis 'grel mdzad pa/ /de dag blangs te bri bar bya/ /bstan bcos brtsam pa'i nusasnyemed cing / /mdzad las dbyung bar ma nus kyang / /bsgom phyir 7—1043

sgrub thabs 'di byas pas/ /blo ldan rnams la bzod par gsol/ /dang por sngags pa mchog tu snying rje dang ldan pa gzhan gyishebya ba byed par 'dod pas/zhi ba la sogs pasnyelas kyi bye brag gis/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram la sogs pa'i gnas yid du 'ong ba'i bsam gtan gyi gnas su/ bla ma dang / rgyal ba dang /de'i sras rnams la gus pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpalasnyedang po'i sangs rgyas kyi bris sku la sogs pa bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa dang / maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa gzhung nas bshad pa ltar bshamasasnyel/ 'jam pa la sogs pa'i stan la bsdad la—/ shin tu gus pa dang ldan pa'i rang gi yid kyis phyag btsal ba la sogs pa rnams dang / phyi'i mchod pa rgya chen po rnamasasnyedang mnyam por gzhag pa ste/ji ltar gsungs pa ltar dag par byas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga'i ri lu sran ma tsa na ka tsam khar bcug nas/ lus dang / ngag dang / yid dang / ye shes rnam par dag par bya ba la sogs pa rnams bya ba ni/ de yang mchog gi snying rje dang bdud rtsi'i dbang gis sems la brlan pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dpal dri ma med par lha nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i don du lus dang ngag dang yid dang ye shes rnam par dag par gsungs pa/ cha.uhūṃ⑩hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa/ prarnyo pā lhakhya ka kā ya wāka byusto tshwa na badzā badzā thrasheta swa bhā bsnyeku ru ku ru skartse ⑨jo tā ya tā nā ni/ su bhā baṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod la/gtsug tor du baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug pa yongs su rdzogs pa lta bu sngags pas bsam mo/ /de nas gtsug tor nas brtsamasad+kute sen mo'i bar byu lus zal pags pa brjesachapa ltar bsam mo de ltar zhi ba dang rgyas pa dag la'o/ /dbang la sogs pa gzhung ches kyis dogs 7—1044

nas ma bris so/ /de nas yang de nyid gsungs pa'i/ mkhaswa bhā ba shurtseḥsarba dharmāḥ②swa bhā ba shustolhahaṃ/ zhes pas brngod do/ /de nas dpral bar ska yig yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med sku mdog dkar po/ mgrin par āXyig yongs su gyur pa las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog dmar po/ snying gar hūṃsnyeyig yongs su gyur pa las don yod grub pa sku mdog nag po/ lte bar hoḥyig yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog ser po/ gtsug tor du haṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyong pa sku mdog ljang gu/ gsang gnas su k+ṣaḥyig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po rnams dgod pa ni/ gsung bar 'gyur ba'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan rnams dang ldan pa'o/ /'di ni rdo rje'i zhal dag pa lasasnyerigs drug dgod pa'i nges pa'o/ /de nas lag pa dag pa'i sngags brjod do/ /oṃtram̐ḥ⑥sar+pā sta rā dza mā ra kle sharnya ka ra badz+ra tīkyāsheduḥkha ts+tsha da ma ma ka re ba sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di nyid kyis lag pa mnye ba ni lag pa dag pa'i nges pa'o/ /de nas a la sogs pa'i la'isnyemathar thug pa'i dbyangs yig bco lnga ni/ a i ṛ u lo/ a e ar oshemal/ha ya ra wa la rnams lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gi rtsa ba'i tshigs nas brtsams te/ mthe bo'i bar gyi tshigs rnams la nam mkha' la sogs pa dgod pa'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo'i steng gi tshigs nas brtsams te/ mthe'u chung gi tshigs kyi bar du khābyuyig la sogs pa dgod pa ni/ khā wā rā yā hā⑩/ā ma ā r+ṣa.ā / skṛ lcadzā zhilga rnams ni sa la sogs pa rim pa bzhin no| /de nas thal mo sbyar ba'i nang du zla ba dang nyi ma'i dbus su hūṃ yig kha dog sngon po bsam/ yang de nyid du gsungs pa ltar zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra 7—1045

gcan gyi sa bon dang ldan pas rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcings te/ gtsug tor nas brtsams nas/ rkang pa'i sen mo'i bar du bdag nyid la reg par bya zhing sngags brjod la/ khro.āḥhūṃ⑥hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥkākheya bāka tsit+ta tshwa ṭ+wā dhi pa ti badz+ra kā yasnyebāka tsit+ta dz+nyā nasnyebadzā kra ya swasnyebhā baṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de'i nga rgyal dang bcas pas—/ chasarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kā ya bāka tsit+ta swa bhā ba ā kopho⑥haṃ/ zhes pa ni lus dang ngag dang yid dang ye shes rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar rigs drug la dgod par byas nas/ de nas yan lag drug la dgod pa ni/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bo gnyis snying gar gtad de/ oṃ d+mo j-ished yā ya nasnyemaḥ/ zhes pa dang / mgrin par skahūṃ spyi wā ya swā hā⑨/ zhes pa'o/ /mgo bor oṃ hūṃ 0si ra se swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /gtsug tor la chi dzo shid+kukhā ma bo ṣaṭa—/ ces pa'o/ /yan lag thams cad la r+sha: ka ba tsā ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis kyis lus thams cad la reg par bya'o/ / mig la oṃ rgyu ṣ+pe tāsnyeya wa ṣaṭa/ ces pas so/ /mig la skyi rīḥ.aṭ+wā ya phaṭa/ ces pas phyogs thams cad du mthe bong dang mdzub mos se gol gtogs shing dge ba'i bya ba la g.yon gyis/ mi dge ba'i bya ba la g.yas pas dgod do/ /de nas cha sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya tri wachasi raḥshi kha ka ba tsa ṣ+pe tra astu badz+ra ṣa hūṃ ga swa bhā ba ā kolha⑫haṃ/ zhes pa ni yan lag drug la dgod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas srung 'khor gyi don du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dang por 'khor lo bzhi bsgom pa ni/ de nas de nyid du gsungs pa ltar srung ba'i 'khor lo rnam par bsam par bya ba'i phyir/ de yang dang por yam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'og dang steng du hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje kha sbyor 7—1046

ro| /de nas ram̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dang / waṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor dang / lo yig yongs su gyur pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rim pa bzhin du/ kha dog nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ser po rnams kyi 'og dang steng du hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rang rang gi kha dog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gnyis⑥dang bcas pa rnams| gzhu'i dbyibs dang / gru gsum dang / rlum po dang / gru bzhi'i rnam pa la rlungasnyeyab dang bkra shis dngasnyepad+ma dang / 'khor lo rnams kyisasnyespras pa go bar bya'o/ /de nas yang de nyid du gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor gzhi gcig tu gyur pa snga dro'i grib ma'i mtshams dang / grong khyer gyi mtshalas dang / phyi rol du nam mkha' dang sa gzhi 'dus par snang ba'i mtshalas su ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor gzhi gcig tu gyur pa khru bzhi brgyasnyedang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang bsgom pa dang / de ltar ra ba gsum bsgom pa dang /de ltar grong khyer srung ba'i don du grong khyer gyi mtshalas su ra ba lnga bsgom par bya ba dang / de ltar 'og thams cad du rdo rje'i mdung dang / steng du mda'i dra ba shin tu rno ba dang / dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi rnams grong khyer gyi mtshams su bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma'am/ 'khor lo khru bcu gnyis pa mu khyud dang bcas pa 'dab ma brgyad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /dbus kyi lte ba khru bzhi dang ldan pa'ishenyi ma dang bcas pa'i gdan no/ /'on kyang 'di'i bye brag ni hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / cha yig yongs su gyur pa las sam/ rgyusheyig yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang dang / baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa'am/ asheyig yongs su gyur pa las 7byed1047

pad+ma dang / ram̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las —nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms zhes bya'o| /de ltar ra ba la sogs pa bsgoms nas/ yang de nyid du gsungs pa ltar sngags kyi bye brag tu gyur pa 'di lta ste/ cha.āḥ hūṃ raḥ badz+ra tsan+d+ra srur+ya rā hu kā la asnesheya/ kākhuya bāka dzisto tshwa na badz+rasnyebadz+ra pā kā rā nasnyeku ru ku ru swā hā/zhes pa ni ra ba'i sngags so/ /ma hūṃsnyebi shā kā ya badz+ra ku ṭā gā ram̐ ku ru ku ru swā hā/zhes pa ni gzhal yas khang gi sngags so/ /mkhapaḥbi shwa badz+ra pad+mesum̐ku ru ku ru swā hā/zhes pa ni pad+ma'i sngags so/ /char badz+ra srut+yā sa rna ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa ni nyi ma'i gdan gyi sngags so/ /de nas de'i steng du e yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ ka yig la sogs pa gsal byed 'dus pa'i bdag nyid las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin no/ /yang de nyid du gsungs pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid g.yon dang g.yas su bskor ba/ dbyangs yig sum cu āḥ⑧tsheg drag dang klad kor dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni/ a i ṛ u lo 'di rnams ni dang po lnga bsdus pa'o/ /de yang yon tan gyi dbye bas a e ar wīmakha rnams ni gnyis pa lnga rnams bsdus pa'o/ /de nas rkyen gyis gyur pa ha ya ra wa la rnams ni gsum pa'i bsdus pa lnga'o/ /bsdus pa bco lnga'i mthar thig le ni i yig ste/ bcu drug pa ste / 'di rnams ni g.yon skor gyis so/ /de nas g.yas skor gyis nag po'i phyogs kyi dang po la sogs pa dgod pa/ khā wā rā yā hā/ ya ma sgo i smra shā sprubyudzā zhinayanade ltar bco lnga dang gnam stong gi mthar tsheg drag ni t+paste/ 'di ni de ltar dbyangs yig bcu drug ces bya'o/ /de nas de'i steng du ā yig dmar po yongs 7—1048

su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin du bu mo'i bdag nyid bsam mo/ /yang de nyid du gsungs pa'i ka yig la sogs pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed bzhi bcu'i bdag nyid de yang / ha ya ra wa la rnams dang / sde tshan drug ste sum cu rtsa lnga dang / de nyid kyis brjod pa'ishel wa ya 73 rnams bzung ste/ l+la lnga ṇ+ḍasnye l+la sbra hra be+e t+ta ma sgo ṣ+ṭha sh+ka rngo/t+ta sgra drwa — n+da/ za thra sba snya sma/ zu ṣ+ṭha ṇ+ḍa ṇ+ḍa/ rtso ts+tsha dz+dza rngo snye/ k+ka khru ga ca ja rnams te/ bzhi bcu tham pa sa la sogs pa'i dbye bas g.yas skorashegyis so/ /de ltar g.yon skor gyis/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇasnyerte ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ṅka sha ṣa tha sa hasheya ra wa la rte ḍa ya wa la ste/ de ltar bzhi bcu ste gsal byed brgyad cu zhes so/ /de nas de dag gi dbus su hūṃ yig sngon po las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtogashepa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gnasasnyegasum po gcig tu 'dres pa la rnyiḥ⑨yig gis spras pa las ⑩bya ba sgrub ⑪pa'i ye shes kyi rtebadag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas lus kyi yan lag thams cad rdzogs pa haṃ yig gi bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin 'og nas phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs su 'chad pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ste/ 'on kyang phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa phyag lhag ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa la kha dog ser po zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig ma spyan gsum ma/ phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa'i sna tshogs yum rmis mgul nas 'ag pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/stag gi sham thabs spyangs pa/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs su bdag nyid 7—1049
