yan lag rnams la dgod pa ni dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po la oṃ yig dgod do/ /mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po la āḥyig dgod do//snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor nag po la hūṃ yig dgod do/ /lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor ser po la ho yig dgod do/ /gtsug tor dang gsang bar rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par shes pa dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ljang gu dang sngon po la haṃ k+ṣaḥdagod do/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor drug bsgoms la dkyil 'khor de rnams nyid la rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du sa bon de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnams te/ rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang / rtse mo sum cu so gsum pa pashedang / rtse mo dgu pa dang / rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa dang / rtse mo lnga pa dang / yang rtse mo sum cu soshegasum pa zhes pa ste/ rdo rje rnams kyang so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog dang 'dra bar ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshad ltar bsgom par bya ste/ yang de nyid nas gsungs pa lhar rdo rje nor bu rnam par dag pa sor gcig pa bsgom par bya'o/ /byi gtsug gi 'khor lo rnam par dag pa sor gnyis pa'o| /dpral ba'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa sor bzhi pa'o/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa sor lnga pa'o/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa sor brgyad pa'o/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa sor dgu pa'o/ /gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo rnam par dag pa sor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de nas g.yon gyi dpung mgo'i tshigs la nga ji dz+dza ngu dṛ rnga / gha ghi 1 ku 1 hūṃ/ ga gi sngo gu bla gekha khi dza khu khro khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ ku kṛ ke/ zhes pas nam mkha' la sogs pa ste/thung ngu drug gi dbye ba dang / ka'i sde tshan yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dpung mgo g.yas pa'i tshigs la/ kluḥ7—1053

spyo kyi spyo l+lī l+lī/ṣ+ṭhaḥ①1 k+ṣu spyo khri skyi/gluḥk+ṣ-i byu 1 l+lī r+sā/ 1ཿspyomai/bye: :/ rngatsho: byu : ji ji / zhes pa ni sa la sogs pa ste ring po drug gi da ba dang /kluḥ'i sde tshan yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu so gcig pa bsam mo/ /de ltar las kyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis rnams la rdo rje bsgom par bya ste/ de yang de nyid du gsungs pa ltar gru mo g.yon pa la tsa'i sde tshan thung ngu'i bdag nyid do/ /gru mo g.yas pa la ring po'i bdag nyid do/ /de ltar g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma'i tshigs la ṭa'i sde tshan thung ngu rnams so/ /g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma'i tshigs la ring po rnams so/ /g.yon gyi dpyi mgo'i tshigs la pa'i sde tshan thung ngu rnams so/ /g.yas kyi dpyi mgo'i tshigs la ring po rnams so/ /pus mo g.yon pa'i tshigs la ta'i sde tshan thung ngu rnams so/ /pus mo g.yas pa'i tshigs la ring po rnams so/ /long bu g.yon pa'i tshigs la sa'i sde tshan thung ngu rnams kyi rang bzhin no/ /long bu g.yas pa'i tshigs la ring po'i bdag nyid do zhes pa ni tshigs rnams la rdo rje dgod pa'i cho ga'o/ /rdo rje de rnams kyang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ de nyid kyis bsgom par bya'o/ /de rnamasasherim pa de bzhin bya ba'i 'khor lo rnams la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas brtsams te/ rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams la thung ngu drug gi dbye bas ka'i sde tshan nga la sogs pa drug drug las byung ba'i rtse mo bdun bdun dang ldan pa'i rdo rje lnga bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar g.yas kyi mthe bo'i tshigs steng ma nas brtsams te/tshigs lnga la ring po drug dang ldan pa'i krā la sogs pa drug drug yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnams so/ /g.yon gyi sor mo'i dbus kyi tshigs rnamasasnyel tsa' sde tshan thung ngu'i bdag nyid las rdo rje rnams so/ /g.yon gyi sor mo'i dbus kyi 7—1054

tshigs rnams la ring po'i bdag nyid rnams lasaspaso/ /g.yon gyi sor mo'i steng gi tshigs la ṭa'i sde tshan thung ngu'i bdag nyid rnams so/ /g.yas kyi sor mo'i rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams la ring po'i bdag nyid las so/ /rkang pa g.yon gyi sor mo'i tshigs rnams la snga ma ltar pa'i sde tshan thung ngu rnams kyisnyebadag nyid las so/ /rkang pa g.yas pa'i tshigs rnams la snga ma ltar ring po rnams kyi bdag nyid las so//de nas g.yon pa'i tshigs rnams la ②snga ma ltar ta'i sde tshan thung ngu rnams kyi bdag nyid las so/ /g.yas pa la ring po'i bdag nyid las so/ /de ltar g.yon pa'i tshigs rnams la sa'i sde tshan thung ngu'i bdag nyid rnams las so/ /g.yas pa'i tshigs rnamasakhul ring po'i bdag nyid las rdo rje rnams te/ rim pa bzhin sde tshan rnams yongs su dag pa lasarkuljang gu dang / nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ser po'i kha dog rnams/ so so'i tshigs kyi tshad kyis so/ /de nas rna ba la sogs parasprerdo rje dgod pa ni/ de nyid las gsungs pa ltar/ rna ba dag tu a k+ṣiṃdag las rdo rje rtse gsum pa bsgom par bya'o//sna bug dag tu e ma dag las so/ /mig dag tu ar ā dag las so/ /lce dang lce chungashedag la wīchadag las so/ /rdo rje dang gsang ba dag la al ā dag las so/ /yid dang khya ba 'dzag pa'i rtsa dag la e aḥdag las te/ 'di rnams kyang rim pa ji lta ba bzhin kha dog gi dbye ba dang ldan par sor gcig gi tshad kyis so/ /yang de nyid du gsungs pa ltar rna ba la sogs parasnyerdo rje sor gcig pa zhes pas so/ /de nas gtsug tor la sogs pa rnams la rdo rje dgod pa ni/ de yang de nyid las gsungs pa ltar gtsug tor dang mgo bo dag la ha hā dag las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /lce dang rkan dag la ya yā dag las rdo rje rtse lnga 7—1055

pa'o| /lag mthil dag la ra rā dag las so/ /rkang mthil dag la wa wā dag las so/ /'phongs kyi g.yas g.yon dgashel khā dag las so/ /de ltar rdo rje'i lus su bdag nyid bsgom par bya ba ni/ de rnams kyi gtsug tor la sogs pa rnam par dag parasnyegasungs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas bdud kyi tshogs bsreg pa ni/ de yang de nyid nas gsungs pa ltar de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje 'bar bas phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud kyi tshogs sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe ba rnams bsregs nas/ steng du ljang gu 'bar ba dang / 'og tu sngon po 'bar ba dang / shar dang shar lhor nag po 'bar ba dang / lho dang bden bral du dmar po 'bar ba dang / byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po 'bar ba dang / nub dang rlungasnyedu ser po 'bar ba dang zhes so/ /bdud kyi tshogs bsregasnyepa'i sngags brjod par bya ste/ ska.ā hūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥhraḥhraḥhraḥhraḥraḥraḥraḥraḥbadz+ra a na la sarba ā ba ra ṇa dharmā pra la yaspreste bhā ba sarba mā ra yashekā yi ka bisna bi nā ya kā dri rmā da sha di ka ga tā rmā kra ya bā ka byu snyeni/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhasmi ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃshephaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa ni bdud rnams rnam par bsregad+kupa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas lus dang ngag dang yid kyi cho gad+kurnam par dag pa gzhal yas khang dang / ra ba gsum dang / ra ba lnga rnams kyi nang dang / phyi rol bsrung ba'i don du/ khro bo la sogs pa rnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin spro bar bya'o/ /de nas yang de nyid nas gsungs pa ltar dang por rdo rje shugs su bdag nyid bsgoms la/ de nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ha ya ra wa la rnams brtsegs pa'i gzugs su bsam mo—/ /de'i steng du ha las byung ba'i 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyag rgya dang mtshan 7byed1056

ma dang zhal rnams dang ldan pa'i sku mdog ljang gu sna bug g.yon pa nas spros te/gtso bo'i dbu'i steng du gzhal yas khang gi nang du zla ba'am nyi ma'i steng du gtsug tor can g.yas brkyang du bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar hasheyig ring po las byung ba'i gnod mdzes rgyal po kha dog sngon po sna bug g.yas nas bton nas rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng du nyi ma'am zla ba la dgod do/ /de lhar yasheyig las byung ba'i bgegs mthar byed kha dog nag po/ sna bug g.yon pashenas byung nas shar phyogs su zla ba 'am nyi ma la dgod par bya'o/ /de ltar ya yigasnyeyongs su rdzogs pa'i dbyug sngon can kha dog nag po sna bug g.yas nas bton te/ me mtshams su nyi ma'am zla ba la dgod do/ /ṛsnyeyig las byung ba'i shes rab mthar byed sku mdog dmar po/ mig g.yon nas bton nas lho phyogs su zla ba'am nyi ma la dgod do/ /de ltar dzā yig las yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar po/ mig g.yas nas bton te bden bral du nyi ma 'am zla ba la dgod par bya'o/ /de ltar lu yig las yongs su rdzogs pa'i pad+ma mthar byed dkar po lce las bton te/ byang du zla ba'am nyi ma la dgod do/ /nyukyiyig las yongs su rdzogs pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po dri chu'i lam nas bton te/dbang ldan gyi mtshalas su zla ba'am nyi ma la dgod do/ /lo yig las yongs su rdzogs pa'i gshin rje mthar byed ser po chu min gyi lam nas bton te/ nub phyogs su zla ba'am nyi ma la dgod do/ /de ltar līsheyig las yongs su rdzogs pa'i stobs po che ser po rdo rje gtsug torasnyenas bton te/ rlung gi mtshalas su zla ba 'am nyi ma la dgod par bya'o/ /yang na bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang nas thams cad nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo dgod pa'o//7—1057

de nas gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du zad par nam mkha' la sogs pa spro ba ste/de yang de nyid las gsungs pa ltar thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la nga nya ṇa ma na rnams brtsegs pa'i gzugs su⑥bsgoms la/ nga ṭ+wā lasasnyeyongs su rdzogs pa'i zad par nam mkha' sngon du bshad pa'i sgo rnams nas bton te/gzhal yas khang gi steng dang gnod mdzes rgyal po'i 'og dgasnyetu stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar nyi tī dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i zad par rlung shar dang me mabyedas su rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar rje 1 ④dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i zad par me lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar mu zu dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i zad par chu byang dang dbang ldan gyi mabyedas su chu'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom par bya'o—/ /de ltar dṛ 1 sgedag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i zad par rlung shar dang me mabyedas su sa'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar gha dzha rte bha dhakyi rnams su brtsegs pa'i yi ge bsgoms la/ de rnams las phyogs skyong bcu spro ba ni—/ gha ghā dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshangs pa dang da 'jug /ljang gu dang sngon po/ ngang pa dang bya khyung la gnas pa/ ra ba la phyogs pa/ ⑦steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu khyab 'jug go/ /de nas rnyi rnyi dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i bden bral dang rlung lha dag /kha dog nag po/ yi dwags dang ri dwags la gnas pa/ shar dang me mabyedas su'o/ /de ltar lho dang bden bral du/dzo 1 las yongs su rdzogs pa'i gshin rje dang me lha/ kha dog dmar po ma he dang lug la gnas pa'o/ /de ltar byang dang dbang ldan du bhu zla dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgya mtsho dngashebade byed/ kha dog dkar po chu srin dang khyu mchog 7—1058

la gnas pa'o/ /de ltar nub phyogs⑥dang rlung du : 1 dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang po dang gnod sbyin/ kha dog ser po/ glang po che dang bsnyem na la gnas pa'o/ /de lhar phyogs skyong rnams ra ba'i nang du bsgos par bya'o//de nas ra ba bsrung ba'i don du gza' rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ ga dza ḍa ba da rnams brtsegs pa'i tshul du gnas pa las/ ga gā dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgra gcan dang dus me/stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ ra ba gsum la phyogs pa steng dang 'og tu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /de ltar dzi dzī dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba dang nyi masherlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ shar dang me mtshalas su dgod do//j-i dz+wa dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i gza' lag dang bkra shis/ me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ lho dang bden bral du dgod do/ /de ltar bu byu dag las yongs susnyerdzogs pa'i pa wa sangs dang phur bu chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/byang dang dbang ldan dag tu'o/ /de ltar dṛ rja dag las yongs su dag pa'i mjug rings dang spen pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa nub dang rlung dag tu ste/ 'di rnams ni ra ba'i phyi rol du bsrung ba'i don du gza'i tshogs rnams bsgom pa'o/ /de nas ra ba lnga bsrung bar bya ba'i don du klu'i rgyal po rnams spro bar bya ste/ sngon du gsungs pa ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la kha tsha ṭha pha tha rnams brtsegs pa'i tshul du bsams nas/ kha khā dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba/ ra ba lnga la phyogs pa stengasnye'og nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /de ltar tshi ṭī dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i ka rko ṭa dang pad+ma dag /shar dang me mtshalas su rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o//7—1059

de ltar ji 1 dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i chu bdag dang dung skyong / lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /de ltarashephu phu dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dga' bo dang rigs ldan/ byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /de ltar dṛ ṭ+wā dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i pad+ma chen po dang 'jog po nub dang rlung dag tu sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /de nas ra ba lnga'i phyi rol du bsrung ba'i don du 'byung po lha ma yin rnams bsgom par bya ste/ sngon du gsungs pa ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ka tsa ṭa pa ta rnams brtsegs pa'i tshul du bsam pa ste/ de rnamasasnyekyang ra ba la phyogs pa steng dang 'og tu ka kā dag las yongs su dgashepa'i ro langs dang / ka sha mān+d+ra ④nam mkha' dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /de ltar tsiṭī dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i ki na ra gasnyedang / ki pu ru ṣa khyi dang bya rog gi gdong can⑥/shar dang mer rlung gi dkyil 'khor la dgod do/ /de ltar ṭi ṭī dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'ishedri za dang 'byung po/ phag pa dang bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor dgasnyel dgod do/ /de ltar pu pu dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'ishesrin po dang yi dwags/ stag dang 'ug pa'i gdong can byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor la dgod do/ /de ltarashā dz+nyā dag las yongs su rdzogs pa'i brjed byed ce spyang gi gdong pa canabyudang / bya khyung gi gdong can/ nub dang rlung du sa'i dkyil 'khor dag la dgod do/ /de rnams thams cad shes rab dang ldan pa'o/ /yang de nyid du gsungs pa ltar/ye shes dang nam mkha' dang / rlung dang / me dang / chu dang / sa rnams khams drug las byung ba'i khro bo'i rgyal po rnams dang / gzugs med 7—1060

dang / gzugs dang / phyogs bcu skyong ba dang / gza' rnams dang / klu rnams dang 'byung po rnams sde tshan drug gi bdag nyid srung zhing skyong ba/ phyi dang nang rnams su kha sbyor du gnas pa rnal 'byor pas dgod do/ /de nas bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa rnams lanyegadab par bya ba ni/ de yang de nyid du gsungs pa ltar de las gzhan pa bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus khug cig /rdo rje zhags pas chings shig /khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje phur bu rtse mo mdung gi rnam pa rnams gnas bcur sdang bakhubatab par bsam mo/ /sngags rnams kha dog lnga dang ldan pa ste/ oṃ.āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra kri la ya kā ya bāka byustosnyetshwa na a dhi pa te ṣa ṭa mu kha ṣaṭa bhu dza ṣaṭa sarba tsa ra ṇa sarba be+esna bi nā ya kā di duṣ+ṭa rna kā ya bāka byusto tshwa ṭ+wā ni tī la yasnyehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa ni gdab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ smṛ badz+ra muṅga ra/mā rā dri ram̐ shi ra si ka— z-i da ye/ ṭ+wā p+ta gu bya man tesnyebadz+ra tī la ya kran yasako ṭa yā ko ṭa ya/ k+ṣe spyo k+ṣi 4 :41 hūṃ hūṃ41 : k+ṣe hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ces pa ni gdung ba'i sngags so/ /de nas nga rgyal byas nas phur bu rnams bsrung ba'i don du/ khro bo bcu la bka' bsgo ba ni/ de'i don du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal por gsungs pa/ srid pa gsum gyi gnas su dbyug sngon can gyis bdud rnams ma lus rdung bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /dus mtha'i nyi ma dang mtshungs khro bo mi g.yo ba yis 'ching ste phur 'debs shin tu brtson 'grus so/ ḍak+kisashede yi brtson 'grus 'jig rten sa stengashegyur par gnod mdzes rgyal pos nges par byed pa'o/ /gtsug tor can gyis de yi rdzu 'phrul 'jig ste nges par khro bo'i lha mo rnams kyisashesnga ma bzhin du'o/ /zhes pas so/ /7—1061

pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba rnal 'byor pas bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i 'od zer gyis thog ma med pa'i sngon du gsungs ①pa'i dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ nam mkha'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/ rnal 'byor pas mchod cing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi tshig rab tu bsdus par bya ba'i phyir dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa rjes su bsgrub pa'i phyir phyag btsal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas rnams dang rgyal sras khro bo phyogs skyong klu rnams dang ni de rnams kyi/ /lha mo'i tshogs dang rgyas 'debs bdag dang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig brjod par gyur pa'i zhal gyisnyegrangs rnams g.yas skor gyis ni go bya ste/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyisnyertsa ba'i phyag na chu skyes dang ni rang mtshan go bar bya/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dus me 'phrog byed zhal gcig kha dog dkar/ /rig byed phyag na rtse gsum ḍa ma ru dang dpal gyi dung dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rtse mo can gyi mig ldan g.yon du gan rkyal bsnyel ba gnas te g.yas su dran pa nyid/ /kha dog dmar po mda'asnyelnga lcags kyu gzhu dang zhags pa rnams dang bcas pa de dag la/ /go rīsnyedaga' byed ma yis bzung ba dkar dang dmarasheba'i g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis snying gar mnan/ /sa bon hūṃ yig dang ni rdo rje dag las byung ba'i ral pa'i thor tshugs sngon po can/ /mi bskyong pa ste zhal gyi pad+ma sprin dang pa lashe'od ldan ri bong can rnams rgya mtsho mtshungs/ /dbus dang g.yas dang g.yon rnams sngon po dmar po dkar po rnams dang ldan pa'i mgrin gsum pa//g.yon gyi dpung pa'i rim bzhin dkar min dmar dang dkar ba rnams te g.yas pa'i dpung pa gsum/ /de bzhin yin te bcom ldan 'das kyis lag ngarashezung 7—1063

gsum phyag gi mgo bo bzhi pa gsum/ /sor mo rnams ni gser dang zla bshenyi ma sprin dang ljang gu mtheb sogs rim pa bzhin/ /de rnams rtse mo dbus dang rtsa ba rnams kyi tshigs ni sprin dang nyi ma thig le rnams/ /mi mgo mkha po lnga rnams kha dog lnga dang ldan pas nyid kyi dbu la brgyan/ /mgrin la mgul rgyan nyid dang sked la ska rags rna rgyan gyis ni rna ba la/ /lag pa dag la yid 'ong lag gdub rkang pa dag la rkang gdub mdzes pas spras/ /dbu la dar dpyangs sku la thugs kar mchod phyir thogs pa rnams kyis brgyan/ /so so'i zhal rnams spyan gsum dang ldan nor bu rdo rje zla ba dngaphu/ /dbu nyid la ste mi mgo brgya yi phreng ba mgo 'dzin la gnas/ /stag gi sham thabs dang ldan rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug /mda' dang lcags kyu cang te'u thod pa 'khor lo dung rnams dang ni/ /dbyug pa dgra sta g.yas min rnams te dril bu phub chung dag ste / /kha ṭī ga dang dung dngasum̐thod pa mda' gnas zhags pa rin chen/ /chu skyes dang ni dung dang mchog gi me long lcags sgog rnams dngasnye/ /rigasasnyebyed gdod ldan mgo bo rnams kyi phyag nyid rnams la mtshan pa⑦/ /phre yig gri gug las byung bud med gzugs can sku mdog ser mo/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las gzhan bzhugs pas rab tu 'ag pa/ /phyag rgya dang ldan klu yi phyag gis pad+ma sna tshogs yum byi/ /dbu la dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' cod pan la gnas/ /gri gug lcags kyu cang te'u phreng ba rnams ni rim pa bzhin du/ /thod pa zhags pa chu skyes rin chen rnams ni phyag gis 'dzin ma/ /gser dang zla ba dang ni sprin dang nyi ma rnams dang ldan pa'i/ /gang zhig zhal bzhi rnams nilgeme yi spyan dang rab tu ldan ma/ /i yig rdo rje dag las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' gang zhig 7—1064

ye shes rnam dag pa/ /sngo dang nyi ma zla ba'i zhal gsum spyan dgu rdo rje 'dug stangs gnas pa'i mnga' bdag nyid/ /rdo rje sngon po gri gug dgra sta dril bu thod pa⑥tshangs mgo rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ /phyag drug la yinakhural pa dang ldan sku la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma yis 'ag/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mas 'ag pa'i rnam par shes pa dag pa'i bdag nyid mi bskyong ljang / /a dang rdo rje dag las byung ba'i mi bskyong rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa dang ni mtshungs/ /mi bskyod rnam pa dang mtshungs k+ṣiṃdang gri gug las byung rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma—/ /mas③dang gri gug las byung shes rab pha rol phyin ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa bzhin/ /dag pa'i lus la sna tshogs pa'i/ /yum gyis 'ag pa 'gro ba'i yab/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo gang / /'khor lo'i dbus gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen gtsug ma dang mtshungs pa'i/ /nag mo 'bar ba la sogs pa/ /brgyad rnams zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ /mnga' bdag pad 'dab rnams la gnas/ /a yig rnams kyi gsang ba'i thod pa las byung dpal nyid nag mo 'bar ma mdun du gnas/ /na bza' nag mo sprin dang nyi ma gser dang ri bong can gyi zhal rnams rim pa bzhin/ /bdug spos dang ni tsan+dan gur gum gla rtsi ga pur dang bcas pad+ma'i sgod rnams dang / /dril bu pad+ma lha shing me tog phreng bsnyegang ba de nyid rnams la bstod/ /g.yas su mkhyeyig dang ni mar me dag las byung ba'i dmar rgos/ /'bar ma nyi ma ser dang dkar dang nag po'i zhal dang ldan ma/ /phyag na mar me mu tig phreng ba cod pan lag gdub rnams dang / /gos dang ska rags rna rgyan rkang gdub rnams dang ldan la phyag 'tshal| /g.yon du i yig dang ni lha bshos las byung ba'i/ /dkar mo 'bar 7byed1066

ma dkar nag dmar ser zhal dang ldan/ /'o ma chu dang sman dang chang dang ro rnams dang / /bdud rtsi 'bras bu zan snod phyag ldan nyid la 'dud/ /chu bdag tu ni ā yig dag las byung ba'i sor mo 'bar ma/ /gser dang zla ba bung ba dang ni drod byed rnams dang ldan ma/ /dung dang gling bu dang ni nor bu cang te'u pi wang dang ni/ /rnga dang mchog gi 'khar rnga zangs dung phyag na bsnams la phyag 'tshal/ /ha hā haṃ haḥrnams las byung ba'i ser dang dkar dang dmar dang bung ba'i kha dog ldan/ /rlung dang dbang ldan srin po me yi 'dab ma rnams la lha mo rnams te mar me ma/ /me khyer ma dang smig rgyu ma ste dpal gyi du ba ma yi phyag rnams ma lus pas/ /rim bzhin rnga yab 'dzin ma rang rang mdog mtshungs snga ma las byung rnams lasnyephyag 'tshal lo/ /rtse mo can dang srin po dbang ldan rlung mtshalas rnams la gnas pa/ /hūṃsnyeyig las byung nor bu dang ni ā yig las byung gaṇ+ḍi/ /ru yig las byung chu spyod hoḥyig las byung dpag bsam shing rnams/ /byung ba'i nyi ma zla bsnyegaser mchog 'od ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /spyan dgu pad dkar nyi ma la/ /thams cad rdo rje'i 'dug stangs bzhugs/ /de rnams ral pa'i cod pan can/ /dbang po a yig ral gri dag las byung ba'i don yod grub pa/ /rlung dang 'du byed rang bzhin bung ba nyi ma dkar ba'i zhal ldan/ /ral gri dang ni gri gug rtse gsum phub chung thod pa dang ni/ /kha ṭī ga rnams bsnams pa'i dkar min spyan gsum ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /g.yas su ṛ yig rin chen las byung dpal ldan rin chen 'byung ldan/ /dmar po me dang tshor ba'i rang bzhin nyi ma zla ba bung ba'i/ /zhal ldan bdag gi mi yi mnga' bdag mda' dang lcags 7byed1066

kyu cang te'u/ /gzhu dang rin chen zhags pa phyag na bsnams pa rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /g.yon du u yig pad+ma las byung 'od dpag med ni dkar po/ /chu dang 'du shes rang bzhin bdud rtsi 'od 'phro sprin dang nyi zhal/ /dpal ldan gos dkar mo yis spras pa tho ba mdung thung rtse gsum/ /chu skyes dkar po me long phreng ba rnams 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyab tu lo yig 'khor lo dag las byung ba'i rnam snang ser po/ /sa dang gzugs kyi rang bzhin gser dang zla ba nag po'i zhal ldan/ /sgol mas spras pa'i 'khor lo dang ni dbyug pa rdo rje bsnams dang / /dpal gyi dung dang lcags sgog dril bu phyag na 'dzin pakhul bstod| /sangs rgyas rnams mtshungs btsun mo rnams/ /pad+ma dmar dang zla ba la—/ /thams cad pad+ma'i 'dug stangs bzhugs/ /kun la rin chen cod pan bsam—/ /shāsheyig 'khor lo dag las byung ba'i spyan ma sa khams rang bzhin/ /rnam par snang mdzad mtshungs dang don grub dang bcas rlung mtshams gnas dang//spru yig pad+ma las byung bdag gi masnyeste chu khams rang bzhin/ /'od dpag med mtshungs rin 'byung dang bcas dbang ldan gnas la phyag 'tshal/ / dzā yig dang ni rin chen dag las byung ba'i gos dkar mo ste/ /me khams rang bzhin rin 'byung dang mtshungs bden bral la gnas pa dang / /ṣ+kayig ral gri las byung ba yi sgol ma rlung khams rang bzhin/ /don grub dang mtshungs rnam snang dang bcas me mtshalas gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /haṃ yig las byung rgyal ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan dpal ldan thugs kyi 'khor lo yi/ /shar gyi sgo ru khro bo'i gdan gyi phyi ru pad+ma nyid la dgod par bya ba ste/ /de ltar nyi yig las byung gti mug rdo rje'i g.yas su dgod de de bzhin rin chen sogs/ /g.yas 7—1067

dgod n+d+ra hu stsoshelas byung bum pa de rnams la ri phyag 'tshal lo/ / 1 hūṃ spyo tīsnyelas byung bum pa spyan sogs g.yas su rim bzhin dgod / /ha yig las byung rnam rgyal bum pa sgo gzhan gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ji bzhin rgyal sras rnams/ /'on kyang rin chen cod pan ldan/ /lha mo de bzhin lha mo rnams//de ltar rim bzhin rab tu gnas/ /a yig rdo rje dag las byung ba'i dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje thugs kar rdo rje nyid/ /sngon po bzung ba rna ba'i dbang po'i bdag nyid mnga' bdag mi bskyong pa dang mtshungs pa ste/ /ljang gu lho sgo'i g.yon gyi rtsig pa'i drung du de yi gdan dang mtshungs par bzhugs pa la/ /spyi bo sa la reg ste de yi zhabs la shin tu dga' bas rab tu phyag 'tshal lo iphuyig ral gri dag las byung ba'i nam mkha'i snying po don grub dang mtshungs sna nyid kyi—/ /dbang po'i rang bzhin dpal gyi rdo rje ma bcas shar sgo'i g.yas na bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal/ /ar yig rin chen las byung sa yi snying po rin chen 'byung ldanasnyedang mtshungs sku mdog dmar po nyid/ /mig gi dbang po'i rang bzhin dpal ldan gzugs kyi rdo rje mar bcas lho sgo'i g.yasarnyaganas dang / /chayig pa dbyung 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med mtshungs ro rdo rjer/ /bcas dang lce dbang rang bzhin byang sgo'i g.yas su gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /al yig 'khor lo las byung sgrib pa rnam sel mdzes pa'i gser dang mtshungs pa yi| /lus kyi dbang po'i rang bzhin dpal ldan rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs pa/ /gang gi pang na reg bya rdo rje ma dang bcas pa nub sgo'i g.yas phyogs na/ /rgyun du yang dag gnas pa de la rtag tu gus pas rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /saṃsheyig rdo rje dag las byung ba'i kun du bzang / /sku la chos kyi 7—1068

dbyings kyi rdo rje ma yis 'ag/ /yid kyi rang bzhin dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpar mtshungs/ /shar sgo'i g.yon du gnas pa la phyag 'tshal/ /a yig dang ni rdo rje dag las byung ba'i⑥rdo rje ma ste sgra yi rang bzhin dang / /dpal ldan phyag rdor dang mtshungs shes rab pha rol phyin ma dang mtshungs byang sgo'i g.yon du gnas/ /lnga yig dang ni 'khor lo dag las byung ba'i dri yi rdo rje ma ste dri yi rang bzhin dang / /dpal ldan spyan ma dang mtshungs nam mkha'i snying po dang bcasasnyerlung mtshams bzhugasasnyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma yig chu skyes dag las byung ba'i gzugs kyi rdo rje ma ste gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang / /dpal ldan bdag gi ma mtshungs sa yi snying po dang bcas dbangasnyeldan la gnas phyag 'tshal lo//ā yig dang ni rin chen las byung ba yi ro yi rdo rje ma ste ro yi rang bzhin dang //dpal ldan gos dkar mo mtshungs 'jig rten dbang po dang bcas bden bral la gnas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma yig dang ni ral gri dag las byung ba'i reg bya rdo rje ma ste reg bya'i rang bzhin dang / /sgrol ma dang mtshungs sgrib pa rnam sel dang bcas me mtshalas gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /k+ṣiṃyig rdo rje las byung chos dbyings rdo rje ma ste rdo rje dbyings ma dang mtshungs ma/ /kun du bzang po dang ni bcas pa nub sgo'i g.yon la gnas pa la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro rnams ral gcig dmar la ser/ /ngagasnyelag rkang bshad rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams dang mtshungs pa/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs dang yul gyis brgyan/ /yi yig dang ni ral gri dag las byung ba'i bgegs kyi dgra nyid nam mkha'i snying po mtshungs/ /rengs byed ma ni mā rī tsimatshungs spangs gnas⑩shar sgo'i dbus su chu skyes dkar po dang / /nyi ma la gnas pa dang re yig dbyug pa las byung 7—1069

shes rab mthar byed sa snying dang / /mtshungs dang nga rgyal ma mtshungs tsun+da dngashebacas lho phyogs la gnas dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang sgor pad+ma zla ba la gnas waṃ yig chu skyes dag las byung ba'i pad+ma'i dgra/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dang mtshungs rmongs byedashem ni khro gnyer can ma dang ni mtshungs pa dang / /lo yig tho ba las byung gshin rje'i dgra nyid sgrib pa sel mtshungs shin tu brtson 'grus ma//rdo rje lcags sgog dang ni mtshungs pa paṃ gnas nub phyogs la gnas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dung dang gzer bu dang / /dpalasnye'abras cod pan na bza' dang / /de ltar phyag mtshan rnams las byung / /so so'i ming gis mchod byed pa/ /ka tsa ṭa pa ta sa sde tshan thung ngu tshogs las byung ba yi/ /lha dang gshin rje la sogs g.yas kyi 'dod yon rnams dang steng dang 'og /'dir ni rim pa bzhin du glu ma dri ma spos ma gsol zas ma/ /lha mo sgeg mo gar ma ma lus phyag gnyis zla ba'i zhal dang ldan/ /pa ṭa ha dang snod mar me/ /mu tig phreng dang phreng chu skyes/ /rim bzhin phyag mtshan las byung ba/ /lha mo thams cad sa bon mdog /sā tā pā ṭā tsā kā'i sde tshan ring po brtsegs pasnyegyur las byung ba yi/ /chu sogs g.yon gyi 'dod yon rnams dang steng dang 'og rnams la//de ltar rim pa bzhin du sgra ma bzhad ma bdud rtsi ma rnams dang / /mar me ma dang phreng ba ma dang 'dod pasnye rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni thugs kyi 'khor lo la phyag btsal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i rim pa'o/ /lha mo tsa rtsi kā⑩sogs sa ga'i rkang stabasashedang / /zhal gcig spyan gsum rig byed lag dang ldan pa yi/ /lte ba'i pad+ma la gnas gshin rje'i rtsa rnams kyi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rin chen dang ldan cod pan can/ /shar du ha yig gri gug las byung tsa rtsi 7—1070

kra | /gri gug rtse gsum thod pa kha ṭī ga nyid bsnams/ /phyag na 'dzin pa'i dbang po dang bcas gang yin pa/ /ro dang pad+ma dmar gnas la nisnyephyag 'tshal lo / /tsa rtsi kā sogs pad+ma bsnams/ /rim pas chu tshod rtsa rang bzhin//mdun nas g.yas skor rim pa bzhin/ /pad+ma rnams la rol pas bzhugs/ /'jigs byed drag po mche ba gnyis gshigs ma dang kha nas me 'bar ma dang rlung shugs rabashegatum ma/ /gtum mig ma dang sna chen ma rnams klu yi pad 'dab rnams la tsa rtsi kā la phyogs nas gnas pa'o/ /brgyad rnams dpal gyi gtso mo dang mtshungs hri ya yir ste nyisnyeyig rnams dang gri gug las byung bsgom/ /yu slo yi rnams dang ni gri gug las byung dpal gyi rnal 'byor rnams la 'dir ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /haḥyig dbyug pa dag las byung ba'i phag mo dmar mo dang ni bde byed dkar po dang bcas nyi ma yi/ /pad+ma ma he'i steng gnas phyag na dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog phub chung rnams dang ldan pa/ /gshin rje la ni bzhugs pa'i zhabs gnyis dag la nges par phyag 'tshal/ /keng rus dus mtshan ma dang khro gdong dus kyi lce dang gtsigs ma/ /nag mo 'jigs ma gzugs ngan klu yi 'dab ma la gnas lha rnams/ /dpal gyi lha mo dang mtshungs hri ra ri rje ṭ+wāsheru dṛ re rnams dang / /dbyug pa las byung dpal ldan rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal//haṃsnyeyig rtse gsum dag las byung ba'i drag mo nyid kyi phyag na rtse gsum cang te'u kha ṭī ga dang ltos 'gro dkar po/ /rim pa ji lta ba rnams gshin rje dang bcas byang du khyushemachog dang ni pad+ma dmar po la gnas pa la phyag 'tshal/ /go rībyudang ni ge gā ma dang rtag ma shin tu mgyogs ma 'degs ma mtshan nyid ldan ma dang / /ser skya ma dang nag mo rnams te de ltar brgyad rnams drag mo'i klu yi pad 'dab 7—1071

la gnas rnams/ /dpal gyi drag mo dang ni mtshungs ma hu wa wi spyo hūṃ nyid rnams dang be+e ṭā waṃ rnams/ /rtse gsum dag las byung ba de rnams kun la rab tu dad pa'i sgo nas nges par phyag 'tshal lo/ /hā yig rdo rje las byung dbang mo gser gyi kha dog dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu ni lag pa'i pad+mas 'dzin ma/ /lha min dang bcas chu bdag phyogs su glang po dkar po dang ni/ /pad+ma dmar po'i steng na gnas pa la ni rab tu phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje 'od ma rdo rje lus ma gser mchog ldan ma rigs 'dzin ma dang sna tshogs ri mo ma /chu shing ma dang zug rngu sel ma shin tu sgrol ma rnams ni lag 'dzin pad 'dab la//gnas pa brgyad rnams dpal gyi gtso mo dang mtshungs gli la lo⑥smṛ lo rnams dang ni| /rdo rje dag las rab tu byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kun la 'dir ni nges par phyag 'tshal lo/ /k+ṣusnyeyig dung dag las byung tshangs ma zhal bzhi nyi ma'i spyan ldan kha dog ser po dung dang dbyug pa spyi blugs thod pa rnams dang ldan pa| /sprin gyi kha dog dang ni mtshungs pa'i 'phrog byed dang ni bcas pa rlung mtshalas ngang pa pad dkar steng na gnas pa la ni phyag 'tshal/ /nyi ma'i bu mo pad+ma'i mig ma chu skyes ldan ma blo masnyengag gi dbang phyug ma rnams dang / /glu ma dang ni glog ma dran ma rnams ni rig byed zhal gyi pad+ma 'dab masnyel — gnas pa rnams| /rim pa bzhin du 1 lā lī nywasnyesmri lhudzo la rnams dang dung dag las nisnyebyung ba yi/ /tshangs ma dang ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kun la rab tu dang bas yang dag phyagashe'atshal lo/ /gru dang pad+ma las byung bkra shis ma ni zla ba dang mtshungs pad phreng ka ma la dang rin chen nor bu phyag ldan ma/ /rasheyi gdong can dang bcas dbang ldan phyogs na seng ge padashedakar steng na gnas pa'i 7—1072

zhabs kyi pad+ma la ni nges par phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dkar mo zla ba'i ri mo can masheri bong 'dzin zhal ngang pa'i mdog ma 'dzin byed ma/ /pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma dang 'od zer can ma dri med zla 'dzin ma rnams dbang ldan mtshalas nyid du/ /bkra shis ma yi pad 'dab rnams la rim bzhinasnyegru wā yī 1 khyu lca1 waḥrnams dang ni/ /pad+ma dag las yang dag byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kun la thams cad dus su phyag 'tshal lo/ /: yig shat+ta las byung gzhon nu ma nyid nyi ma dang mtshungs/ /shasti lcags kyu rin chen zhags pa rnams ni phyag gis 'dzin ma/ /bden bral mtshalas nas rma bya pad+ma dkar po'i steng na gnas pa'i/ /tshogs kyi bdag po dang ni bcas pa gang yin de la phyag 'tshal/ /pad+ma ma dang yan lag med ma gzhon nu ma dang seng ge 'gros ma rin chen phreng ba ma| /mig mdzes ma dang kun ma bzang mo rnams ni gtso mo chu skyes gtsug phud can gyisasnye'agros ma yi/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma la gnas rim pa bzhin du spyo rā rīsnye: spyo rū 1 raḥrnams dang ni/ /shat+ta dag las byung ba'i lha mo de rnams dang ni bcas pa rnams la rgyun du phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyi yig 'khor lo dag las byung ba'i dpal ldan khyab 'jug ma nyid/ /zhal bzhi dang bcas pa yis⑥gnag pa'i sku mnga' 'khor lo dbyug pa/ /chu skyes dang ni dag pa'i dung rnams 'dzin pa'i phyag ldan me mtshalas/ /pad+ma dkar po dang ni bya khyung la gnas de la phyag 'tshal//dpal mo sgyu 'phrul ma dang grags ma bkra shis ma dang shin tu rgyal ma dpal rgyal rnams dang / /rab tu rgyal ma dpal ldan 'khor lo can ma dag dang brgyadasheni khyab 'jug ma yi pad 'dab la/ /gnas pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin du spyo yā yīsnyezhu spyo yushe1 masam lus pa rnams dang / /'khor lo dag las byung ba'i lha mo de 7—1073

rnams dang bcas rnams la dang bas⑥rgyun du phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho sgo'i g.yon gyi 'dod yon rnams la ka kha ga gha nga rnams tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i sa bon rnams dang so so'i phyag mtshan rnams las byung ba'i 'dod ma lnga rnams phyag gnyis ri bong zhal/ /shar sgo la sogs rnamasashekyi g.yas kyi 'dod yon rnams la sa bon rang bzhin tsa ṭa pa ta yi/ /sde tshan rnams las de ltar rab tu byung ba de rnams lnga lnga so so'i phyogs la gnas pa dang / /shar sgo'i g.yon gyi 'dod yon la/ /sa sde las byung ha sde las/ /byung ba byang g.yon de las gzhan/ /k+ṣi yig las byung rnams la 'dud/ /ces pa rnams gsung gi 'khor lo'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /tsa rtsi kā sogs dang mtshungs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi rigs rnams/ /rigs byed brgyad dang bcu drug pad+ma'i 'dab ma sum brtsegasasnyel gnas/ /a sogs sa bon rnams dang rdo rje las byung rdo rje dang bcas/ /khyab 'jug la sogs rnams dang tshes kyi lha mo rnams dang bcas pa/ /nga ji rje dra tsā rnga / gha :/ 1 ghu 1 r+ghaṃ/ ga lnga/ spru ṭa/ smṛ ge/ kha na 1/ brgya khre 9 / ka ki sngo ku kṛ ka/ rnams dang 'khor lo las byung ba④/ /pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /dpal gyi dgun zla tha chungasasnyetshes rnams dang ni nges par dpung mgo'i tshigs kyi rang bzhin can/ /'di rnams dang bcas shar sgo'i g.yon du bya khyung pad+ma dmar po'i steng gnas kesnyeyig dang / /'khor lo las byung ba yi khyab 'jug ljang gu'i lus la dpal mo gnod sbyin dang ni mtshungs pas 'ag/ /'khor lo dang ri dbyug pa dag dang chu skyes dung dag 'dzin pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /nya nyi 1 nyu kṛ nye/ dzha rnyi 1 tshu : rdzu/ dza dzi 1 dzu rmi dze+e/ tsha tshi ji tshu rmi tsho/ tsa tsirngo tsu skṛ rtsa/ rnams 7—1074

dang ral gri las byung pang gnas rnams/ /mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas pa dpal gyi dpyid zla 'azing po'i tshes rnams dang ni gtum mo'i tshogasashekyi rang bzhin can desnyenyid do/ /'di rnams dang bcas shar sgo'i g.yas su yi dwags dang ni chu skyes dmar po'i steng gnas pa/ /rtsa dang ral gri dag las byung ba'i srin po dmar mo dbang mo dang bcas ral gri gri gug dang / /phub dang thod pa phyag gisasnye'adzin pa gang yin de la bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ṇa ṇi rje rku 1 ṇi/ rte rnyi 1 zu : haṃ/ ḍa ḍi rje byu dṛ ḍi/ ṭha zi 1 zu khre shā/ ṭa ṭi 1 ṭu zle ṭi/ rnams dang shat+ta las byung pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /dpal gyi dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes rnams dang ni lag mgo'i tshigs kyi rang bzhin gcig nyid de/ /'di rnams dang bcas gshin rje phyogs kyi sgo yi g.yas su lug dang pad+ma dmar po'i steng / /gnas pa ṭī dang shasti las byung sregasnyeza kha dog dmar po shasti dbyug pa dang / /chu skyes spyi blugs dus kyi phyag na bsnams pa drag mos 'ag pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma mi sngo mu slo me/ bha rnyi 1 bhu rmi sgo/ ba bi dz+dza bu bla baṃ/pha phi sngo phu smṛ paṃ/ pa pi z-i pu bla paṃ/ rnams dang zhags pa las byung pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /dpal gyi dbyar zla tha chungs tshes rnams dang ni dpyid mgo'i tshesasnyekyi rang bzhin can nyid do/ / 'di rnams dang bcas byang ⑥sgo'i g.yas su chu srin dang ni pad+ma dmar po'i steng na gnas / /paṃ yig dang ni zhags pa dag las byung ba'i chu bdag zhags pa rin chen sprul nyid dang / /nor bu rnams ni rig byed phyag na 'dzin cing phag mo dang bcas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na ni rje nu 1 rna/ dha dhi dz+dza 7—1075

byu z-i snye/ da di dz+ra du dṛ de/ tha thi dzo thu dṛ dze+e/ ta ti ṭ+wā tu41 haṃ/ rnams dang rdo rje las byung pang gnas rnams ri mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas| /de ltar ston zla 'khrung po'i tshes rnams dang ni g.yon naturnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'di rnams dang bcas nub sgo'i g.yas su sna thag can dang chu skyes dmar po'i steng gnas pa/ /haṃ yig dang ni rdo rje dag las byung ba'i dbang po ser po phyag na rdo rje dang / /mda' dang dril bu gzhu rnams 'dzin pa tsa rtsi ka ②dang bcas pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rka rmi skṛ lku skṛ sko /shi shi 1 shu 1 shaṃ/ ṣa ṣe dz+dza 6 ྾ ṣe/ tha byu byā dzi spyo paṃ/ sa si sngo su bla saṃ/rnams dang rtse gsum las byung pang gnas rnamasasnyeni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /dgun zla ra ba'i tshes rnams dang ni long bu'i tshigs kyi rang bzhin can de 'di rnams dang / /bcas pas byang sgo'i g.yon du khyu mchog dang ni chu skyes dmar po'i steng du yang dag gnas/ /saṃ yig dang ni rtse gsum las byung 'phrog byed sngon posnyertse gsum mda' dang kha ṭī ga /gzhu rnams phyag gis 'dzin dang gshin rje dang mtshungs ri yi bu mo pang gnas la phyag 'tshal//sā sī hṝ sru 1 na / r+pā sri zhu(1 : 49/ ṣā ྾ hṝ ci j-i ṣāḥ/ shā shī 1 shu shrī shāḥ/ ṭ+wā skyi spyo rkya spyo ṭ+wāḥ/ rnams dang dbyug pa las byung pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /de ltar dgun zla 'breng po'i tshes rnams dang ni rkang g.yas long mo'i tshigs kyi rang bzhin te/ /de rnams dang bcas nub sgo'i g.yon du ming dngashenyi ma'i mdog ldan steng gnas pa/ /ṭ+wāḥyig dpal gyi dbyug pa dag las byung ba'i gnod sbyin nor bu dbyug pa sre mo dang / /pad+ma rnams ni phyag na 'dzin pa'i khyab 'jug dang mtshungs nor 7byed1076

dbang pang gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /tā tī hṝ tū 1tāḥ/ thā bhā hṝ byu bla thāḥ/dā dri hṝ byu dz+nyā dāḥ/ jo dhī spyo sgo 1 d+maḥ/ tsā rī 1 nu 1 tsāḥ/ rnams dang dung las byung ba pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas//de ltar ston zla tha chungs tshes rnams dang ni pus mo'i tshigs kyi rang bzhin can nyid de/ /ngang pa chu skyes dkar po la gnas ṭ+wātshoyig dang ni dung las byung ba'i tshangs pa nyid/ /ser po dung dang phreng ba chu skyes spyi blugs rig byed phyag gis 'dzin la khyab 'jug mas/ /'ag pa'i zhal bzhi ser dang dkar dang dmar ba de la phyag 'tshang lo/ /pā spru dz+wa phu spyo pāḥ/ sna shī dzo phu pho snaḥ/ bā bī spyo byu ṭ+wā bāḥ/ bhā ji : khyu 1 bhāḥ/ mā rmā : mū l+lī māḥ/ rnams dang sta re las byung pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes rnams dang ni g.yas kyi dpyi mgo'i tshigs rnams rnam par dag pa yi/ /rang bzhin de rnams dang bcas dbang ldan mtshalas su byi ba chu skyes dkar po'i steng gnas pa/ /māḥyig sta re las byung tshogs bdag dkar po steng gnasasnyesta re rdo rje zhags pa nor bu rnams/ /phyag gisasherim bzhin bsnams la gdong drug mas 'ag de yisnyezhabs la rgyun du phyag 'tshal lo/ /ṭā ṭī dzo 2 1ṭāḥ/ ṣ+ṭha khri 1 zu 1s+dza/ ḍa ḍi dz+wa ḍū 1 ḍāḥ/ bhā ji : zla 1 ṭ+wāḥ/ṇa ’ 1 ḍū 1 ṇ+ḍaḥ/ rnams dang dung las byung ba pang gnas rnamasasnyeni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /dbyar zla 'khrung po'i tshes rnams dang ni lag mgo'i tshigs kyi rang bzhin de rnams dang bcas pa/ /bden bral mtshalas su rma bya chu skyes dkar po la gnas 7ཿyig dang ni mdung⑥dag las/ /byung ba'i ro yi gdong can dmar po shat+ta dang ni mdung dang nor bu me long rnams/ /7—1077

gang gi phyag na gnas pa dang rgo dpa' mo dang bcas de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /tsā ṭī rngo tsu : tsāḥ/ tsā : rngo tshu : tsāḥ/ dzā dzī rmi dzu 1 dzāḥ/ 1 rnyi 1 tsu : dz+nyāḥ| hā tī 1 khru 1 2ཿ/ rnams dang ljon shing las byung pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /dpyid zla tha chungasashetshes rnams dang ni gru mo'i tshigs kyis rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin4 te/ /de rnams dang bcas me yi mtshams su ri dwags chu skyes dkar po la gnas bāḥyig dang / /ljon shing dag las byung ba'i rlung lha nag po phyag na ljon shing lha shing me tog dang //nor bu ut+pal sngon po rnams ②'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhal ma pang gnas de la phyag 'a 'gro 'os/ /2/ tī 1 ṭa: 41 na/ཿ/ ta/ ste/ 4 (1 (1 ta / rwa/ —— sbyo/ byu/ (1 ta/ཿ/bhā l+lī 1 byu : ghāḥ/ ngu dri bye co hṝ ṭ+wāḥ/ rnams dang dbyug pa las byung pang gnas rnams ni mnga' bdag dang mtshungs rol pas gnas/ /de ltar dbyed zla ra ba'i tshes rnams dang ni dpung pa'i tshigs kyi rang bzhin can nyid de/ /de rnams dang bcas lho sgo'i g.yon gyi phyogs su ma he chu skyes dmar po'i steng gnas pa—/ /nguḥyig dbyug pa las byung shin tu sngo ba dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgog zhags pa rnams / /dus kyi phyag gis 'dzin la 'phrogasnyebyed dang mtshungs gshin rje ma nyid pang gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /khro rgyal rnams ni g.yas pa brkyang / /lha mo rnams ni g.yon brkyang gnas/ /zhal gcig rgya mtsho phyag ldan zhing / /spyan gsum rin chen cod pan can/ /haṃ yig dang ni rdo rje dag las lha dbang lus ldan phyag na rdo rje dang mtshungs gtsug tor can/ /de nyid pang gnas hāḥyig dang ni gri gug dag las byung ba'i shin tu sngon mokyidus kyi phyagasagri gug rdo rje thod pa dril bu 'dzin pa dag ni steng du mkha' lding rlung gi shing rta la//7byed1078

yang dag gnas pa'i khu ba 'dzag pa'i rang bzhin de dag zhabs la rab tu dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yisheyig dbyug pa dag las byung ba'i khro bo dbyug sngon can de gshin rje'i dgra yi yum mtshungs dang / /'u yig dang ni 'khor lo las byung 'od zer can ma gser mtshungs 'khor lo dbyug pa dung dang ni/ /rin po che rnams phyag gis pad+mas 'dzin pa dang bcas shar sgo'i dbus su phag pa bdun gyis drangs/ /shing rta la gnas dri chu rnam par dag pa de dag zhabs kyi pad+ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /rbongs byed ma mtshungs dzāsnyeyig mda' dag las ni ṭak+ki rā dza/ /sgo yig tho ba las byung tsun+da sku mdog dkar mo len pa'i/ /rang bzhin tho ba mdung dang pad+ma me long rnams 'dzin gshin rjer/ /rtas drangs shing rta la gnas de dag la ni rab tu phyag 'tshal/ /nga rgyal can mtshungs rmā yig gtun shing las byung mi g.yo ba ste/ /rā yig mda' dag las byung khro gnyer can masnye'agro ba'i rang bzhin/ /mda' dang lcags kyu gzhu dang zhags pa rnams ni phyag ldan dmar mo/ /byang du seng ge'i shing rta la gnas de dag la ni phyag 'tshal/ /rengs byed ma mtshungs lo yig dbyug tosnyedag las byung ba'i stobs chen/ /yāḥsdeyig gtun shing las byung rdo rje lcags sgrog ma nyid nag mo/ /ral gri rdo rje dung dang dril bu rnams 'dzin bshad pa'i rang bzhin/ /chu lhar glang chen shing rta la gnas de dag la ni phyag 'tshal/ /kun du bzang mo dang mtshungs hūṃ yig dang ni dpal gyi gri gug las byung gnod mdzes dang / /hātshoyig rdo rje las byung drag mig ma nyid ljang gu phyag gis sta re rtse gsum dang / /sbrul zhags snying gar 'dzin cing kha ṭī ga bcas kyis 'ag 'og tu klu yi lag ldan pa'i/ /shing rta la gnas bha ga dri chu'i rang bzhin rnam dag la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs skyong dang 7byed1079

mtshungs klu rnams kyis/ /dbu la gdengs ka lnga ru 'dod/ /'on kyang rgyal ba rnam rgyal ni①/ /dbu la gdengs ka bdun du 'dod/ /hūṃsnyeyig rdo rje las ni byung ba'i rgyal ba sku mdog ljang gu/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa rdo rje chu skyes rin chen phyag rnams kun gyis/ /bzung ba rkang g.yon mthe chung3ma par dag pa sngon mo dang bcas/ /steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la gnas de dag la ni phyag 'tshal—/ /sgo 'gram rnams su g.yo ba'i rtse mo can dang chu dang sa rnams dkyil 'khor so so'i kha dog gis/ /shar la sogs pa'i g.yon du dgod pa byu yig rgyal mtshan las byung karko ṭa nyid nag po ni/ /ming med rnam par dag pa ce spyad gdong mas 'ag dang hūṃ yig bkra shis las byung chu bdag nyid/ /nyi ma dang mtshungs gung mo rnam par dag pa stag gdong ma dang bcas la rim bzhin phyag 'tshal lo/ /hwa yig chu skyes las byung dga' bo dkar po nyid/ /mdzub mo rnam par dag pa phag gdong masasnye'ag dang / /h+la yig 'khor lo las byung 'jog po ser po nyid/ /mthe bo rnam dag khyi gdong dang bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /nub sogs g.yas su rmā yig 'khor losnyelas byung pad+ma chen po ser po khā gdong bcas| /hā yig dag ni pad+ma dag las byung ba'i rigs ldan dkar po bya rgodasnyegadong bcas dang / /hā yig bkra shis las byung ltos 'gro dung skyong dmar po 'ug gdong ma dang bcas pa dang / /t+yā yig rgyal mtshan las byung pad+ma dkar min bya khyung gdong bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ yig rdo rje las byung rnam rgyal sngon po nyid/ /rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo la sogs pa nyid kyi/ /rnam par dag pa rdo rje mig ma dang bcas pa/ /'og tu ye shes la gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho sgo'i g.yon gyi 'dod yon la ni nges par gsal byed ka kha ga gha 7—1080

nga rnams thig le dang / /bcas pa'i sa bon las byung mi 'dod ma rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ste mda' yi grangs rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i g.yas kyi 'dod yon rnams la tsa ṭa pa ta'i sde tshan rnams las rab tu byung / /de ltar de rnams so so'i phyogs la lnga pigrangs kyi sa bon dang bcas so so'i phyag mtshan no/ /de ltar sa sde'i shar gyi g.yon/ /'dod yon la ste ha ste byang / /de las ga na pa k+ṣa yig las/ /byungasnyeb rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo la gnas lha nyid de rnams ma lus pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ste spyan gsum dang ldan ma//phyag rgyas spras shing skra grol na bza' rnams dang bral/ /dpal gyi mgo bo'i phreng ba'i gri gug thod pa'i phyag /hā yig gri gug las byung rdo rje spyanalgem nyid/ /ljang gu rgyan dang bcas pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gi/ /rnam par dag pa'i sku mnga' steng gi phyogs nyid du/ /rkang brgyad 'khor lo ljang gu la ni gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi me dang rlung dkyil 'khor lo dag gi dbus kyi cha/ /ka sde brtsegs pa dang ni gri gug las byung khye gdong ma/ /nag mo 'jog po dang ni bcas pa lha yi dbang po'i phyogs su/ /ral gri can dang 'khor lo dmar po la ni gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin k+ṣa ya rā wa la dang / /gri gug las byung phag gdong dmar mo/ /dga' bo dang bcas lho yi phyogs su/ /dom dang 'khor lo gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin ha ya ra wa la dang / /gri gug las byung stag gdong dkar mo/ /chu bdag dang bcas byang gi phyogs su/ /g.yagasnyedang 'khor lor gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin ṅka sha ṣa po sa dang / /gri gug las byung ce spyang gdong ma/ /ser mo karko ṭa bcas nub tu/ /seng ge 'khor lor gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /tu pu ṭu tsu rnams dang gri gug las byung bya 7—1081

yishedabang po 'ug pa bya rgod khā rnams dang / /mtshungs pa'i gdongashecan ser mo dkar mo dmar mo nag mo rnams ni pad+ma dung skyong dga' bo dang / /pad+ma chen po dang bcas rlung dang 'phrog byed ster byed me mtshalas rnams su shing rta'i tshogs bcom nas/ /longs spyod pa yi bzhonasnyepa mig sngon bya long ste ruṇ+ḍa dang 'khor lo dkar po gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /haḥyig gri gug las byung sngon mo kha dog sngo/ /rgyal ba dang bcas 'og tu rlung dang 'khor lo nyid/ /sngon po la gnas phyag 'tshal sngon ltar dgu po yang / /lag pa g.yas g.yon sor mo rnam dag lha mo/ /a yig las byung zla ba dbang po'i phyogs gnas/ /bcalas byung ba'i snang byed bden bral la gnas/ /de dag sa yi dkyil 'khor gnas la phyag 'tshal—/ /hūṃ yig dang ni i yig masayig hoḥ④rnams las byung ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dpal gyi bum pa bzang po mchog gi rnga dang / /dpag bsam shing rnams dkar min dmar po dkar po ser po rnams ni/ /rim bzhin shar la sogs pa'i rta babs la gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba mi bskyong pa la dpal ldan rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpas rgyas ni gdab par bya/ /de ni rgyal ba mi bskyod pasnyeste don grub rgyal ba nor bu'i phyag ldan de nyid kyis/ /chu skyes phyag ldan de nyid 'khor lo can no yang ni de yi rgyal ba rnam par shes/ /spyi bo la gnas sgrib pa bral ba so so'i phyag rgya mdzad la dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' dang ni rlung dang sreg byed chu dang sa yi rang bzhin gyis/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i khams rnams las byung bde bar gshegs pa ji lta bu/ /de bzhin 'khor lo 'di las gzhan pa'i lha rnams ma lus pa nyid kyi/ /con pan mchog las yang dag gnas pa de rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar phyag btsal nas 7—1082

mchod pa bya ba ni/ de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'dod pa'i dri ma med par gsungs pa ltar/ /de las rgyal ba ma lus mchod pa'i don du spros pa'i 'od zer de rnams slar bkug ste rang gi snying ga'i zla ba'i rdo rje la zhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis kyi sa bon gyi yi ge rnams bsams ①la/ de nas so so'i sa bon bherte/ rdo bye shaṃ bye bye rgo// bye //rdo snye bye~X / / bye sde shā rdo/ sde/ sprishaṃ byerdo/ bye bye rtehūm̐ bye byeste / shāru ste // sdishā bye shaṃ byebye bye rdo/ byeṣ+pe bye byedz+rardokā bye rdo hā/ de ltar sngags kyi rkang pa rnams kyisasnyesangs rgyas la sogs pa rnams la yid kyisasnyemachod par bya'o/ /de nas sdog pa bshags pa ni sdig pa dpag med byas pa rnams/ so so nyid du bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyid+kudage ba dpag med gang byas pa/ /de rnams kun la rjes su yi rang ba dang sdig bral byang chub spyod la rjes su bzhugs par zhu/ /de nas dkon mchogad+kugasum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 7—1083

srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa rnams la byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /de nas bdag nyid dbul ba dang bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi ji srid len gyur lus 'bul sems can ma lus don phyir bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shog /de ltar bdun rnam par dag pa'i mchod pa byas nas/ de nas rtsa ba gsum dran par bya'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu bsgom par bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi bsgom par bya'o| /mi dge ba bcu yongs su spong ba bsgom par bya'o/ /sgrib pa lnga spong ba bsgom par bya'o/ /nyon mongs pa bzhi spong ba bsgo ba par bya'o/ /zag pa bzhi spang ba bsgom par bya'o/ /rnam par thar ba bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pa la khams gsum g.yo ba dang brtan par bcasashepa rnams rnam par dpyad par bya ste/ dngos med dngos por med pa ste/ /de ltar dngos po'ang dngos por med/ /des na dngos po dngos med 'gyur/ /de phyir dngos po dmigs su med/ /ces pa'o/ /de nas 'khor ba'i phung po yongs su spang bar bya ste/ de yang de nyid las gsungs pa ltar dang por 'dir brtul zhugs dang ldan pas lus kyi dbus su chu yis me rnams bshig par byed pa'o/ /de nas me'i dngos po med pa las sa'i sra ba spangs nas tshwa bzhin du zhu ste/ chu'i dbus su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang chu rnams rlung gis bamasas te nam mkha' la thim par 'gyur ba ste/ /de lhar khams kyi tshogs rnams myur bar rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /de nas/ sems dang me nyid mun pa'i mtha'/ /zhes pa ni nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus kyi gnas so/ /yul dang bral ba zhes pa ni rnam pa thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan kun gzhi rnam par shes par gzung bar 7byed1084

bya'o zhes pa'o/ /de nas sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /chashu n+ya tā tshwa na badz+ra ste ṅgā ba zhwa kopho①haṃ/ changa.a ni mit+ta tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā ko3②haṃ/ chada.a pra ṇi nyi ta tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kopho③haṃ/ oṃ a ṭ+wā rnyi saṃ ska ra tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kopho④haṃ/ zhesasnyebarjod la/ khams gsum po rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa'i stong pa'i rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sngon gyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs nas chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i don du mngal du 'jug pa'i tshul gyis bskyed pa ni/ nam mkha' khams dpag pa las 'das pa bltas la sngon du brjod pa'i rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi la sogs pa bsam mo/ | de nas rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i dbus su gzhal yas khang bsam pa ni/ hūṃ yig gam rungayig yongs su gyur pa las thugs dang gsung dang sku'i 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid gru bzhi pa'i rten bsam par bya'o/ /de yang thugs kyi 'khor lo la ra ba nag po dang dmar po dang dkar po gsum gyis bskor ba sgo bzhi pa kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ phyi rol du 'dod yon dang / rin chen pha gu dang / dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang /ba ku li dang / kra ma shir+ṣas spras pa/ zla ba dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / me long dang / rnga yab la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pa/ de'i nang gi byed ye shes kyi 'khor lo ste/ rdo rje'i phreng bas bskoraspreb ka ba bcu drug gis spras pa'o/ /de nyid kyi byed ni bcom ldan 'das kyisheganas te rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /de ltar thugs kyi 'khor lo rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i nyis 'gyur gsung gi 'khor lo ra ba lnga yis bskor ba'o/ /de ltar nyis 'gyur gyi sgo bzhi la sogs pa rnga yab kyi bar gyis mdzes par byas pa'o/ /de'i 7—1085

phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo la de nyid nyis 'gyur gyi tshad kyis te/ ra ba lnga dang sgo bzhi la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa'o/ /thams cad kyi shar dang me mtshalas kyi sa gzhi nag po'o/ /lho dang bden bral gyi sa gzhi dmar po'o/ /nub dang rlung mtshalas kyi sa gzhi ser po'o/ /byang dang dbang ldan gyi sa gzhi dkar po'o//phyi rol du sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba dang /rdo rje'i me ri dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor lasheganas pa'i dur khrod chen po'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnam par bsgoms la/ phyag btsal ba'i tshigs su bcad par bshad pa'i bzhugs gnas rnams su gdan rnams ji lta ba bzhin du lha rnams rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de rnams las thugs kyi 'khor lo la paṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams la gnas pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang bcas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /pad+ma re re la rtsa ba dang / ra ba dang /'dab ma dang / ze 'khru dang / lte ba rnams kyi sa bon rnams gzhung ches kyis dogs nas ma bris te/ de yang gzhan cung zad tsam brjod pa ni/pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang ra ba dag las asnyeyig las byung ba'o/ /'dab ma dang ge sar dag u yig las byung ba'o/ /de'i dbus su lte ba la a yig lasasnyezla ba'i gdan no—/ / ram̐ yig lasasnyenyi ma'i gdan no/ /de nas gtso bo'i pad+ma nyi ma nyi shu rtsa lnga pa oṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las te/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / sgra gcan dang / dus me'i dkyil 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa bsgom par byas nas/ rdo rje shugs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa ye shes lnga rdzogs pa dang / phyag btsal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das ⑤dus kyi 'khor lo de nyid du 7—1086

gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sna tshogs yum gyis 'ag par bdag nyid bsams la/ nag mo 'bar ma la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad dang / rin po che la sogs pa'i mtshan ma blta bar byas pa 'di ni rdo rje sems dpa' babyed pa'o/ /de nas sbyor ba'i sgra mi bskyong pa la sogs pa rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams bdag nyid kyi lus la gzhug par byas nas/ nam mkha' la sogs pa'i tshogs skyes bu dang rig ma dang / mig la sogs pa dang / yul rnams kyi rang bzhin gyi lha nyidashedu babyed do/ /yang de rnams rang gi lus lasasnyephyung ste/ /sna tshogs yum la ji lta ba bzhin du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas yang de ltar khrosashel dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang gi lus la bcug la/rang gi rdo rje las spros te rang gi rig ma'i pad+ma'i dbus so / /de yongs su gyur ba las lha nyid kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa ste/ lhag pa'i gtso bor mi bskyong pa bsamasasnyenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la gzhug par bya zhes pa'o/ /de nas sngar gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor byi bdag nyid la gnas par byas nas/ de nas wīsu bi shurtse dharmā dh+wa tu tshwa na badz+ra swa ṅgā ba āt+pasnyeko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad la snying rjes dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de yang de nyid las 'di ltar gsungs pa/bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo la ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas nas sems can thams cad bkug ste/ de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs par rnam par bsam par bya'o—/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 7—1087

khams rnams dang bcas pa rnams rang gi snying gar zhu ste/ byang chub sems su zhu ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ rang gi gsang ba'i rdo rje nas spros pa'i byang chub sems des/ sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar bsam par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems kyi 'od zer de rnams reg pas/ zhal gsum pa dang zhal sna tshogs pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha'i rang bzhin thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid mchog tu gyur pa ①dga' ba'i bde bas gang bar bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de rnams rang rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyikhu'akhor lo'i rang bzhin du skad cig gis blta bar bya'o/ /de nas sngags kyi sa bon rnams gsal byed sna tshogs 'dus pa dang dbyangs dang bcas pa rnams te/ 'dir gsal byed thams cad 'dus pa k+ṣa yig go/ /de nyid kyis ga na yang shes par byed pas/ gang dang gang gi ming gi yi ge dang po de gsal byed de/ de ltar thams cad go bar bya'o/ /de yang 'di lta ste/ k+ṣa k+ṣi k+ṣ-i khyu khyen zhes pa — rnam par shes pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'o/ /de ltar lnga spyo spyo klu 1 k+ṣ-i③/zhes pa ni rna ba la sogs pa byang zung sems dpa' drug go/ /de ltar k+ṣu k+ṣe ji k+ṣiṃ ṣ+ṭha glaḥ/ zhes pa ni yul drug go/ /de ltar sgo glu lnga gru 14 zhes pa ni las kyi dbang po lnga ste/ de ltar khro mo rnams so/ /de ltar kyā yi ji grwa / zhes pa ni las kyi dbang po lnga'i yul lo/ /de ltar sems can thams cad mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa'isnyeskyes bu chen por gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gye 'khor lo'i rnam par skad cig gis rdzogs par bya ba ri/ sems can thams cad la snying rjes dbang bskur ba byin la rang rang gi zhing la gshegs par bya zhes so—/ /sku rdzogs pa'i bhang nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gyikyidakyil 'khor rgyal 7—1088

mchog nadang bsnyen pa'i yan lag go/ /de nas zhu ba lasheganas pa bsgom par bya ste| de yang de nyid las gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ lte ba dang gtsug tor dag lasasnyeho yig go/ /'di gnyis ka dbus su dgod pa dpral bar sku rdo rje r+ṣayig go| /mgrin par gsung rdo rje lnga yig go/ /snying gar thugs rdo rje hūṃ yig gode ltar yi ge gsum ni/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdagasnyenyid ces pa'o//de ltar gzhan yang gsungs pa lte ba'i ho yig gi ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis bzhu ba ni sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams kyis bde mnyam pad+mar shes rab kyi chags pa zhu ba'i ri bong can bzhin du khyab bdag ni bcom ldan 'das shes rab dang bcas pa zhu bar gnas pa las/ sgol ma la sogs pas bskul bas te/ de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms rnams kyi rang bzhin/ sgrol ma dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dgan mo dang / spyan ma ste lha mo rnams kyis bskul zhes pa'o/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i rgyud du yang de ltar gsungs pa/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rgyu mthun rnal 'byor la gnas pa/ /bdag ni rang bzhin dkyil 'khor las/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā ma tī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnam smin rnal 'byor la gnas pa/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin las/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /skyes bu'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin las/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /bral ba'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin pas/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas 7—1089

la| /'gro ba sgol ba'i thugs dgongs kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces pas so/ /de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das stong par bzhugs pa glus rab tu sad nas/ 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams sgyu ma bzhin du bltas te/yang skyedashepar mdzad ces pas so/ /de nas de ltar rang gi sa bon dang mtshan ma yongs su gyur pa las/ rdzogs pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo mi bskyong pas rgyas btab pa bsam ste/ glang po'i pags pa dang / rgyas gdab dang / glu rnams dgod pa'i sngags rnams spangs nas/ sngar gsungs pa'i sngags kyi rkang pa rnams kyis rgyas gdab pa dgod pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas nang gi rgyas gdab pa dgod par bya ba ni/ de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ 'dir gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor thig le lasnye.a yig las mi bskyong pa'o/ /de ltar snying gar sgra gcan byi dkyil 'khor lasnye.i yig las don yod grub pa'o/ /dmakha bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lasnye.u yig las 'od dpag med do zhes pa ste/ mi mnyam pa'i rigs rnams mi mnyam pa'i 'khor lor ro/ /de ltar lte bar dusasnyeme la lo yig las rnam par snang mdzad do/ /mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ yig las rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la saṃdzo yig las rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'o/ /de ltar lha rnams kyi rgyas gdab pa ni lus kyi rgyas gdab par nges pa'o/ /yang ngag gi rgyas gdab pa ni lte bar lī yig go/ /snying gar spru yig go/ /mgrin par dzā yig go/ /dpral bar cha yig go / /gtsug tor du uyig ste sa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bsam mo de ltar sems kyishethig les rgyas gdab pa ni/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 7—1090

oṃyig go/ /mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sgo yig go/ /snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig go/ /lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥyig go/ /de ltar ye shes kyis rgyas gdab pa ni/ /chos thams cad byed pa dang bral ba'i sgo can/ thog ma nas ma skyes pa'i bdag nyid/ rdo rje nor bur a yig grub pa'o/ /de nas chasu bisnyeshurtse dharmā dh+wa tu tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kohwa②haṃ/ zhes pa brjod la dkyil 'khor las dbyung ba'o/ /yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ⑧nam mkha' la gnas pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa'i rang bzhin/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du sangs rgyas lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin rang gi lus la bcug la shes rab kyi pad+mar so so'i sngags kyi rang bzhin du bltas la/ /de nas pad+ma nas snga ma ltar zhal dang / phyag dang mtshan ma dang dbyibs kyi mtshan nyid can/ ye shes dang / thugs dang /gsung dang / sku'i dkyil 'khor la dgod par bya zhes pa ste/ de ltar dkyil 'khor dbyung bar bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i pad+ma'i lte ba la ri bong can dang nyi ma dang / rtse mo can rnams las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ nag po 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro bzhin pa bsams la/ rdo rje de nyid kyi lte ba'i dbus su dzaḥyig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje lcags kyu bsam par bya'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyu de nyid las sngon du gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje shugs yan lag brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa 'od zer rdo rje lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyi rdo rje shugs yang dag par spro bar byas pas/ sngon du yang dag par grub pa'i khams gsum rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ de nas 7—1091

rdo rje shugs rang gi gnas su gshegs par bya'o/ /de nas rmugs byed dang /rengs byed dang / nga rgyal can dang / shin tu stobs can te khro bo bzhi rnams kyi⑥'gugs pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /yang de nyid las gsungs pa de ltar rnam par shes pa lngas te/ dzaḥyig gis dgug pa dang / hūṃ yig gis gzhug pa dang / baṃ yig gis bcing ba dang / hoḥyig gis dgyes par bya ba dang /nyi yig gis ro mnyam par byas nas/ rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje dang /rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje dril bu dang / rdo rje dbyug pa rnams kyis zhes pa'o—/ /de ltar ye shes kyi 'khor lo lasnyeyang dag par mchod nas/ sngon ltar dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsgom par bya ba ni nges pa'o//phan tshun rgyas gdab pa ni/ phyag btsal ba'i tshigs su bcad par gsungs pa'i rim pa ltar sgom snyepa ste/ 'di ni lha nyid kyi sku rdzogs pa'o/ /de nas sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlabasnyepar bya ste/ de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/dpral bar oṃ ⑤yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khorakhude'i steng du cha yig yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje kha dog dkar po zhal gsum pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yon dmar po g.yas nag po phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyis 'khor lo dang / pad+ma dang rdo rje rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pasheral gri dang dril bu dang nor bu rnams 'dzin pa/ shes rab dang bcas pa dmakha ba nas spros te/ des nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgoms nas/ sku rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan par mdzad pa dang / slar log ste bdag nyid kyi sngon du bzhugs pa la rang dbang du blang bar bya ba ni/ sku rdo rje 7—1092

'dzin bdag dbang bskur/ /zhes pas so/ /de nas sku'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur ba dang / de nas byen gyis brlabashepar bya ba ni/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje bcug nas 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'chang / /bdag ni byin rlabasasnyeganas yin pas/ /mi byed rdo rje gsum thob par/ /myur bar sku yi rdo rje mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bdag ni byin rlabasasnyeganas yin pas/ /mi byed rdo rje gsum thob par/ /myur bar sku yi rdo rje mdzod/ /ces pa di sku byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de ltar mgrin par ṛ yig yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du bcayig yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po shes rabasnyedang bcas pa zhal dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po rnams so/ /g.yas kyis pad+ma dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo rnams 'dzin pa| g.yon gyis rin po che dang dril bu dang ral gri rnams 'dzin pa spros la/masnyemakha'i khams ma lus pa yongs su gyur pa gang bar rnam par bsgoms nas/gsung rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos ston par mdzad pa dang /slar log ste bdag nyid kyikyisngon du bzhugs pa la dbang rab tusheblang bar bya ba ni/ gsung rdo rje 'dzin bdag dbang bskur/ /zhes pas so/ /de nas gsung gi rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar bsgoms ⑧nas/ gsung byin byis brlab par bya ba ni/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsung rdo rje bcug nas 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'chang / /bdag ni byin rlabasasheganas yin pas/ /mi byed rdo 7—1093

rje gsumashethob par/ /myur bar gsung gi rdo rje mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bdag ni byin rlabasasnyeganas yin pas/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob par/ /myur bar gsung gi rdo rje mdzod/ /ces pa ni gsung byin gyis brlabasashepa'o/ /de ltar snying gar thig le yongs su gyur pa las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa'o/ /de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje sngon po shes rab dang bcas pa ste/ zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po rnams so/ /g.yas rnams kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyis dril bu dang nor bu dang ral gri rnams 'dzin pa/ de spros te nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa yongs su gang bar bsgoms nas/ thugs rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos ston par mdzad pa dang / slar log ste bdag nyid kyi sngon du zhugs pa la dbang blang bar bya ba ni/ thugs rdo rje 'dzin bdag dbang bskur/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas thugs kyi rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdag nyid la dbang bsgur bar bsams nas/ thugs byin rmis brlabasnyepar bya ba ni/thugs kar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la thugs rdo rje bcug nas/ 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang / /bdag ni byen rlabasasnyeganas yin pas/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum thob pas/ /myur bar thugs kyi rdo rje mdzod| /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bdag ni byen rlabasasheganas yin pas/ /mi byed rdo rje gsum thob par/ /myur bar thugs kyi rdo rje mdzod/ /ces pas de ltar thugs rdo rjelgebyin gyis brlabs par byas nas 'dir ro gcig tu bya ba ni/ r+shasarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra ga bhā 7—1094

ba ā kopho①haṃ/ zhes pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas de ltar bya'o/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi lte bar hoḥyig gis so/ /gsang bar haḥyig gis so/ /bye gtsug tu haṃ yig ste/ thabs kyi khu ba'i chos dang rigs gsum mo/ /shes rab kyi rdul gyisnyechos dang rigs drug go zhes so/ /de nas 'dir gtum mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya ba ste/ de yang dri ma med pa las gsungs pa/ /'dir bskyed pa'i rim pa thams cad du lus rdzogs pa ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go/ /ngag rdzogs pa ni las rgyal mchog ste/ las kyi dbang po'i bya ba la rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems kyi thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa'i phyir jo/ /bde ba la dmigs pa ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor te/de yang mi rnams kyi lo bcu drug gi mtha' ru'o/ /de'i phyir de'i longs spyod pa'i don du bag ma len pa'i dus su lag pa gtod par byed pa dang / slob masnyel slob dpon gyis shes rab ma gtod par byed pa'o/ /de'i phyir las kyi phyag rgya de'i sgrub byed du/ byis pa'i skye bo rnams la gsungs so/ /ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni bar ma rnams la'o/ /phyag rgya chen mo ni mchog gi rnal 'byor pa rnams la'o zhes pa'o/ /de nyid rtsa ba'i rgyud du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ bcu drug lo ste rigs can ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa las/ /dang por shin tu bslab byas nas/ /dbang bskur bsgrub pa nas brtsams nas/ /sku gsung thugs su chags pa dang / /dpral ba la sogs rnams su dgod/ / swā hāsnyegasang ba gtsug tor du/ /de nas pad+ma rnam sbyang bya/ /a las pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /hūṃ las rdo rje dang ldan pas/ /de ltar rdo rje dang bcas pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi rgyud nyid do/ /hūṃ las bdag gi rdo rje nyid/ /rtse mo lnga par 7byed1095

bsam par bya/ /de dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /ayig las ni rab tu brtag /de ltar pad bcas rdo rje nyid/ /pad+ma la ni ga ga par bya/ /hūṃ phaṭa brjod cing rnal 'byor pas/ /mngal du rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyu/ /bha gar liṅga rab gnas pas/ /byang chub sems ni spro mi bya/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis | /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs te/ /mig dang spyan ma la sogs pa//bsregs te ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /zhu ba'i chos can bdud rtsi nyid/ /thig le gzugs kyis 'dzag pas na/ /thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes su bshad/ /bcu drug phyed byed thig le 'dzin/ /cha med cha las 'das pa ni/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'dzin/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor zhes su bshad/ /rgyu mthun la sogs steng du 'gro/ /dung can ma ni phyag rgya che/ /de ni gtum mor rab tu bstan| /lte ba'i steng du g.yung mo ste/ /masab byu tī mi snangasheldan/ /'od zer lnga yi rang bzhin srog /dkyil 'khor lnga ni rgyudasnyebyed pa/ /sna rtser yungs karasnyetsam du bstan/ /de yang srog sdud pa ru brjod/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa'i/ /srid pa gsum po yongs su shes/ /srog nyid 'gagasashepa de nyid kyang / /g.yo dang mi g.yo yungs karalgetsam/ /so sor sdud pas phyag rgya che/ /nam mkha' stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /sna ldan de ni rab bstanasnyepa/ /gang gisasheyid gnyis brtags pa yis/ /de yang de nyid las gsungs po/ /mtshan ma'i mtha' ru ri mo gang / /de yi gzugs ni g.yo mi g.yo/ /rnal 'byor bsam gtan la sogs pa/ /de rnams ma lus bsgom par bya/ /zhes pas so/ /de yang 'dir drang ba'i don du/ g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba dkyil 7—1096

'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam parashespro zhing bsgom par shes par bya'o/ /de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ khams gsum po lan cig gis 'gugs par byed ces pa ni| skad cig gis dus gsum mkhyen pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha'i rnam par spro ba'o/ /'khor ba posnyernams kyis kyang byang chub kyi sems las bu dang bu mo spro ba ste/ de ltar lo bcu drug gi mthar mngal nas skyes pa rnams kyi lus dang / ngag dngasnyesems rnams rdzogs pa'o/ /lha rnams ni rnam par thar pa bzhi'i stobs kyis te/ 'dir kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba'osde/ /de dag las yang drang ba'i don du shes rab kyi chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sna'i rtse mo lusasnyeyungs kar la sogs pa'i nges pa dang /'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa mngal du rgyu ba ste/ de'i dbus su khrotshwa na byu dza a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophoXhaṃ/ zhes pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ lo bcu drug gi mtshalas nas ye shes kyi mchod pa la rjes su chags pa de bzhin du/ 'dir bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dus su yang de'i rang bzhin bdag nyid du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs par nges pa'oshezhes pa'o/ /nges pa'i don du sngags bzlas pa ni srog mnyam par gzhagasnyepa ste/ dgang ba dang dbyung ba dang / bum pa can gyi sbyor ba la dus thams cad dushebasnyen par byas pas/ de nyid kyisabyulha'i mchog ster bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ srog ma bsdams pa dang / ngag gi brjod pa dang bcas pas nges pa'i don la ma yin te/des na sgrub pa'i thabs kyid+kubye brag gi sbyor ba'i yan lag drug mdor bstan pa tsam las ma bris pa ni gzhung ches kyis dogs pa'o/ /drang don ltar na thun mong bsgrubasnyepa'i don du phreng ba dang bcas pas sngags bzlas pa ste/ de yang zhi ba 7—1097

dang rgyas pa la phyogs pas mu tig gam shel gyi phreng ba dang bcas pas/ sngags bzlas pa ni/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi yan lag drug gi sngags 'di lta ste/oṃ n+d+ra hūṃ hūṃdz+washen+d+ra swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di'i mthar na mo bcug pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lha rnams gshegs par bya ba ni/ de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ 'dir dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog dngashe/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnams bsgoms nas mchod pa bya ste/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /ces pa la sogs pas bstod nas/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba ni/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgoms pa dang / de'i lte ba la bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de ltar snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la rdo rje rtse mosnyedagu pa bsgo sa pa dang / de'i lte ba la du ba ma la sogs pa rnams gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de ltar dpral bar lhan cig skyes pa'i 'khor lo la rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa bsgoms pa dang / de'i lte ba la phung po dang khams kyi lha rnams gshegs par bya'o/ /de ltar mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo la rdo rje rtse mo sum cu so gsum pa bsgoms pa dang / de'i lte ba la skye mched bcu gnyis kyi lha khro bo rnams gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de ltar ste b.rasnyesprul pa'i 'khor lo la rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa bsgoms pa dang / de'i lte ba la tsa muṇ+ḍa la sogs pa dang / 'jigs byed ma la sogs pa'i lha rnams gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de ltar gsang bar rdo rje rtse mo sum cu so gsum pa bsgomasnyepa dang / de'i lto ba la 'od zer can ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de ltar las kyi 'khor lo rnamasasnyel rdo rje rtse mo 7—1098

sum cu so gcig pa rnams bsgomanyepa dang / phyag btsal ba'i tshigs su bcad par gsungs pa ltar khyab 'jug la sogs pa'i lha bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ de rnams kyi lte ba rnams la gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de ltar las kyi 'khor lo rnams la rdo rje rtse mo bdun pa rnams bsgomasnyepa dang / klu rnams dang khyi gdong ma la sogs pa'i lha desnyernams lte ba rnams la gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas thugs dang gsung dang sku'i 'khor lo rnams kyi bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom par mi nus pa'i gang zag dbang po tha ma 'ga' zhig gis/ sngon du gsungs pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ste/ de yang de nyid las gsungs pa/ rgyal ba'i bdag po'i pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa'i du ba la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad dang / bum pa brgyad dang /chos kyi dung la sogs pa bzhi rnams spangs pa ni/ dpal ldan snying po'i 'khor lo ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lhasnyenyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid du 'gyur ro//mi'i bdag po kye zhes pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das dusasnyekyi 'khor lo bzhugs pa ste/de'i tshe dpal 'dus pa bzhin 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'dir nges pa med de rjes su 'gro ba med pa'i phyir/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das rang sems nus ma dang ldan parku'adir yang shes par byas la rnal 'byor rnams kyisheni sgrub pa po rnams kyis bsgom par bya'o/ /dbang gi don du rigs kyi dbang las phyi'i dkyil 'khor dngasnyebral ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /yang 'dir sngon du gsungs pa ltar lus dang ngag dang yid rnam par dag pa la sogs pa nas lhashernams gshegs pa'i bar bsgom par bya ste/ der gshegs su gsol bar byas nas/ de nas chahūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i nga rgyal byas pa dang / gtor ma sbyin no/ /de yang de 7—1099

nyid las gsungs pa/ sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas mtshalas gsum du gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas dam tshig gi rdzas rnam par dag par byas la/ lha'i tshogs rnams mnyes par bya ba'i don du gtor ma 'bul ba ni—/ cha.āḥhūṃ hoḥ/ rim par gnas pas dang po 'dir ni rtag tu dag bya sel bar bya ba dang / /rab tu sbar⑥bya nyid dang ri bong can zhu lha busnyem lus rim pas chang la bsgomasnyebyas la/ /snod de las ni nges par ri bong can gyi lag pa'i ming med rtse mo sasnyel thig le nyid/ /nyin byed dang ni mtshungs pa'i dbus su rlum po yin te de yi phyi ru gru gsum byas pa la/ /de yi dbus su ye shes 'khor lo srid gsumasnyel gnas pa yang sngags pa rnams kyis 'dir bsgoms nas//mthe bong dang ni srin lag gis ni—nyi ma so so'i dus su chim pa la sogs bya ba ni//'dir ni sngon du yul dang grong gi bdag po rnams la dang poshedabus mtha'i ming gisalgegator ma dbul/ /'phrog ma la yang chang bu gnyis dngasheg na yang khro bo'i rgyal po'i ched du sngags pas gtor ma'o/ /pho nya rnams la zas kyi rtse mo sa stengs rnams su bzhag ste khyab bdag rdo rje rnams kyis sbyin/ /zos pa'i lhag ma 'byung po rnams la sbyin te gzhan yang dge ba'i don du sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad brjod | /nyal ba'i dus su 'khrig pa'i mchod pa byas nas yan lag kha dang gnyis kyi rigs rnams nyid dang ni/ /rang gi mgo dang mgrin pa snying ga lte gsang spyi bo'i 'khor lo rnams la rdo rje'i yan lag dgod/ /ces pa ste/ de nas ayig las byung ba'i bum pa gsum mo/ /de rnams kyi steng du ru yig las byung ba'i thod pa'o/ /nang na gnas pa ni phung po dang khams kyi sa bon rnams las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga rnams so/ /de rnams kyi 'og tu 7—1100

gnas pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyisasherab tu sbar ba'i mes bzhu bar bya'o/ /de nyid hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rjes dkrug par bya'o/ /de dang bcas pa'i ro gcig tu gyur pas zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su blta'o/ /de nas rnam par dag par bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags kyi rkang pa brjod pa②/ oṃ6badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dhasmra su bi shurtse / swa bhāsnyeb sarba dharmā nakhebi sho dha ya sru hā/ ska.āḥbadz+ra srur+ya sarba dhas+thā pra bo dha ka sarba dharmānasnyepra po dha ya snga hā/ chahūṃ badzā na la sarba dhasmrakhepra dī bsheka sarba dha— pra dri pa lasnyeya swā hā/ chaho sarba dhasnyad+kubadzā mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmā na badzāsnyemṛ tai ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa rnams kyis lag pa g.yon pas rnam par dgab par bya ba dang / lag pa g.yas pas spel bar bya ba dang /thal mos kha bcad de reg pas rab tu sbar bar bya ba dang / rdo rje bya khyung gi phyag rgyas rdo rje bdud rtsir bya'o/ /gzhan yang khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas yul gyi bdag po spyan drang bar bya ba dang / khyi'i phyag rgyas grong gi bdag po rnams la'o/ /rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo'i rgyal po rnams la'o/ /gri gug gi phyag rgyas zad par rnams la'o/ /ral gri'i phyag rgyas lha rnams la'o/ /rin po che'i phyag rgyas gza' rnams la'o/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgyas klu rnams la'o/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgyas 'byung po rnams la'o/ /de yang oṃ.āḥhūṃ a mu ka ugats+tsha ugats+tshachashī n+t+ra ཿ'i ba li greṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍa bu sta spru tā z-iste kṛ tāsnyesarba satwa rmā shārnyi cilta kṛ tā asnyepa ras+thā rna gats+tsha gats+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa gtor ma'i sngags 'dis yul gyi bdag po dang / grong gi bdag po'am de ltar yul lam/ grong gi ming gi yi ge gang yang rung ba gsum dang lnga dang bdun yin na/ de yang ming gi yi ge dang po dang / dbus dang mtha' ma rnams bcug ste/ gtor ma rnams sbyin 7—1101

256ra / /dpal dus kyi 'gor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen bya ba/① ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭīkā la tsakra maṇ+ḍa lo pa yi kā bi dhisga bod skad du| dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi stog zhes bya ba/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par mkhyen pas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa rab tu 'joms par mdzad pa dze+e /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin khyab bdag dpal ldan dus 'khor nges par gzhan gyi don mdzad la/ /phyag byas sems can don phyir rgyud gsungs rmag bzhin du de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga nyid| /rang gi don dang 'on kyang gzhan don du yang 'gyur bas yid la 'dod pa sgrub byed bshad/ /'dir thog ma med pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pa'i tshogs kyis blo'i mig bsgribs pas mi bden pa'i lam nas 'gro ba'i sems can rmi tshogs sdug bsngal spyod pa bsal bar nus par yang dag par mthong bas/ snying rje mchog dang ldan pa mngon par shes pa thob pa'i dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam khyim na 7—1111
