thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /rang gi pad+ma'i snying ga ru/ /ye shes me ni gshegs su gsol/ /chadzaḥgats+tsha gats+tsha swā hā/ ramisarba saṃ tri ba tosnyeho pu na ra ga mi sha si di pa sresnyeya dha tā na ya mi swā hā/ dam tshig gdan rnams rim bzhin thim/ /de ltar lhag gnas byas nas ni/ /rmags gtor ma lhag gnas bya/ /de ltar gtor ma lhag byas nas/ /ga na don slob ma lhag gnas bya/ /sgom ldan slob ma khrus byas te/ /gtsang ma'i gos bgo maṇ+ḍal bya—/ /me tog thogs la gsol ba gdab/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs bdun po dang / /sdom pa gsang ba bla med sbyin/ /de nas smon lam gdab par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /bla ma yang ni spyi bo ru/ /gzung bar bgyi'o rdo rje dze+e /rin chen gyis ni sbyin pa sbyin/ /rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig ni/ /bskyang bar bgyi'o 'khor lo yi/ /ral gri yis ni mchod par bya/ /chu las skyes pa'i rigs kyis ni/ /sdom pa yang ni sbyin⑧par bya/ /sems can rnams ni grol ba'i rgyur/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i rigs kyis ni/ /byang chub sems ni babyed par bgyi / /kun rdzob don du brtul zhugs ⑤rnams/ /rab mchog gis rjoni lam song ba/ /de bzhin de rnams sbyinalgepar bya/ /'tshe dang brdzunabasagazhan bud med/ /gzhan nor de bzhin chang 'thung spangashe/ /sdig pa lnga po 'di dag ni/ /'khor bar rdo rje zhags pa ste/ /rang gi rigs ni 'joms par byed/ /gang zhig gang gi dus su ni/ /sum cu pa dang mi'ibyubla ma/ /de yi ming gis sbyin par bya/ /sna tshogs bdag po'i bka' 'di ni/ /srid pa yi ni 'jigs 'jomasad+kupa/ /khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya/ /cho lo bsadasnyezas kha na ma thor bcas/ /tshig ni ngan par sngab dang / /'byung po lha dang lha min chog /ba lang bud med skyes pa rnamag /7—1227

sum cu pa dang mi'i ①bla ka /lnga ni bsod nams mi bya'o/ /sum cu pa dang mi'i ②bla ma/ /dge 'dun dang ni sangs rgyas dang / /yid ches pa dang byang chub dang / /grogs dang dpon la 'khu mi bya/ /dbang po rnams ni chags med bya/ /'di rī srid pa'i bdag po dzi /brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /brgya la g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis ni/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba byung gyur na/ /dmyal ba yi ni sdug bsngal myong //bu yi rtsa ba'i lhung ba ni/ /dpal ldan mama'i thugs sun byung / /ri bong 'dzin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de yi bka' las 'das pa ga na/ /gnyis pa nyid ni de bzhin du/ /spun la khro ba gsum pa'o/ /byams pa dor ba lnga ru 'gyur/ /grub pa'i mtha' smod drug pa'o/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba ston pa gzhan pas ringasnye/ /phung po nyon mongs brgyad par 'gyur/ /dam pa'i chos la mi dad pa/ /slar la yang ni dgu pa'o/ /rgyu shibyams pa phyogasasusnyi'agyur/ /ming sogs bral ba'isnyebade ster ba/ /rtog pa drag po ru nikyi'agyur/ /dag pa'i sems can la skyon brjod/ /nyi ma ru ni 'gyur ba yin/ /dam tshig rnyed pa ⑦ 'dor 'dod pa'o/ /bud med kun la zod pa ni/ /yid nyid kyi ni dgra ru 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i theg la gnas rnamasasnyikyi'o/ /slob ma skad cig lhar bskyed nas| /slob ma la ni bsrung bya gle /spyi bo snying ga de bzhin du/ /spyi gtsug lte ba mgrin pa dang / /dpral ba gsang bar rgyal bshesogag /gnyi ga'i rigs su song ba'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'o/ /nges par byin gyis brlab par bya/ /de la rnam bcu'i mchod pa bzhin/ /so shing dor dang srungabyuskud bcing / /byams pa'i go bskon gtsug tor bskyed/ /mi lam brtag pa'i kusha sbyin/ /de nas slob ma gshegs su gsoka /thig skud rdo rje rdul tshon nyid/ /shar dang 7—1228

gshin rje chu lha ru/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor snying gar bsdu| /bdag nyid mal sar mi lam brtag /ngan nashephyir bzlog cho ga bya/ /bcu gnyis pa la thig gdab cing / /'dod pa yid kyi nyi ma la/ /dpal gyi rdul tshon nyid ni zi/ /nya la dbang rnams rdzogs par ni/ /mchog gi bla mas sbyin par bya/ /bdud bcom pa shinyi ma la/ /de yi mtshan mo rgyal ba yis/ /rigs ni rab tu gnas par bya/ /mtshan mo gzhan la rab gnas min/ /srad bu khru ni brgyad 'gyur las/ /lag pa'inas kyilgetshad tsam du/ /gcig tu bsgril ba'i sum bsgrilasnyel/ /slob dpon mthe bong nas kyi tshad/ /lam ni rnam pa gsum song ba| /srad bu gcig go gzhan ni med/ /skesogs ka sogs gcig pa nyid/ /rangakyigi snying ga'i pad+ma ka /zla ba nyi ma me stengs su/ /ri bongakhucan dang dregasayipa ni/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis mnan/ /shes rab rje btsun snying pad+mar/ /nyi ma zla ba brtsegs pa yī /rang rang rdo rje lcags kyu yis/ /sangs rgyas lha mo rnams bkug ste/ /thig skud chad pas slob dpon 'chi/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma rnams ni 'dze+e /mthun dang mi mthun rkang pa yis/ /thig gdab par ni bya ba min⑨/ /shes rab thabs kyi yan lag dbus/ /me dang rlung du song ba yi / /dpung gidabus sud+kuyul 'dra ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor mtshams rgal de spang bya/ /tshangs pa'i thig nas thig gdab nyid/ /nor dang dus kyi tshad kyis ni/ /phyogs kyi cha la rab rtsasbyin/ /thugasakyi dkyil 'khor bdag nyid ni/ /sor mo byed kyi cha ru gsungs/ /'khor lo pad+ma'i bdag po ste/ /lha mo la sogs gdan rnams kyi/ /sum 'gyur du yang gsungs pa yin/ /tshangs pa'i gnas su nyi ⑫re'u mig /be+er la yang ni zla ba yis/ /ka ba rdo rje ra bar gsungs/ /7—1229

sangs rgyas la sogs chu skyes bzhis/ /phyi ru ri bong can gyis ni/ /rdo rje'i phreng bar rab tu 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas lha mo'i bar bar du/ /sor byed gsum gyi re'u mig la/ /bum pa'angaspathod pa'i gdan du 'gyur/ /de yi gnas su rdul tshon las| /nyin mo byed pa la 'gyur te/ re khā gsum gyi mthar thug par⑦/ /phyogs dang mtshalas kyi re'u mig bzhi/ /pad+ma rnams la zla nyi ma/ /de bzhin dri la⑧sogs rnams kyis/ /sor byed bzhi chas re khā gsum/ /dus dang de bzhin ro yis ni/ /sgo dang sgo khyud de bzhin du/ /sor byed drug las 'gram dang logs/ /kha khyer chen po ka ba'i phyegaci/ /de yi phyed kyis nor bu dze+e /rang bzhin pha gu 'ba' zhig 'gyur/ /nyis 'gyur dra ba dra phyed pa/ /sgo yi rtsa ba'i phyi rol du/ /sor phyed drug gi sum 'gyur gyis/ /ka bar bcas pa'i rta babs 'gyur/ /thig las mtha' ru spang bar bya/ /de yophyi rol 'byung ba bzhi/ /yang ni spros don ma yin pa/ /gcig bzhi gnyis bzhi gcig nyi ma/ /dus dang ro dngartse mokhyacan/ /me dang dus dang dus kyi phyed/ /twas la drug gi rab byed dngakyi/ /dus drug dang ni ro ⑦rnams kyi/ /nges par cha yi rim pa yig /lte ba'am ni snying po nas/ /chu skyes pad+ma yangasnyide ni/ /ka ba rdo rje phreng ba dang / /pad+ma rdo rje phreng bar 'gyur/ /sgo dang sgo khyud la sogs pa'i/ /sad+kuru de 'og 'gyur ba dang / / ka ba ra ba kha khyer dang / /slar la yang ri de 'og yo /pha gu dra ngadra byed pa/ /me long la sogs snam bu sa/ /mi yebadag por gyur pa dngad+ku/ /rta babs kyi ni cha rab gsungs/ /de ltar thig gi las zin nag /tshon gyi las ni rab tu bya/ /rdo rje la sogs rdul tshon lnga/ /gser dang pad+ma rā ga ⑪dang / /byu ru mu tig la sogs pa/ /'khru yi khyad par dag dang ni/ /nor 7—1230

bu'i khyad par mang po dze+e /phye ma rdul tshon de bzhin du/ /thig bzhin byin rlabs stog bya/ /phyogs kyi cha atshon gyi sar/ /mi yi bdag po rdul tshon gyi/ /sangs rgyas dbye bas bri bar bya/ /ser po dkar po dmar sogs kyig /sa dang chu dang me rlung ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bri bar bya/ /shar gyi sar ni dpal nag po/ /nyi ma lta bur⑥lho ru'o/ /nub tu gser du snang ba ste/ /byang du ri bong 'dzin dkar po/ /rdo rje 'dzin zhal dbye bas so/ /dkar po dmar po nag po'o/ /rim pas yongs su zis nas so/ /kha khyer pha gu dra ba'i sa/ /pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i mdog /dri med ri bong can 'dra dang / /dmar po nag po re khā gsum//dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /ljang gu āXli lta bu'o/ /ka ba rdo rje phreng bar 'gyur/ /dbang ldan bden bral me rlung du/ /zla ba nyi ma dag gi mdog /nag po ser po dmar po yis/ /dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor bu dang / /ljon shing dang ni de bzhin du/ /bum pa dkar po pad+ma dzi /steng du zla ba dmar po ni/ /'gyur ro nyin mor byed pa ni/ /pad+ma dkar po'i steng du'o/ /pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar lha / / ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan la ni④/ /lha mo rnams ni gnas par 'gyur/ /pad+ma dkar po'i lte ba ka /nyin mor byed pa dgod ⑤pa dzi /lha rnams phyogs su gnas pa na/ /phyi ru rdo rje phreng bar 'gyur/ /gtso bo'i pad+ma'i dbang gis ni/ /kha khyer dag ni mdog dkar po/ /ba ku li dang ka ba ni/ /gser dang 'dra ba ser por 'gyur/ /rta babs kha dog sna tshogs so/ /sbom pos nad ni skyed par byed/ /phra mos nges pa kho nar ni/ /nor rtams mtshan nganakyiri mo spang / /chad pas 'chi zhing yon po yis/ /mi rnams skyebo'i bdag pos sgod/ /de bzhin mtshan ma nyi ma'i bdag /srid pa ani 'jigs 'joms la/ /sngags pa 7—1231

rnams ni dngos grub med/ /rdul tshon 'dres na rigs ni 'chad/ /rgyal rigs dkyil 'khor la ni ①bya/ /rgyal ba nges pa kho nar ster/ /rgyud kyi nang du gang ma gsungs/ /mtshan ma mdzes pa'i ched du ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni de mi dgod/ /rgyal bas rigs ni shes med pas/ /de nyid bdud kyi mtshan ma'o/ /de phyir rgyud gsungs mtshan ma ni/ /rigs kyi dbang gis bya bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor sgo yi bar du ni/ /dra ba dra byed bar de bya/ /sa dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma bum pa sogs kyis brgyan/ /nag po la sogs rdul tshon rnamag /bzhi cha 'phel bar 'gyur ba ste/ /nas gcig bar du mtho ba'o/ /ra ba rnams ni mtho 'gyur te/ /nyin mor byed dang ri bong can/ /re khā ga na ni nyis 'gyur te/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni mtho ba ru/ /mi yi bdag por 'gyur ba yin/ /dra ba dra byed mthar thug dang / /sa dang chu dang byin za dang / /phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng gnas gcig /chagyi ye shes las skyes par/ /rgyal ba dam pa'i pad+ma dzi /nyi ma zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /asogs ka sogs stong par bcas/ /srid pa gsum ni bskyed⑧pa yī /yum ni gzhag par bya ba yin/ /stong pa adang tsheg drag dang / /gzhan ni dbyangs dang bral ba'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /yang dag 'byung phyir sngags skyeganas/ /mchog tu bde ba byed pa dze+e /ye shes rdo rje bzhi pa'o/ /hūṃ ni kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal ba'i bdag po'i pad+ma dze+e /zla ba nyi ma me steng du/ /dbang ldan bden bral gyi ni mtshalas/ /rtse mo can dang rlung du ni/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs chags pas/ /haṃ sogs bum pa brgyad kyi'o/ /shar gyi pad+maraḥsayig stes/ /me yi pad+ma ru song ba/ /yi ge bltani ring po nyid/ /gshin rje bden bral ṛ yig gnyis/ /shar dang nor sbyin 7—1232

phyogs song ba①/ /thung dang ring ba'i u yig go/ /chu dang rlung gi mtshalas su ni/ /ga na yang pad+ma ru song ba/ /thung dang ring ba'i lo yig go/ /nag po dmar po dkar po dang / /gser ni btso ma lta bu ni/ /zhal byi dbye ba yod pa yis/ /shar gyi sgo yi g.yas dang ni/ /rtse mo can gyi pad sod pa/ /ring dang thung ba de bzhin nyid/ /gshin rje rutsoni bden bral du/ /de bzhin du ni ar ni zungaka /nub dang rlung du u snyeni zung / /gnod sbyin 'phrog mar ocha'/ /lha dang chu lha gshin rje dze+e /sgo wagayon dang gnod sbyin bcas/ /i dang ayi rim pa yis/ /ga na yang lngar thal dang / /sgo yi pad+mar rlung la sogs/ /shar gyi sgo dang g.yas min par/ /khro bo dag gi gdan du ni/ /ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur ba gle /g.yas dang nub tu nyi ma yang / /pad+ma dag gi steng du ni/ /gdan gnyis dag tu rab tu 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs kyi rab dbye bas/ /pad+ma'i steng du zla ba dang / /nyi ma yang ni gdan du 'gyur/ /g.yas dang rgyab tu nyi mar 'gyur/ /lha abadag por sdeganod sbyin du/ /zla ba yi ni gdan du 'gyur/ /thung dang ring po'i sde tshan drug /rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis na//kha khyer ka ba'i logs su'o/ /dri sogs rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ /rang gi rigs kyi sar song ba/ /shar gyi cha nas rang phyogs su'o/ /de ltar zis pa zin pa dang / /de nas rdzas rnams bsag par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa/ /slob dpon gyi ni rdzas rnams dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni rdzas rnams dang / /de rjes mchod pa'i yan lag rdzas/ /re re nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / /khyad par tshogs kyi mchod pa'i rdzas/ /chang dang bdud rtsi la sogs pa/ /ci 'byor pa ni bsags par byatso/ /bsrung ba mda' dang phur bu dang / /yungs 7—1233

kar phur bu tshon skud do/ /sgrub pa bum pa rnams dang yang / /sbyin sreg rdzas dang gtor ma'o/ /bsod nams bsoganyapa'i rdzas dag ni/ /rin chen bdun dang rdzas brgyad dang / /bum pa 'dod 'jo nor bu dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga'o/ /rdzas ni ji tsam 'byor pa'o/ /de nas dgongs kyi dus su ni//dkyil 'khor sngags kyis bslang byas la/ /rang gi 'khor lo sprul dang bsre/ /lha rnams ma lus tshang bar bsgom/ /de nas shar du las kyi ni/ /he ru ka yi gzugs kyis dbye/ /tsham ngam sngags kyis bstod pa dang / /sa man+ta zhes sngags kyis ni/ /bgegs bamakha lhag dang ma tshang bskang / /lha la me tog phreng ba dor//sngags kyi mtshan ma khang pa'i nang / /shel gyi bum pa dkar po ka /skud pa sna lngas dkris pa ni/ /zur du yang dag ga ga par bya/ /slob dpon 'khor lo'i shar du ni/ /gnas nas sdig pa bshags sogs dang / /dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog dang ni/ /las kyi rgyal po'i mchog la ni/ /rigs gtso pad+ma las skyes pa'i| /byung ②ba khro bo'i rgyal po yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas ni/ /mchod yon dang ni mchod pa bcu/ /lha rnams kun la rgyas byas la/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lcags kyu sogs/ /rim bzhin yongs su bskyed pa yig /dgug gzhug bcing dang dgyes byas nas/ /rdul tshon dang ni ro mnyam pa/ /dbang gi ched du bya ba yin/ /de nas bum pa thams cad la/ /bzlas pa lha re brgya byas la/ /mchod dang lha rnams zhu bar bya/ /zhu ba'i chu yis dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang bskur rim pa bzhin byas la/ /de nas bdud ci lngarjams ni/ /lha rnams sngags kyis dbul bar bya/ /hūṃ yig ye shes sa bon ni/ /snying po yang ni chen po ste/ /brtsegs pa'i yi ge zhal du bcas / /haṃ la sogs pa go cha drug /nye ba yi ni 7—1234

snying po 'di/ /sku yi rdo rje dang por ldan/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni de bzhin ga na//las kyi dbye ba du ma yis/ /rnam pa mang po ru ni 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'khor gyi sngags kyis kyang / /bdud rtsi lnga ni dbul ba yin/ /de nas gong gsungasasreg blugs ①kyis/ /lha rnams kun la sbyin sreg sbyin/ /de nas mchod pa thams cad ni/ /dbyangs dang bstod sgra ldan pas ni/ /rin chen gser dang chu me tog /rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang ras/ /dri dang spos dang mar me dang / /dril bu me long bla re dang / /'bras bu sna tshogs pa la sogag /gar dang rol mo la sogs⑧ pa'i| /mchod pa sna tshogs byas nas ni/ /gong gi gtor ma rgya chen sbyin/ /de ltar mchod pa'i las zin nag /de nas slob ma gzhug pa ni/ /khrus dang dri yis rjes byugs shing / /lus la gos ni ser byin te/ /mig ni dar gyis bkab nas ga /yolaba'i rgyab ṭubazhag⑧nas ni/ /bsang chu dang ni dris lan bya/ /rgyal rnams la ni deng bdag nyid/ /'khor ba mi bzad 'jigs pas na/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dag pa/ /srid pa yi ni 'jigs sel ba/ /khyed kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma ru/ /skyabs su lhag par 'gro bar bsgo /gser dang bcas pa'i me tog gis| /maṇ+ḍal dag ni byas pa yin/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas ni/ /yol ba'i nang du bsdu bar bya/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag bzhi dang / /bdun po rnams dag rdzogs par bya/ /de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /mam yang ni spyi bo ru/ /gzung bar bgyi'o rdo rje'o/ /rin chen gyi ni sbyin pa sbyin/ /rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig ni/ /bskyab—par bgyi'o 'khor lo yi—/ /ral gri yisasnyeni mchod par bya/ /chu las skyes kyi rigs kyi ni/ /sdom pa yang ni bskyang bar bsgo /sems can rnams ni grol ba'i rgyur/ /rgyal ba skyed 7—1235

byed rigs kyi ni/ /byang chub dag ni bskyed par baṅga /de nas dam tshig rdo rje sbyin—/ /snying ga yi ni zla ba la/ /hūṃ las rdo rje bkod nas ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par ba4 /de nas lha dang slob dpon dze+e /dam tshig rab tu bsgrag par bya/ /lce largyal ba mchog gi ni/ /dam tshig gi ni bdud rtsi bzhin/ /spos ni dbab pa'i don du'o/ /hūṃ gi sngags ni gcig pu dang / /ar la dang lhan cig yo /khro bo ani rgyal ba bskul/ /de yi mtshan nyid rgyud na gsaka /dbab pashepad+ma'i steng la ni/ /spyi bo snying ga spyi gtsug dang / /lte ba mgrin pa gsang ba ru/ /rgyal ba rigs kyi sar son pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyis bsrub ba ②bya/ /de nas rigs nishedag bya'i phyir/ /chasarba zhes bya ba yis/ /dpal kyi sngags kyis mngon bsngags te/ /lag pa'i pad+ma sbyar byasal/ /me tog gcig ni rab tu sbyin/ /dang po bskor ba gsum byas te/ /lag pa'i pad+mosnyesbyor byas pa'i/ /me tog dkyil 'khor du ri dor/ /gnas gang du ni lhung ba ni/ /de yis rigs so mi bdag kye/ /dbye ba'i sngags kyis mig ni dbye/ /de nas rigs kyi lha dang ni//gtso bo la sogs pa ni bstan/ /'jug pa bdun ni mi'i bdag po/ /de nas dbang bskur bya ba ni/ /slob ma shar gyi sa ru ni/ /cho ga bzhin du lhar babyed nas—/ /rigs ni dag par byas nas ni/ /de nas byang gi sgo ru ni/ /rgyal po klu dang bzhi yis terjo/ /rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa dang / /lha mo rnams kyis bkrus pa ni/ /sgol ma la ⑦sogs pa ru 'gyur/ /cod pan sangs rgyas rab dbye bas/ /bla ma mchog gis sbyin par bya/ /de ltar sku ni dag byasaka /lho ru gsung ni dag lar bya⑧/ /dar dpyangs nus pa rnams yin no/ /rdo rje dril bu nyi zla dag /de nas shar du brtul zhugs ni/ /dbang po rnams la sbyar ba'o/ /ming ni khro bo 7—1236

byams sogs dag /der ni nub kyi sgo ru ni/ /rgyal ba'i bdag pos nges par ni| /sngags dang bcas pa'i gnang ba sbyin/ /rdo rje drilabu rab sbyin te/ /rab mchog gi ni snying rje yig /dag pa'i chos ni bstan par bya/ /rigs gtso rigs kyi ngesapar ni/ /srog bcad pa ni bya ba yin/ /ral gri mi bden bar saba'i| /rin po tsheyis gzhan nor dbrog /pad+mas gnan gyi bud med dbrog /chang dang mar me sangs rgyas dang / /yul ni ①du ma ma lus dang / /'khor lo yis ni bsten par bya/ /gri gug g.yung sogs bud med kyi/ /mkha' yi pad+ma smad mi bya/ /sems can rnams kyi don miphyir/ /nor bcas lusani sbyin par bya'o/ /khyod kyis zhen par mi bya'o/ /bamakha pa dpag med rgyal bas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas nyid de ga na du min/ /min par 'gyur ro rigs kyi bu/ /chu ni sgrol ma sogasalha mo/ /cod pan 'dir ni rgyalab rnamag /dar dpyangs nus pasnye rnams yin no/ /rdo rje nor bu nyi ma ma /brtul zhugs yul ni dag par 'dod//ming ni byams pa sogs la sbyor/ /gnang b.rogs pa'i⑧byang chub thob/ /srid pa yoni 'jigs pa sel/ /dus kyi 'khor lo rjes shesapa'o/ /'di dag dbang ni bdun yin no/ /ston mongs dri ma sel bar byed/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab sbyin bya/ /dbang bdun bskur bas sa bdun glo /dbang phyug tu ni grol bar 'gyur/ /bumapa gsang ba'i dbang bskur bag /yang ni phyir mi ldog pa sogag /ngesapa kho nar 'jug par bya/ /shes rab yeshes kyis srid pa'i/ /'jigasacu 'jam dpal dbyangs su 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i nyung bas dmyal bar bsregs /nyung ba dag pas dbang bdun las/ /gnas pa yon tan rmis sbyang bya/ /bum pa gsang gnasanyabargya la3/ /brtulazhugs pa adabang gis te/ /7—1237

rtsa lhung byas nas slar yang ni/ /dag phyir dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya/ /gnang thob tshogs nang 'jug pa na/ /slar yang rgan nas ga na spang ngo / /de nas sngags kyi dbang bskur sbyin/ /dbang bdun gyi ni cho ga'o/ /da ni bum pa'i⑪dbang bskur ba/ /bdag ni bde gshegs kun gyi lam/ /dpal ldan mam khyed kyi ②ni/ /bshad drin gyis ni bdag 'tshal lo/ /zam khyed dang sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs par/ /slob dpon ga na ni mnyes mi balga /de ltar gsol ba btab nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ru maṇ+ḍal bya/ /re khā lnga yis spras pa dze+e /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ /de ru slob ma bzhag nas ni/ /brgyad dang de bzhin bzhi yis ni/ /bum pa nor bu gser gyi 'am/ /sa las byung ba rin chen bcas/ /sman dang dri dang ldan pa dze+e /rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa yis/ /shing stegs dbus su brtsabar bya/ /klu yi dpalagyi cod pan bcings/ /nor gyi dpal gyi 'dab ma la/ /bzhi yis bkru dang dar gyis bcings/ /phyag rgya dpal bum gcig gis te③/ /'dir ni pad+macidang bral zhing | /rimo lnga ⑤ni rnam par spangs/ /dang po chu la sogs pa yis/ /dge bsnyen du ni 'gyur ba yin/ /bum pa yis ni dge tshul 'gyur/ /gsang dbang dge slong du 'gyur te/ /gnas brtan 'gyur ba gong ma'i rgyu/ /de nas rdor dugasum phyag rgya sbyin/ /khyab 'jug thugs su bya ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya drug lnga cod pan sbyin/ /tshangs pa'i sku phyir mchod phyir thogag /dbang phyug gsung du bya ba'i phyir/ /rang gi rgyal po'i rigs dbang gig /der ni phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs dbang dang / /lung bstan dngakhuni dbugs dbyung dang //mig thur nyon mongs spang ba dang / /me long yeshes dbang dang ni/ /chos dang 7—1238

phrin las gnang ba dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang / /dam tshig rnams ni bsgrag par bya/ /de ltar dbang bskur zin nas ni/ /rab tu gnas pa tsam du bya/ /steng du glare byesaspanas ni/ /sa yi steng gi gnasadag tu / /kun nas ming⑧yig gsum zi'o/ /derams mtshams susnyeg ga par bya'o/ /nor bu gser gyi bum pa rnams/ / ༄ bcas gang ba pad+ma'i khar⑤/ /gser gyi snod dang dngul la sogs/ /yang na dngul las byung ba la/ /dri yi chu ni gzhag par bya/ /nang du gser las byung ba'i stegag /nges pa kho nar ga ga par bya/ /de ru khrus ni brtsam par byaX/ /me tog la sogs dris bdugs ka /nyi ma me la bsros pa yis/ /lha rnams la ni byug par bya/ /bye ma rnams kyis mnyes nas ni//sprang rtsi zho dang mar rnams dang / /'o ma'i chu yis bkru bar bya/ /grub pa'i don du mar me dang / /'bras bu sna tshogs mchog gis bya/ /'di ru byas pa zin nas ni| /gnas de nas ni bskyong par bya/ /de ni gnas nas bskyod byas nas/ /sku la na bza' dmar pos ni/ /yang dag par ni dgab par bya/ /dpal gyi dkyil 'khor mtha' ru ni/ /sa mnyam gnas su rgyal ba dze+e /ri mo lnga ni zis nas su/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /rang gi rigs kyi phyogs song ba/ /mtshan ma lnga yis brgyan pa dzi /de yi dbus su ga ga par bya/ /lha dang lha mo'i sku gzugasashekyi/ /zhal ni ⑧pad+ma logs su bya/ /mchod rten la sogs glegs bam dang / /de bzhin du ni bris sku ka /de la sngags pa kha phyogs bya//rgyal ba mchog dang lhan cig a /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin du zhes bya/ /phyi nas sngon gsungs rnal 'byor la / /zla ba nyi ma me skyes la/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /rig ma lha mo rdzogasad+kusangs 7—1239

rgyas| /phywali kā li rigs skyes shing / /rang rang sa bon las skyes rnams/ /snying ga mgrin pa lte ba dang / /spyi bo spyi gtsug 'khor lo ru/ /rigs kyi dbang gis bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin du ni bsgom bya ba/ /slar la yang ni lha rnams —/ /ma lus pa 4rang lus la/ /ye shes sems dpa' bkug nas ni/ /gnyi ga mnyam par bya ba'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rang lus la/ /gzhug dang bcing dang mnyes pa dang / /ro mnyam bya phyir lha rnams bstem / /de nas slob dpon nyid kyis ni/ /lha rnams zhal bsil phyag ni bya/ /lha dang lha mo rnams kyis —/ /sa bon asogs ka sogs dang / /rang rig yon tan gyis song ba/ /snying gisnyedabus su sa bon te/ /zla ba nyi ma sbyangs pa dze+e /sku dang gsung dang thugs su ldan②/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan zhingakhu/ /lus ni ma lus par son pa'i/ /mkha' brgyadagasal byed rnams ni 'god/ /⑤de nyid dbyangs kyis phye ba ni/ /glegs bam rnams kyi yi ge dngaka /'dab ma lasteni rnam par dgog /mchod rten nang du dpal 'khor lo/ /me dang nor bu lad+ma yis/ /dbus su ral gri'i ri mo'o/ /⑧hūṃ las gyur pa'i bgrang phreng di/ /ri tsayongs su bgrang ba ni/ /gsal byed rnams kyi mtshan nyid do| /dril bu'i lus la dbyangs rnams te/ /bcu 4sum 'gyur byas pa yi| /ka sogs sde tshan rdo rje ma/ /mchod phyir thogs la sogs pa dang / /gong mashebacu yis bgrangs pa zhi /gsal byed rnams ni sgrog byed la/ /ka sogs sde tshan gug skyed bcas/ /nayomakhar ro dang yon tan rnams/ /rnal 'byor rang la bsgom par bya/ /ha hā dpal gyi rna cha la/ / la nibyuzung gcig mgul do dang / /ske rags dag ladagod pa'o/ /de bzhin wage yoni 7—1240

zung / /gdu bu dag la dgod par bya/ /g.yer kha rnams la ha hā gnyig /rnam pa lnga yi stong pa ni/ /lus ni ma lus par khyab pa'i/ /thal ba yang ni bsgom/ par bya/ /rang lus yeshes rnam pa'o/ /rigs gsum gtso bo lhan cig pa'o/ /phung po khams sogs kun la sogs / /rang gi snying gi⑧pad+ma ni/ /sa bon so so'i rim pa yis/ /lha rnams dgod par bya ba ni/ /mchod rten lder so la sogs la/ /sa bon bkod pas rab gnas 'gyur/ /rang sgolus la sa bon dbab/ /lag pa la ni rigs kyi gtso/ /sdud pa yoni dus su min/ /ri mor bris pa'i bris sku rnams/ /'di ru me long la ni khrug /byas nas dri dang spos dang ni/ /dri zhim me tog gis mchod bya/ /glu dang gar dang rol mo dang / /gos kyi mchog ni⑧sna tshogs pa/ /rnga yab gdugs rnams kyis ri mchod/ /de ltar rab gnas byas nas ni/ /dri yi mchog ni sna tshogs pag /dge 'dun la ni ston mo bya/ /khron pa rdzing dang mtshe'u dang / /phyogs bzhi mtshams ni bzhi po ru/ /klu yi rgyal po rnams ni dgod/ /mtshon bdun rang gi sa bon ni/ /sprang rtsi chu dang ldan pa dze+e /ba alnga ni gzhug par bya/ /sbyin sreg mthar ni rdzing sogs su/ /chu lha dkar mociphyag na ni/ /zhagasapa bsnams pa bsgom par bya/ /skyed mos tshal dang dpag bsam shing / /yang na kun du bskyed pa'i shing / /shing gcig pa la gtor bar bya/ /de nas rab gnas zin pa dang / /dam pa yi ni man ngag gig /rdzogs pa'i dbang rnams rim bzhin sbyin/ /ci 'byor pa shitshogs 'khor dang / /dpa' bo yi ni ston mo bya/ /srid pa rnam pa gsum song ba'i/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sems can yang / /yeshes lcags kyus bkug nas ni/ /snying rjes dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ /sangs rgyas bdud rtsi'i rdo 7—1241

rje yis/ /lus ni zla ba lta bur 'gyur/ /rdo rje can gyi lam rnyed nas/ /rang gi gnas su gtang bar bya/ /nyon mongs pa dang bral ba las/ /byang chub spyod pa rjes su gzhol/ /de nas dkyil 'khor mdun du ni/ /slob mas yon gyi tshogs ①rnams dbul/ /lus kyi nang gi drug cha ni/ /lag pa kang pa dag dang lus/ /yan lag mchog ni sbyin pa dag /slob dpon la ni rab phul na/ /bde ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ / phyag rgya bzang mos rjes su ②dbye/ /las kyi dbang po rnams las tshig /dbang po rnams kyi nang nas yid/ /yon dang bcas pa dbul bar bya/ /khams kyi nang nas cha drug pa/ /rkang pa gnyis dang phyugs kyi tshogag /de kho na yi cha ga nasnyeni/ /cod pan dar dang do shal dang / /gdu bu yang ni de bzhin te/ /rna cha ka ④bo che la sogag /slob dpon la ni rab phul zhing / /rang gi nus pas yon rnams ni/ /dbul lo mi yi bdag po kye/ /ma lus tshogs kyi rigs la yang / /bsod nams rgyu ru dbul ba ni/ /ga na gyi don du pon lam ga ba/ /bsod nams 'di yis sems can rnams/ /bcom ldan rnam pa gsum gyisasteni/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /de nas bzod par gsol ba ni/ /rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma ru/ /ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ /pad+ma'i bar gyi rdul tshon rnams/ /chu bo gtsang mar bskyur bar bya/ /dam pa dang po'i rgyud rgyal mthong nas bdag gis ni/ /rim bzhin rjes su sbyar gyisakhya rang bzor byas pa min/ /slob ma dam pas gsol btab ngor byas kyi/ /nga rgyal la sogs grags pa'i dbang gis min/ /bdag gis cho ga 'di byas pag /blo dang ldan pas rtogs pa dang / /byed po dge ba spel ba dang / /bstan bcos rnyed dang ldan par shog /dpal yid du 'ong ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dpal dus kyi 'khor 7—1242
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (184)7—1246

sa / /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa sgrub ba'i thabs/①༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ 1kā la tsakra sa ha dza sā rnya dze+e bod skad du/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'jigs 'jig rten 'jigs skyobs pa/ /bud med sbyor la tshangs par spyod/ /thugs rje shes rab dbyer med pa②/ /phyag 'tshal de bsgrub mdo tsam sga /rab tu bsngags pa'i sa yi chag/ /sngags pa rab tu yid dge bas/ /maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa byas la/ /gtor ma sbyin pa sngon 'gro bas/ /bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas rdzusnyilas rdo rje'i khang pa brtsegs pa bsams la| dbus su 'damatsoskyes dang / nyi ma la/ hūṃ rab tu dkar ba las 'od 'phros te/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa bkug nas/ mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya'o/ /stong pa rlung dang me dang chu/ /sa dang rgya mtsho ro pad+ma/ /zla ba nyi ma me dkyil du/ /rin chen khang brtsegs 'od 'phro bsgom/ /zla ba nyi ma ma 7—1247

steng du/ /drag po 'dod lha'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje dang ni dril 'dzin 'ag/ /gangs ri ltar dkar btsun mor bcas/ /pha rol phyin drug dag pa'i rgyan/ /yon tan thams cad tshad med ①pas/ /tshad med dag pa'i chos ldan pa//sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /lte bar sangs rgyas yum bcas bsregs/ /spyi bor zla ba bzang rgyun 'dzag /chos 'byung gnyis 'dus rdo rje can/ /srid gsum yang dag bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor las/ /shes rab pad+mar sems thig le/ /lhan cig skyes pa de ②dbang gis/ /mi shigs 'od gsal bsgo bar ⑧'gyur/ /bsnyen pa bdud rtsi lnga la sogs/ /rigs kyi gtso bo bzhi dag ni| /sngags kyis bzlas pa la sogs pa/ /so sor sdud pa la sogs 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+ma las skyes pa'i/ /bdud rtsi nye bar sgrub pa'o/ /dga' ba la sogs rdo rje gsum/ /pad+mar mnyam song bsgrub par 'gyur/ /shes rab sbyor la mi 'dzag gang / /sgrub ④pa chen po nyid 'gyur te/ /phra mo yi ni sbyor bas so/ /de bzhin ga na ni gzhan du 'gyur/ /mchog tu gsang ba khyab bdag las/ /rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag pas ni/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin rtagag /byug rgyu nam mkha' la sogs mthong / /skakā la tsakra ā hoḥswā hā/ skahūṃ hri rngo hūṃ : hra swā hā/ chabadz+ra jotī shā re t+pahūṃkhuswā hā/ ting nge 'dzin las skyo na/mdo li la sogs pa'i rnam pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /nyi ma dang / zab dang /dus dang / ro dang / rgya mtsho dang / me dang / nam mkha' de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /gtor ma ni mtshan byed nasnyesbyin par bya ste/ dus dang | ro'i yi ges byin gyis brlabs la/ rgya mtsho dang / mig gi phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ prad+me/ baju ṣ+pedz+ra tre⑨/ bā yu/ yim/7—1248

asnye| sa.u tre/ rdzi①shwa ren+d+ra/ ya k+ṣe khyug sa pa ri wāre sprug charda ba gog:—/ pu྾/ dhū paṃ/ dri paṃ/ ak+ṣa lta da dā ma nyi/ te dza gaka t+ya/ sa pa ri wāre/ shrī shā charda ba chakṛṇ+ḍa⑧saṃ j-isnya/ hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa badz+ra rnya ra ā ④pa ya ti sru hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis so/ /nor mchog gtong ba sbyin pa ste/ /yum sbyor mi 'dzag tshul khrims so/ /sgra sogs mi 'dzug bzod pa ste/ /gnyis spong le lo med brtson 'grus/ /kun nas mi g.yeng bsam gtan mchog /bde sbyor 'od gsal shes rab yin/ /de 'bras bsam mi khyab rmad byung / he ru ka dpal brjod pa'o/ /de ltar cung zad dus 'byung rgyud/ /snying po sbas pa 'di phyung bas—/ /sgrub po yang dag sbyor rnams la/ /ye shes me chen 'bar bar 'gyur/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dus kyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po burtsetsoṭītshwa na dang / lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyes bsgyur ba'o// //7—1249

2thabyed/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo skad cig gis bskyed pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byed bya ba/①byed/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭīkā⑧la tsakra ri ṭi ti sa ha dza sā dha rna nā byed/bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo skad cig gis babyed pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i byed thabs zhes bya ba/ bde ba byed po'i sku la phyag 'byed lo/ /rnam pa dang bcas rnam pa med pa'i babyed ldan 'das ma shes rab ma des rab tu byed//skyo'ajig rnam par spangs pa'i mi byed bde la dgodasrepa la sogs rnams dang bral ba yibyed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byed par mdzad pa'i sku gsum dang bcas dus gsum yang dag mabyed pa po/ /thams cad mabyed pa dang po'i mabyed gi sangs rgyasaganyis med de la phyag 'byed lo/ /dang po skad cig gcig gis stong pa la gnas phyi nas de bzhin skad cig gis babyed ⑦pa/ /sna tshogs chu skyes zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas dbang phyug dang / /'dod lha dag gi snying gar g.yas brkyang shin tu sngo ba rdo rje dril bu dang ldan phyag gnyis kyis/ /sna byed6

tshogs yum gyi sku la yang dag 'ag pa'i dpal ldan mnga' bdag dus 'khor go / sprin nag lta bu'i ral pa'i tshogs la ta ma la mtshungs mi bskyong pa la sogs pas spras| /phyag rgya drug gis kyang ni rab spras thod pa dkar po'i phreng bas bcings pa gang | /mi mgo'i do shal spyan gsum gser mtshungs sku mnga' gri gug pad snod dang ldan phyag gnyis ma/ /dpal ldan sna tshogs yum dang gnyis med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin la sogs bsgom par bya/ /de nas khams gsum rang dang mtshungs par ldan pa de rnams ma lus lha mo'i sku la bzhugs / /de yang rang la rang lus gdan dang bcas pa nyi ma la ste nyi ma hūṃ la'o/ /sna②ni ha la de yang mgo bo la ste de nyid zla ba phyed pa nyid la'o/ /zla phyed thig le de nyid nā da de bzhin nam mkha' kha rlangs me long la phog mtshungs/ /de ltar 'od gsal zhugs nas slar yang snga ma dang mtshungs gzugs su dran par byas pa dngaka /sprul pa sna tshogs khams gsum rnams su nam mkha' khyab par skad cig gis ni spro bar bya/ /de ltar yang ni de bzhin bsdu zhing yang ni de ltar bskyed cing spro ba de bzhin du/ /mnyam par ga gasnyepa'i zung 'jug lam dngasnyi'adi yis —/ /sangs rgyas zhabs la yang dag 'gro bar 'gyur/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gang byas pa yi pebasod nams 'dis/ /'jig rten pa rnams lhan skyes kyangaste/ /gnyis med rang bzhin zhabs thobasanyashog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// // paṇ+ḍi ta bā gri shwa ra dang / lo tsā ba chos rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //⑧7—1252

rnal 'byer rab gsal zhes bya ba/①ra ga /rgya gar skad du/ spyokā la tsakra sā dha na yo ga pa dri sna hwa yi/bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor rab gsal zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi byams pas 'jig rten la gzigs pa/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi galasnyeb sna tshogs 'di/ /de ni dpal ldan dus 'khor ting 'dzin rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas dzad la phun tshogs mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa'i rgyas 'grel sogs/ /med par mkhas pas rgyud mang rtogs pa min/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas thos nas rdzogs byang chub/ /legs grub gnyer rnyed phyir na bde thob 'gyur/ /de yi sgrub thabs rjes dran bya ba la/ /bdag ni mkhas min sdeb sbyor mchog yod min//de lta na yang rang nyid dran ched du/ /bdag gis bgyid de mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod/ /rlung me chu sa lhun po dang / /sna tshogs chu skyes dkyil pad+mar/ /7—1254

zla nyi sgra gcan bdud dbang phyug /rol par g.yas brkyang zhabs ga la zhing //sna tshogs yum la snyoms 'jug pa/ /gcig tu rang gzhan don phun tshogs/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid zhi ba ni/ /gnyis su med cing rtog pa spangs/ /'gyur med bde ba chen po gang / /stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /de dran chos dang rjes mthun pas/ /sgrub thabs kun du 'dris par bya/ /srid pa'i skyebar kun rmongs las skyes pa'i/ /mngal gyi sdug bsngal dag kyang mtha' yas shing / /byis pa gzhon nu nyid dang long tsho dang / /rgan po la yang srid par bar du 'jig /de la mi yi dngos po rnyed dka' ste/ /chos bzhin spyod pa shin du rnyed par dka'/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang theg pa chen po dang / /de la gus pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /brtan rnams mtha' dag gsang ba'i bsam gtan la'ang / /gang zhig tshe na rab tu 'jug par byed/ /de las sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba la/ /tshema'o 'jug pa shin tu dka' ba nyid/ /des na blo ldan rnams kyi mgo dang —/ /gos la me shor bzlog pa ltar sgrubs bya/ /snying rje che ldan rnal 'byor pa/ /rmongs dang nga rgyal la sogs spang / /chu sogs bden dang rjes gnang dang / /bum pa gsang ba mchog gsum dang / /shes rab chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /bla ma dam pa'i rim thob pa/ /gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing / /skyodagu rnams kyang bder gnas la/ /gang na sa 'dzin rtsod med pa/ /der ni bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /skyed tshal ri bo rgyal ba bzhugs/ /grub pa'i lha gnas stong pa dang / /dur khrod dang ni chu 'gram dang / /gnas gtsang dang ni sa phug dang / /gang du sems ni nyams dga' bar/ /ci 'byor pas ni mchod par bya/ /dang por re zhig rnal 'byor pas//7—1255

kun nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bas / /bde ba'i lam la stan 'dug nas/ /sngon du khro dbang nga rgyal bya/ /snying gar sna tshogs chu skyes nyi/ /dbus su sa bon hūṃ bsgom bya/ /de 'od dkyil gsal srung 'khor mchog /rgya la rgya mtsho gabyung bsgoms nas/ /phyag 'tshal sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i rnam bdun gyi/ /mchod pa bla na med byas nas/ /stong pa nyid la dmigs par bya/ /lha yi skur ri bskyed pa dang / /lus sogs rnam par sbyong ba rnams/ /rim pa ji bzhin brjod bya ste/ /de rnams sngags kyang go rims bzhin/ /r+sha.ā hūṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥprasto pā yā ka kā ya nywarmi dz+nyā ṭ+wā dhi pa te ma ma kā ya 3gyi brdza badzā mṛ ta swa bhā baṃ ku ru ku ru skarnya d+ma two ya ta dz+wa ni swa bhā baṃ swā hā/de nas gtsug tor steng gi char/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ /de ni waṃlas byung ba bsgom/ /gtsug tor nas ni rkang sen mthar/ /sbrul gyi shun pa bzhin du ni/ /lan gsum dor bas gnyug ma'i lus/ /bdag gi lus de de nas ni/ /dge ba'i las la zla bar bsam/ /dbang sogs rgyas par ma brjod do/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /chaswa bhā wa shumasarba dharmāḥsu ṅgā wa shustolhahaṃ/ dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga dang / /lte ba gtsug tor gsang ba la//r+shachahūṃ hoḥde nas ni/ /haṃ k+ṣaḥyi ge rim pas sbyar/ /'od dpag med dang rin chen dbang / /de nas don yod rnam snang mdz+wad/ /mi bskyod pa dang rdo rje 'dzin/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan 'chad 'gyur bzhin/ /chachasar+pā sta rā dza mā ra gre shā— ka ra badz+ranywakyā duḥkhamyu da ma ma ka re bi sho dha ya ṭ+wā hā/ sngags 'di yang dag brjod byas nas/ /lag pa phan tshun nye bar bya/ /adze+el sogs thung ngu ni/ /g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung 'og tshigs nas/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong 7—1256

steng tshigs sogs/ /lngasogs ring po lnga pa gsum/ /r+yachaṛ u ka tshe.e ar amal/ ha ya ra wa la/ zhes pa dang / lnga wā rā yā hā/ sgo cha.ā i lga ljo lcadzā k+ṣiṃzhes pa'o/ /lag pa kha sbyar dbus su ni/ /hūṃ gi yi ge mchog tu sngo/ /zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan byu/ /sa bon gyis ni rtse lnga bcing / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya de yis ni/ /gtsug tor rkang sen mthar thug reg /chat+pahūṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥkā ya lnga tshwa ṭ+wā snyi pashete badz+ra ka ya ma ma kā ya lnga tshwa na brdza badz+ra kā ya ga bhā baṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /de nasar rgyal bya ste/skasarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra tā ya swa bhā ba ā kopho zhes bya'o/ /blo ldan rigs drug rnams bkod nas/ /de nas yan lag drug dgod bya/ /lag gnyis kha sbyar byas nas ni/ /mthe bong zung dag snying gar dgod/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo nyer bsdu ba/ /lugs las bzlog pa'i rim pas brjod/ /ma dz+dza da yā ya na ma—/ /— hūṃ shi ra se swā hā/ r+shasgyu shi khā yi bo ṣaṭa/ /r+shahri ka pa tsā ya hūṃ/lag gnyis dag gis lus kun la/ /reg cing 'di ni yang dag brjod/ /cha hūṃ de tā ya ba ṣaṭa/ /chahraḥm ya phaṭa/ mdzub mo dang ni mthe bong gi /se gol lag pa g.yon pas bya'o/ /mi dge ba la lag g.yas kyi/ /phyogs kun du yang mtshon cha mchog /de yi 'og tu blo bzangs kyis/ /'dir yang stong nyid bsgom par bya/ /brtan par byed pa'i sngags rnams kyang / /'chad par 'gyur ba nyid bzhin no/ /rlung sogs dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ /steng du de yongs gyur pa las/ /ring du mthong ba'i mtshams kyi mtha'/ /der ni ra ba gsum pa'o/ /yul 'khor bsrung phyir yul 'khor mthar/ /ra ba lnga yang de bzhin no/ /kun gyi 'og tu mdung dang ni/ /steng du mda' yi dra ba'o/ /7—1267

dbus su rdo rje sa gzhi ni/ /yul 'khor mthar yang bsgom par bya/ /tho rangs grib ma'i mtshalas kyi mthar/ /khang pa brtsegs pa'o de nang du/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'am 'khor lo ste/ /de dbus nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /chahūṃ yo dzā 4 lo badzā kā sha bā yu te dza u da ka thra ji badz+ra swa bhā ba palca — ta bo badz+ra maṇ+ḍa lnga ni ku ru ku ru snga hā/ zhes pa 'og tu dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i sngags so/ /cha.āḥhūṃ raḥbadz+ra tsan+d+ra srur+ya rā hu kra khāsna 06kā ya 2lo badz+ra thā ka rā na ku ru ku ru sru hā/ zhes pa ra ba'i sngags so/ /ma bai shā ka ya badz+ra badz+ra kyu ṭā shā ram̐ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa khang pa brtsegs pa'i sngags so/ /chab shwa badz+ra pad+ma ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa pad+ma'i sngags so/ /skaḥbadz+ra srur+ya badz+ra srut+yā sa rna ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa nyi ma'i gdan gyi sngags so/ /hūṃ yig rdo rje las skyes pa'i/ /rdo rje shugs ri gtso bo bzhin/ /dbu ni g.yas 'gying glang lngags gyon/ /nyi shu rtsa drug phyag ldan pa'i/ /khro dbang rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /klu bcu yis ni rgyan du byas/ /ral pa dar dpyangs phyag gdub dang / /ske rags mgul rgyan rkang gdub rim/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal zhes bya dang / /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma zhes/ /gnyis rnams dang po g.yon shes bya/ /nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong dang / /mtha' yas de bzhin rigs ldan dang // /'jog po pad+ma che dag go/ /ma lus bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /sku las me 'od 'phros pas bsregs| /mtha' yas zhing rdul grangs 'das pa'i/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi 'od can/ /bsams nas de snying pad nyi la/ /ha ya ra wa la rnams brtsegs/ /thung ngu ring pos rab phye ba/ /de rnams bcu ni rtsibs bcur spro/ /ha yig las skyes gtsug tor can/ /rtsa zhal gyi ri snyan g.yon las/ /phyung ste khang 7—1258

brtsegs steng dbus su/ /zla ba'am nyi mar snang bar bsgoms/ /snyan g.yas nas byung gnod mdzes ni/ /hā skyes rdo rje sa 'og tu'o/ /bgegs mthar byed pa yi las skyes/ /shangs bug g.yon nas shar du'o/ /shangs bug g.yas nas me mtshalas su/ /yī las byung ba'i dbyug sngon can/ /j-i skyes shes rab mthar byed ni/ /g.yon pa'i spyan las lho ru spro/ /: las byung ba'i 'dod rgyal ni/ /g.yas pa'i spyan las bden bral du'o/ /'dir ni skyeba'i rim nyid kyis/ /dang por gnod sbyin dbang ldan mchog /lhag ma chu dang rlung gi phyogs/ /rim pa las ni bzlog pa yin/ /lu yig yongs su gyur las skyes/ /pad+ma mthar byed zhal sgo las/ /lha yig las byung mi g.yo ba/ /gci ba'i sgo nas nges par skyes/ /bshang lam sgo nas phyung ba ni/ /lo yig las skyes gshin rje gshed/ /rdo rje gtsug tor nas phyung ba/ /skṛ yig las chen stobs chen te/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'di rnams kun/ /mi mnyam gzi ldan gtso bo mtshungs/ /ma lus bgegs ni 'joms mdzad cing / /bdud bzhi zad par mdzad rnams so/ /so sor bsdu ba'i rim nyid kyis/ /nga 'og nya ṇa ma na rnams/ /bsams te zad par nam mkha' sogs/ /de ltar sgo rnams las byung spro/ /khang brtsegs steng dang g.yon mdzes drung / /gzhan ni khang brtsegs phyi rol du/ /stong pa rlung me chu dang sa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lnga pa zung la'o/ /de bzhin gza' dang klu rnams dang / /'byung po rnams kyang gdan la'o/ /zad par gza' dang 'byung po rnams/ /mtshon cha 'dod ma sogs ji bzhin/ /khro bo phyogs skyong klu rnams kyi/ /dbyibs ni 'chad 'gyur ji bzhin no/ /klu yis khro bo rnams kyang 'dir| /zhal gsum phyag drug spyan gsum pa'o/ /'di kun ming gi rim pa 7—1259

yang / /gtor ma'i sngags ni ji bzhin no/ /ra ba gsum par phyogs skyong dang / /gza' rnams 'chad 'gyur gdan la'o/ /phyi rol ra ba lnga rnams la/ /de bzhin klu dang 'byung po spro/ /snya dzha rte bha dha rnams brtsegs/ /phyogs skyong sa bon go rims bzhin/ /ga dza ḍab da rnams brtsegs/ /gza' rnams rim pas 'byung ba'o/ /kha tsha ṭha pha tha rnams brtsegs/ /rim pa ji bzhin klu'i sa bon/ /katsa ṭa pa ta rnams brtsegs/ /'byung po rnams ni rim pas 'byung //ra ba gsum dang ra ba lnga'i/ /phyi dang nang du de bzhin no/ /de dag rnam par gnon byed pa'i/ /steng dang 'og tu gnas pa spro/ /ye shes mkha' rlung me dang chu/ /sa yi khams las yang dag byung / /srung ba'i 'khor lor gnas pa drug /gnyis gnyis sems dag lus srung ba'o/ /lus las 'jig dus me 'bar bas/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa bsregs/ /mkha' khyab me stag tshogs 'phro ba'i/ /'khor lo 'dir di rnam par bsgom/ /de nas mnyam par ga ga pa yis/ /bdud sreg pa ri bsgrags par bya/ /cha.ā hūṃ7ho haṃ k+ṣaḥhraḥhraḥhraḥhraḥr ra ra ra badz+ra na la sar+pā ba ra ṇa dharma pra la ya ga bhā ba sarbasnyemā ra kā yi ka bisna be+eṭ+wā ya kā dri rmā da sha dig tā rmā kā ya lnga ni da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bhathi ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa bdud sreg pa'i sngags so/ /bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs rnams/ /rdo rje lcags kyus dbang byas te/ /rdo rje zhags pa yis kyang ni/ /bcing pa lnga yis bcings par bsgom/ /khro dbang rdo rje phur bu —/ /lte ba'i 'og nas mdung gi tshul/ /phyogs bcu rnams su gdug pa dze+e /steng du bying bar bsam par bya/ /sngags ni/ cha āḥhūṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra tī la ka ka ya lnga 1 na snyi pa te gzu 7—1260

kurban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra dha ra k+ṣiṃtsā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pa khro bo thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /chuba.ā hūṃ hoḥ.ā kā sha wā yu te dza u da ka thra sbyi sā rnyi te bh+yaḥs pa ri wā re zhes pa la sogs pa lhag ma snga ma bzhin te zad par gyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ.āḥhūṃ hoḥbrah+ma biju ṣ+pej-i t+ya bā yu yā mā— sa mu dre shā ren+d+ra yaste bh+yaḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /sgo ā hūṃ hoḥrā hu kra lāsna tsan+d+ra srur+ya burtse me ga la shu kra thra haspa ti ke tu sha de bh+yaḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa gza'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /r+sha.ā hūṃ hoḥdza ya bi dza ya pad+ma na ṭa ga bā su ka shaṃ khā pā la ku li kā nasto tak+ṣa ka ma hā pad+me byuḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa klu'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /cha.ā hūṃ hoḥbe tā ḍabi kṛ ta mu kha shā ka ka shu ka ra kṛ za byu sbyo phru ka dzakhru ga ru ḍa mu khe bh+yaḥs pa ri zhes pa la sogs pa thams cad snga ma bzhin te 'byung po'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /gtor ma rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs| /mchod pa'i rnam pa yang dag ldan/ /med na yid kyis bsgom par bya/ /bza' bca' la sogs rgya che ba/ /shing rta khur dang zangs mo dze+e /thal mo la sogs bar du yang / /g.yon dang g.yas dang zung gis bkab/ /nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya dang/ /sku yi rdo rjes sbyang bar bya/ /gsung gi rdo rjes rtogs bya ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rjes sbar bar bya/ /ye shes kyi ni bdud rtsi dgug /rtse lnga gri gug ral gri dang/ /rin chen chu skyes 'khor lo yis/ /phyag rgyas de rnams la gtor ma/ /dbul zhing 'thor 'thung sogs kyis mchod/ /dril bu'i sgra dang bstod pa bya/ /ye shes nam mkha' rlung me chu/ /sa yi rang bzhin de rnams kyang / /haṃ a lnga ṛ u lo bsam/ /kra mā dā pa rak+ṣe na sa ste/ /'khor lo drug tu gshegs gsol bya/ /ma cig nyid la dgug bya ste/ /ji 7—1262

skad bstan pa thams cad nyid/ /ces pa gsungs pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin/ /'dod ma'i grogs dang ldan pa yang / /kha ri dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi ril bu kha ru gzhug /yang na lus dag bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas lus reg nas/ /dang por skad cig rnam pa yis/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku/ /thugs kar paṃ skyes pad dmar 'dab brgyad pa'am/ /yang na i skyes sna tshogs pad+mar ni/ /zla ba nya ba la ni hūṃ yig sgo /de las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /gzi brjid las skyes sangs rgyas tshogs rnams ni/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa'i phyir du yang / /'khor lo'i gtso bo rnams kyang bsgom par bya/ /brtsegs pa'i sa bon las byung ba/ /dri chab ma sogs lha mo ni/ /kun nas 'od kyis bkug rnams kyis/ /mngon par snyerdo byebye khye /rdo khye hūṃ khye/ ༷ rdo/ khye rdo/ byek+ṣiṃ / /l+lī skre rdo/ bye dhī / bye bye bye bye rdo/bye khye // dh+rid / bye/ rdo/ bye / rdo aX / //snye/ / ༷ bye bye sbyor rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dam chos dang bcas tshogs rnams la/ /bdag ni 7—1263

gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /de rnams re re la yang de snyed kyi/ /de la bos pa shin tu yid 'phrog pa/ /dri chab ma sogs lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dri bzang la sogs rnams kyis mchod pa bgyi/ /bgyis dang bgyid durol dang ga na rnams la/ /rjes su yid rangs btang snyoms ga ga pa ste/ /srid par lus sogs las skyes nyes pa dang / /sdig pa ma lus pa dag bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa du mas chos la mchog mdzad dang / /gzhan gyi dge ba byas pa gang yin la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /mchog gi brtse bas khyab par gyur pa yi/ /kun du chags las ma chags bde ba 'byung / /thar pa'i thabs ni rab tu sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /kun du rtog pa ma lus kun nas spangs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi phun tshogs brten/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis su med pa'i chos/ /rnam pa gnyis la rab tu skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos/ /dam pa'i yon tan mnga' ba tshogs kyi mchog /chags pa'i zhags pa'i tshogs las nges grol bar/ /'gyur ba de la nges par skyabs su mchi/ /sems can rnams kyi ci 'dod don/ /bya phyir bdag gi lus 'di ni/ /shin tu rnam par dag sems kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bapi /rmongs dang dka' thub kyis bskams pa'i/ /'gro ba'i lo tog thams cad la/ /dam chos ston pa'i char pa ni/ /rgyal bas rgyun mi 'chad par mdzod/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i btsan ra las/ /ma grol sems can gcig gi bar/ /de srid skya ngan mi 'da' ba'i/ /brtse ba chen po bstan du gsol/ /gal te gzugs can gyur na 7—1264

zhing gi rdul/ /kun dang mnyam pa'i nam mkha'i tshad las kyang / /lhag par gyur pa'i bsod nams 'di de yang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nyid du bsngo bar bgyi/ /ma lus nyes las nges grol zhing / /yon tan kun gyis brgyan gyur pa//ye shes rgya mtsho rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sems can don phyir 'grub par shog /byang chub sems ni babyed bgyi zhing / /bsam pa rnam par dag pa babyed/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa spangs/ /rtsa ba gsum ni dran par bgyi/ /sbyin sogs phyogs dang tshangs gnas bzhi/ /bsdu bzhi dge ba rnam bcu bsten/ /sgrib pa lnga dang nyon mongs dang / /de bzhin zag pa bzhi po spang / /de nas dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /bsgom pa bsgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin stong nyid las/ /kun nas ston mongs rnam byang skyes/ /de lta na yang kun rdzob yo /bsngags pas dkyil 'khor dbang phyug bsgrub/ /ji ltar mthar ni chu yis me/ /'jig ste sa yang bzhuspabar gyur/ /chu ni rlung gis skems byed cing / /rlung ni stong par 'jug par byed/ /kun gzhi rnam par shes pa'i semag /mkha' dbyings yul dang bral gyur pa/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan gzugs/ /dbu ma'i gnas su gzhag par bya/ /de nas chashu n+ya tā tshwa na badz+ra sa bhā bāt+pa kolhahaṃ/ ska.a ni mit+ta tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā bād+ma kophohaṃ/ r+sha.a pra ni nyi ta 1 na badz+ra swa bhā bād+ma kophohaṃ/ oṃ.a na bhi saṃ sku ra 1 na badz+ra swa bhā bāt+pa ko3haṃ/ 'di ni phyi ru chos 'byung ste/ /ma yi lus la gru gsum mo/ /de dbus py-ingh+rushāsdu dī rngo ༵py-i ṭā dī /gas//a lardo/ rdo rnyi paX rdo rdos rnasbyi/ la//:de/ tha da 7—1266

ka'i tshad ni dpag tshad dag /'bum phrag bzhi gsum gnyis gcig go/ /nag dmar ser dang dkar ba ste/ /sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis kyis mtshan/ /rgyal mtshan bkra shis chu skyes dang / /rdo rjes kyang ni de rnams mtshan/ /dbyibs ri/gzhu dang zur gsum dang / /rlum po gru bzhi go rims bzhin/ /ma yig las skyes lhun po dze+e /rin chen rdo rje'i rang bzhin de/ /'og la stong phrag bcu drug dang / /steng la stong phrag lnga bcur brjod/ /de yi byed du k+ṣa las skyes/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'o ha dang ni/ /zla byed thig le las skyes pa'i/ /zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gzugs/ /nang du dpral ba sogs kyang ngo / /de steng hūṃ 'phros rdo rje ni/ /'bar ba'i sa dang gur nang du/ /'od gsal hūṃnyayig las byung ba'i/ /khang pa brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ /'og tu chaskyes dbus kyi ni/ /pad+mar nyi zla sgra gcan 'dzin/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor pad+ma rnams/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis de zhes bya/ /ru yig ye shes las skyes par/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gdan rnams so/ /phyi rol dag tu bzhon pa'i steng / /zla ba nyi ma spangs pa dze+e /brgyad dang bcu gnyis grangs rnams so/ /sgo rnams su ni shing rta bzhi/ /sna tshogs nor bu gser sogs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor de yang 'od gsal te/ /mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing rdul dang / /mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /nam mkha' ji srid mthas gtugs par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phro/ /sangs rgyas byang chub lha rdzas gnas/ /rang bzhin dri med shin tu gsal/ /gzhal med bsod nams ye shes kyi/ /tshogs las byung ba'i nor bus brgyan/ /snying po'i 'khor lo'i nor bu'i nang / /'di ni kun nas dag pa'i mchog /de nas phyi rol de lus la/ /de khams dag par rgyas 7—1266

par brjod/ /chos kyi phung po'i dag pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud bzhin brjod bya ste/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun chos/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rnams kyis ni/ /rdo rje'i thig le bzhi pa ste/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi rnams kyis/ /kun nas gru bzhi pa nyid do/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa yig /sgo3 bcu gnyis po rnams te/ /de bzhin sa ni bcu gnyis kyis//rta babs dag ni ma sa pa rnams/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams kyis/ /phyogs brgyad du ni dur khrod rnams/ /stong nyid bcu drug ka ba rnams/ /khams rnams kyis kyang khang pa brtsegs/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis sgo khyud rnams/ /gzugs can yon tan brgyad rnams kyis/ /'gram rnams dang ni logs rnams nyid| /thugs gsung sku yi dbye bas so/ /tshul khrims la sogs phung po lngas/ /kha dog lnga ni rnam sbyangs pa/ /theg pa gsum gyis ra ba gsum/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs kyis lnga/ /dad sogs stobs rnams dag gis lnga/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la kha khyer te/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa yis/ /rin chen snam bu rnam par bkra//ma 'dres chos ni bco brgyad kyis/ /do shal byed pa de rnams nyid/ /dbang rnams kyis kyang ba kyasnyi/ /dge bas kra ma shīr+ṣa'o/ /stong nyid la sogs rnam thar gyis/ /dril bu'i sgras ni gang ba ste/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas rgyal mtshan gtams/ /spong bas me long rab tu 'bar/ /byang chub yan lag rnga yab g.yo/ /yan lag dgu yi phreng bas brgyan/ /bsdu ba bzhi po rnams kyis ni/ /zur du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /bden pa rin chen bzhi rnams kyis/ /sgo dang sgo khyad mtshams su spras/ /mngon shes lnga yis rtag tu ni/ /rlum skor chen po lnga yis bskor/ /rnam pa kun gyis byang 7—1267

chub spras/ /rdo rje phreng bas legs par bskor/ /bde ba gcig pu'i lcags ri yig/de bzhin ye shes rdo rje 'bar/ /shes rab thabs kyi cha yis ni/ /zla ba nyi ma rtag tu shar/ /thugs gsung sku dang yang dag dag /chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa dze+e /rnga bo che dang byang chub shing / /de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu sogs/ /'di dag dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings dang ldan/ /phun tshogs kun byed bsgo sa nas ni/ /de nas sa sogs ka sogs dgod/ /ces gsungs so/ /thung ngu yon tan yaṇa 'phel ring / /tshes mtha' dag tu e dang ka/a sogs g.yon skor lugs 'byung ste/ /la sogs de las bzlog pa'o/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan rnams ni/ /zlar 'gyur zla ba'i rgyu rnams so/ /la sogs wa ya ḍarte rnams| /yi ge rnam gnyis rnam gnyis brngod/ /la sa ta sogs paṭa tsa/ /ka sogs rang rang gnyis brtsegs nas/ /de rnams gcig pa lugs bzlog las/ /nga gha ga sogs rim pa'o/ /g.yas skor ba dang zung gis ni/ /brgyad cu nyi ma'o nyi ma'i rgyu/ /gang 'di me long sogs rim las/ /dbyangs yig dang po gsal byed rjes/ /gang 'di skyeba'i rim pa las/ /gsal byed dang po dbyangs rjes su/ /des na nyi ma'i steng gi ni/ /zla bar hūṃ yig dri za nyid/ /de rnams kyang ni hriḥru 'gyur/ /de yang haṃ gyur des mtshan pa'i/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga 4bdag /mthon ka chen po'i 'od ltar gsal/ /rgyal ba lnga yi 'od 'phro ba/ /ston par sprul pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /dus kyi 'khor lor mngon brjod pa/ /rdo rje'i rgyan dang sku 'od kyis/ /ma lus nam mkha'i khongs khyab pa/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog bdag nyid/ /dus kyi dbugs 'gags las skyes pa'i/ /gtsug rgyan rna cha mgul rgyan dang / /tshangs skud phyag gdub ske rags dang / /zhabs gdub rdo rje phreng ba 7—1268

dang / /thal ba stag lngagasan bza' dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed dang / /ral par dpal ldan rdor sems 'dzin/ /dpa' bo mi rus rgyan ldan zhing / /thod phreng dang — dar dpyangs can/ /spyan dang phyag dar bcu gnyis te/ /mgrin pa gsum dang zhal bzhi pa/ /nag po mche gcigs drag po ni/ /byams chen rang bzhin las 'khrungs shing / /g.yas pa dmar po phyag dang bcas/ /dga' ba chen po'i thugs las 'khrungs/ /ser 'od ting 'dzin la gnas zhal/ /btang snyoms che las yang dag byungayi/ /g.yon zhal dkar po zhi ba ste/ /snying rje chen po las byung ba'o/ /dbus dang g.yas dang cig shos ni/ /sngo dmar dkar ba'i mgrin gsum ldan/ /sku gcig zhabs gnyis phrag pa drug /dam pa'i phyag ni nyi shu bzhi/ /sum brgya drug cu'i tshigs kyis ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang ldan pas mdzes/ /g.yas pa'i phrag gsum sngo dmar dgan/ /cig shos kyang ni de bzhin te/ /dpung pa gnyis gnyis cig shos kyang / /sngo dmar dkar ba'i rnam pa gsum/ /de bzhin phyag ni bzhi bzhi yang / /sngo dmar dkar ba rnam pa gsum/ /de bzhin phyag sor 'og tshigs nas—/ /sngo dang dmar dang dkar ba nyid/ /sor mo kun kyang sor gdub kyis/ /mdzes shing kha dog lnga ldan te/ /mthe bong la sogs rim pa yis/ /ser dkar dmar dang sngo dang ljang / /nag po'i phyag bzhir⑧rdo rje dang / /ral gri rtse gsum gri gug 'gyur/ /de bzhin dmar por me mda' dang / /lcags kyu cang te'u tho ba nyid| /dkar po bzhir ni 'khor lo mchog /mdung dang dbyug pa dgra sta'o/ /g.yon gyi nag por dril bu mchog /phub dang kha ṭī thod pa ste/ /dmar po bzhir ni gzhu dang zhags/ /rin chen dang ni chu skyes dkar/ /dmar por dpal ldan dung me long / /rdo rje lcags sgog tshangs pa'i mgo /sna tshogs yum gyis sku la 7—1269

'ag| /dpal ldan chayig las skyes pa'i/ /pad+mar zla nyi sgra gcan gzugs/ /steng du bdud dang dbang ldan gyi/ /brang gi mthil la nyi gzhon dang / /zla 'od ltar gsal zhabs gnyis po/ /g.yas brkyang du ri rol pas bzhugs/ /zhabs g.yas dmar po'i 'og tu ni/ /lag pa bzhi pa'i bdud dmar po/ /gdong gcig me tog mda' lnga dang / /lcags kyu gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin/ /zhabs dkar 'og tu dbang ldan yang / /dkar po gdong gcig mig gsum pa/ /lag bzhi rtse gsum ḍa ma ru/ /kha ṭī ga dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dga' ma u ma gdong dman cing/ /kun du 'khrul pa yang dag skyes/ /skra grol gos dang bral gyur pas/ /rang gi rje bo'i kang mtha' 'dzin/ /gtso bo'i mgul la 'ag pa yi/ /sna tshogs yum ni gser gyi mdog /gtso bo'i rgyab zhal gtsor gyur lta'i/ /zhal bzhi dang ni phyag brgyad ma/ /g.yas par gri gug zhags pa dang / /ḍam ru dang bgrang phreng ste/ /g.yon par thod pa zhags pa dang / /chu skyes 'dab brgya⑥nor bu'o/ /spyan gsal bcu gnyis kyis phyug cing / /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan ldan/ /mi 'gyur gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /gtso bo'i byin pa'i ljon shing steng / /rang gi byen pa'i 'khri shing dkris/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /'dab ma brgyad la lha mo brgyad—/ /phyag brgyad spyan ni bcu gnyis ma/ /nag dmar ser dang dkar mo ni//'bar ba mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /phyogs bral 'dab mar du ba dang / /byug rgyu mar me mkha' snang ma/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan kun gyis/ /gtso mo bzhin du brgyan byas ma/ /rang rang mngon phyogs mgon po'i zhal/ /gtso bor gyur 'dra'i zhal bzhi ldan/ /de phyir mgon po'i zhal mdog gam/ /yang na phyi rol phyogs kyang ngo / /me sogs phyogs bral rnams kyang ni/ /rim pa ji bzhin shar 7—1270

phyogs bzhin/ /lha dang sku mdog dag kyang 'dir/ /g.yas skor gyis ni brjod pa nyid| /ga na du rim pa gzhan nyid dang / /yang na spro ba'i rim pas so/ /nag po 'bar ma bdug spos dang / /tsan+dan kha che gla rtsi ni/ /ga pur bcas snod dril bu dang / /yongs 'du'i me tog me tog phreng / /dmar po 'bar ma mar me dang / /do shal cod pan lag gdub gos/ /ske rags rin chen rna rgyan dang / /sil sil byed pa'i rkang gdub ldan/ /ser mo 'bar ma'i g.yas su dung / /gling bu 'od 'phro rin chen dang / /cang te'u g.yon dang pi wang rnga / /khar ba'i rnga dang zangs kyi dung / /dkar mo 'bar ba'i g.yas su yang / /'o ma chu dang sman chang snod/ /g.yon du bdud rtsi grub pa'i ro/ /'bras bu sna tshogs 'bras chan snod/ /du ba ma sogs mtshan ma ni/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad/ /'di dag khro mo'i dbang phyug dang / /lhan cig pha rol phyin bcur bshad/ /yid bzhin nor bu chos gaṇ+ḍi| /dpag bsam shing ni grwa gsum du'o/ /gtso bo'i pad+ma'i sa las phyi'i/ /dbang ldan du ni chos kyi dung / /'dod chags chen pos 'dul ba yi/ /skyebo'i 'jig rten de gzigs nas/ /lus la shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs ni rab tu gzhug /skyes bu rig ma'i rang bzhin las/ /phung po khams sogs rab bcug nas/ /ming dang gzugs sogs ngo bo yis/ /mi snang gyur par rnam par bsgom—/ /lha nyid gzugs kyi sku yis ni/ /mi snang gyur par bar snang du/ /phyunganyabs ji lta ba bzhin du/ /sna tshogs yum la gzhug par bya/ /slar yang de las nges 'thon nas/ /rang gi lus kyi nang du zhugs/ /rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas ni/ /zla ba zhu ba'i rang bzhin las/ /lha mo'i pad+mar rang rang gi/ /sa bon las skyes rdo rje ni—/ /rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /mi bskyong dkyil 'khor bsams te 7—1271

dbyung / /sngon du bcom ldan 'das sku la/ /'gro la phan pa kun sgrub pa/ /bdag po de bzhin bcu gnas ni/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams yangaspadag spro/ /bde chen sbyan las phyi rol du/ /rdo rje phreng ba gnyis kyi bar/ /ral gri phreng sogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /brgyad gnyis ka ba'i bar bar du/ /phyogs kyi pad+mar rdzogs sangs rgyas| /kun tu gzigs rnams spro bar bya/ /thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa//rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag brgyan/ /dam pa'i phyag gis rang nyid la/ /mngon phyogs gzhan rigs shes rab 'ag/ /pad dkar la gnas nyi ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor la ni skyil krung bzhugs/ /rnam shes kyis mtshan spyi bor ni/ /ral pa'i cod pan dar dpyangs can/ /der ni shar phyogs chu skyes las/ /sems can mtha' yas don byed pa/ /don yod grub pa 'di ni nag /dkar dang nag dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /de rnams ye shes lnga rang bzhin/ /phung sogasadag pa'i mtshan nyid do//spyan ma dang ni mā ma tī/ /sgrol ma gos dkar rim pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes rab 'gyur/ /mngon du phyogs pa'i gnas las byung / /sku mdog phyag mtshan rang bzhin yang / /rang rig sangs rgyas rnams dang mtshungs/ /ral pa'i cod pan dbye ba gzhan/ /'di rnams rin chen cod pan can/ /'di ltar thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /sku mdog nag po rnams kyi g.yas/ /ral gri gri gug rtse gsum ste/ /g.yon na phub thod kha ṭī ga /mdog dmar rnams kyis g.yas pa na/ /mda' dang lcags kyu cang te'u/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi mthil gsum du/ /gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /ser po rnams kyi phyag g.yas su/ /'khor lo dbyug pa rdo rje mchog /g.yon phyag gsum du dpal gyi dung / /lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu'o/ /dkar po rnams kyi phyag g.yas su/ /tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum ste/ /g.yon du 7—1272

pad dkar 'dab brgyad dang / /me long dang ni bgrang phreng ngo / /me yi mtshalas nas brtsams byas te/ /chu skyes dmar dang zla dkyil las/ /dpal ldan sgol ma gos dkar mo/ /spyan dang mā ma tī rim bzhin/ /'di rnams thabs ni rim pa bzhin/ /mngon du phyogs pa'i gnas las byung / /rnam snang mdzad dang dpag med 'od/ /las kyi rgyal dang rin chen 'byung / /pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs de rnams kyang / /khams sogs dag pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /sangs rgyas lha mo gnyis bar du/ /re mig brgyad la pad dmar steng / /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa'am/ /yang na pad+ma'i sgod rnams so/ /shar phyogs sgor ni shin tu stobs/ /rmugs byed rengs byed khengs byed rnams/ /khro mo gzhan ni thob pa la/ /de bzhin kho nar rol bar mdzad—/ /phan tshun gzhan rigs las skyes phyir/ /khro bo dang ni khro mo nyid/ /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad la/ /mngon du phyogs pa phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /rengs byed ma dang khengs byed ma/ /shin tu stobs ma zhes bya dang / /rmugs byed ma rnams btsun mo nyid/ /chu skyes dkar dang snang byed la/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi stabs kyis gnas/ /mngal du zla ba bzhi pa la/ /ming gzugs 'byung ba'i skad cig go/ /'byung ba bzhi las byung ba'i gzugs/ /de byed khro bo lhag ma rnams/ /dbang po drug ni 'byung ba la/ /mkha' lding la sogs yang dag spro/ /shar sogs sgo las byung ba yi/ /g.yas su ra ba'i rtsig pa la/ /snam bur dbang por legs dag pa/ /mkha' snying sa yi snying po dang / /rnam sel 'jig rten mgon zhes bya/ /byang chub sems ma phyogs bral du/ /reg bya ro dri gzugs rdo rje/ /ma rnams yul dag pa las skyes/ /shar sogs sgo yi g.yon rnams su/ /kun bzang dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /'di dag 'og dang steng du 'gyur/ /steng dang 'og tu 'gyur ba gzhag /chos 7—1273

dbyengs ma dang sgra ma ste/ /de dag thabs dang shes rab dag /ye shes rnam shes las skyes pa/ /de bzhin sngon po ljang gu'o/ /'di kun g.yas su rim pa yis/ /rdo rje gri gug dgra sta ste/ /g.yon pa rnams su dril bu dang / /thod pa dang ni tshangs mgo bshad/ /'di kun g.yas dang cig shos zhal/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bzhin zhes bshad| /sngon po rnams ni nag po bzhin/ /ljang gu rnams kyi ser po bzhin/ /ji skad bshad pa'i gnas nyid du/ /'di dag bsgom par yang 'dod do/ /skyeba'i gnas kyang gzhan dag tu/ /ga na du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /kha khyer la ni shar g.yas dang / /g.yon du dri dang phreng ba gnyis/ /gshin rjer bdug spos mar me ma/ /nub tu sgeg mo bzhad ma nyid/ /lha bshos dpal ldan bdud rtsi yi/ /'bras bu ma ni byang du'o/ /steng du sgra ma gar mkhan ma/ /'og tu glu ma 'dod ma'o//de yis bar bar mtha' yas pa'i/ /gzung ba'i mtshan ma brjod bya ste/ /dung chos phreng ba sgos phor dang / /mar me dar dpyangs do shal dang / /zan snod bdud rtsi'i 'bras sil snyan/ /gos dang rdo rje mtsho skyes rnams/ /res 'ga' du ba ma la sogs| /lha mo brgyad dang bum pa brgyad/ /yid bzhin nor bu la sogs bzhi/ /dor nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa lta bu nyid/ /lha ni nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /'di yang rang sems nus pa dag /shes nas rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya—/ /gang tshe sems mchog lhan cig skyes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying por gyur/ /de tshe mgon po bzhugs pa la'ang / /ris ni med pa nyid kyis skyon/ /med ces thub pa chen pos gsungs/ /yang na dbang gi don du yang / /dkyil 'khor phyi yi 'khor lo spangs/ /'dir ni khro rgyal gtsug tor dang / /gnod mdzes kyi ni rgyal po dag /steng 'og dag tu gnas pa 'ang bya/ /zla ba drug gis ma rig sogs / /7—1274

drug ni reg pa'i yan lag par/ /bdun par tshor bar skyeb la/ /dbu ma'i dkyil 'khor spro bar bya/ /de la sprul pa'i 'khor lor ni/ /chu tshod drug cu'i rang bzhin gnas/ /shar sogs phyogs su tsa rtsi kā/ /la sogs rdo rje'i ming thogs ldan//sna tshogs zhal dang rgyan bzang can/ /spyan gsum ldan zhing phyag bzhi ma/ /dbang po tshangs pa dbang phyug dang / /glang po'i gdong dang lha min dang / /khyab 'jug mthar byed sbed byed rnams/ /gzhan rigs thabs la 'di dag ni/ /lag pa yis ni kun du 'ag/ /yi dwags dmar dang mkha' 'gro'i dbang / /ma te ltos 'gro za ba dang / /glang po ngang pa khyu mchog dang / /seng ge'i rgyab tu pad+ma brgyad/ /rang rang phyogs su nges gsal ba/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral dmar dang dkar/ /pad+ma'i lte bar zla nyi bral/ /sa ga'i stabs kyis gnas pa la/ /kha dog mtshungs pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams brgyad brgyad kyi/ /'dab mar rol pa'i stabs kyis bskor/ /tsa rtsi kā ni gri gug dang / /mdung dang thod pa kha ṭī 'dzin—/ /khyab 'jug ma ni 'khor lo dang / /dbyug pa pad+ma dung gis mtshan/ /phag mo'i mtshon cha dbyug pa mchog /ral gri dang ni lcags sgog phub/ /gzhon nu ma ni lha rdzas mdung / /lcags kyu zhags pa nor bus mtshan/ /rdo rje dbang mo rdo rje dang / /mda' dang dril bu gzhu 'dzin 'gyur/ /tshangs ma lag par chu skyes dang //tshangs dbyug spyi blugs lhung bzed 'dzin/ /drag mo rtse gsum ḍa ma ru/ /kha ṭī ga dang rtsal gyis mtshan/ /dpal chen mo ni pad+ma dang / /bgrang phreng chu skyes rin chen mtshan/ /de nas de 'dab lha mo yi/ /ming gi phreng ba bshad par bya/ /'jigs ma drag mo dus kyi ni/ /mche ba ma dang me 'bar gdong / /rlung gi shugs ma rab gtum ma/ /spyan drangs ma dang sna chen ma'o/ /gtso bo khyab 'jug ma'i 7—1275

'dab mar/ /dpal mo sgyu ma drag ma dang / /bkra shis ma dang rnam rgyal ma/ /dpal rgyal dpal rgyal byed ma dang / /dpal ldan 'khor lo can ma'o/ /phag mo'i 'dab mar keng rus ma/ /dus mtshan ma dang khros ma dang / /dus kyi lce ma gcigs ma dang / /nag mo drag mo gzugs ngan ma'o/ /pad+ma lus med gzhon nu ma//ri dwags bdag pos 'gro ma dang / /rin chen zeng ma mig bzang ma/ /rus ma brgyad pa bzang mo'o/ /rdo rje 'od dang rdo rje lus/ /gser ldan ma dang urba ste/ /bkra ba'i ri mo rab 'bar grags/ /zug rngu med ma legs sgo ma'o/ /rig byed 'don ma pad+ma'i mig /chu skyes ldan ma blo ma dang / /ngag gi dbang byug glu ma dang //de bzhin glog ma dran ma'o/ /gang du drag mo gtsor gyur der/ /dkar mo gaṅgā rtag ma dang / /myur ma dang ni 'degs ma dang / /mtshon byed dmar ser nag ma'o| /dpal ldan dkar mo zla ris ma/ /zla zhal ma dang ngang pa'i mdog /'dzin ma pad+ma'i dbang mo dang / /skar mig dri med ri bong 'dzin/ /sum cu rtsa drug grangs mnyam pa'i/ /'dod dang phyir 'dod lha mo rnams/ /gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor kha khyer la/ /zhal gcig rang rang phyogs gsal byed/ /phyogs cha re re rnam pa dgu /rol pa'i stabs kyis legs par bzhugs/ /shar du ral gri phub 'dzin te/ /gshin rjer mda' dang gzhu 'dzin rnams/ /klur ni 'khor lo dung 'dzin te/ /nor sbyin tho ba chu skyes 'dzin/ /steng dang 'og gi rigs gnyis ni/ /lag na gri gug thod pa 'dod/ /gsod dang bskyed par 'dod ma ni/ /rta babs rtsa ba 'am steng 'og tu'o/ /'di rnams gang gis bskyed pa ni/ /rgyas par dogs pas ma bshad do/ /zla ba brgyad pa sreg pa yi/ /yan lag sku yi dkyil 'khor spro/ /las dang bya ba'i 'khor lo dze+e /rtsa rnams rnam par dag pa dang / /nag sogs zla 7—1276

ba dag pa las/ /der ni lha rnams bcu gnyis 'gyur/ /rdo rje dang po'i ming ldan pa| /sngar bzhin yang dag ye shes sbyong / /shar sgo'i g.yas nas brtsams byas te//de rnams mkha' snying la sogs bzhin/ /sgra dang sgo yi ngos rnams su'o/ /sgo rnams su ni rang rang gi/ /bzhon pa'i rgyab gnas sgo skyong rnams/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral dmar dang dkar/ /ge sar ze 'bru 'od 'phro ba/ /zla nyi bral ba'i 'dam skyes la/ /rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs rang phyogs mdog /gnyis med shes rab la mngon phyogag /'dab ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/ /rol pa'i rkang stabs kyis gnas pa//kun kyang phyag bzhi kha dog dang / /mtshan ma mtshungs pa'i lha mos bskor/ /yi dwags dmar po bden bral nag /ral gri gri gug phub thod 'dzin/ /ri dwags la ni rlung gi lha/ /ljon shing dbang po'i me tog dang / /in+d+ra rī la ut+pal dmar/ /ma te'i pad+mar gshin rje dbyug /ral gri lcags sgog zhags pa 'dzin/ /ra yi pad+mar me lha mdung / /dbyug pa pad+ma chu skyes 'dzin/ /gdong drug shak+ṇi mdung rin chen—/ /me long ldan par rma byar gnas/ /glang po'i pad+mar gnod sbyin ni/ /rin po che dang be+e con dang / /ṣ+pe'u le dang dung rnams 'dzin/ /dbang po sa srung bu la gnas| /rdo rje dril bu mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /ngang pa'i pad+mar tshangs pa khab/ /bgrang phreng chu skyes spyi blugs can/ /glang gi pad+mar drag po ni/ /mdung dang mda' dang yul gzhu 'dzin/ /chu srin pad+mar rgya mtsho ni/ /zhags pa rin chen ngos gnyis ldan/ /byi ba'i pad+mar tshogs bdag ni/ /dgra sta mchog gi rdo rje dang / /zhags pa dang ni rin chen ldan/ /mkha' 'gro dbang po la gnas pa'i/ /khyab 'jug 'khor lo be+e con dang / /chu skyes skyeb lnga dung 'dzin/ /mchog sde'i don dang rjes mthun par/ /'di rnams phyag rgya 'byung 'gyur ba/ /srin mo dang ni rab gtum ma//7—1277

gshin rje ma dang chu lha mo/ /dpal chen nor dbang rlung lha mo/ /glog ma dkar mo phag mo dang / /gzhon nu ma dang dpal mo rnams/ /dkyil 'khor pad+mar bstan pa bzhin—/ /khyab 'jug dang ni mthar byed dang / /'phrog byed dang ni nor dbang dag /rim bzhin ljang dang sngon po'o/ /steng dang 'og gi rigs nyid kyis/ /der ma yang na 'dod pas brjod/ /ma bshad phyag rgya'i gzugs rnams kyang / /ji skad bshad pa'i ming nyid kyis/ /mngon phyogs phyag rgya rnams kyi yang / /mtshon cha gzhan rigs nyid du 'dod/ /'dab ma'i lha mo de rnams kyis/ /ming ni sa bon mtha' rdo rje/ /bzhi brgyad mi gdags 'dab mar —/ /'chad 'gyur rnams la brjod par bya/ /lag pa rkang pa'i mthil gtsug tor/ /bshang lam rtsa yi rang bzhin las/ /drug drug sgo ba'i khro bo dang / /de yi lha mo yang dag spro/ /lha bdag phyogs su dbyug sngon can/ /ral gri rdo rje phub sbrul ldan/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /mda' dang lcags kyu gzhu zhags ldan/ /stobs chen 'khor lo dbyug pa dung / /rin chen ldan pa chu bdag tu'o/ /mi g.yo tho ba mdung pad+ma/ /me long ldan pa nor sbyin du/ /gtsug tor can ni dgra sta dang / /rtse gsum yul zhags kha ṭī ldan/ /gnod mdzes phyag bzhi gri gug dang / /rdo rje thod pa dril bu ldan| /'di dag g.yas brkyang stabs kyis di/ /rang rang shes rab shing rtar gnas/ /phag rta glang po gdong lnga pa/ /bdun gyi grangs dang ldan pas drangs/ /phyogs kyi mdog dang lhan cig pa/ /steng dang 'og gi shing rta yang / /ljang gu dang ni sngon po ste/ /grangs bdun mkha' lding a ni la/ /seng ge rkang pa brgyad pas drangs| de rnams kyi ni shes rab kyang / /'od zer can dang skul byed ma/ /dpal ldan rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /khro gnyer can dang shin tu sgo /drag can ma rnams 7—1278

gzhan gyi rigs/ /zla ba dgu par len pa la/ /sor mo nyi shu'i rtsa rnams ni/ /rnam dag klu dbang bcu rnams dang / /rab gtum ma rnams yang dag spro/ /rta babs ka ba'i rtsa rnams su/ /re mig zung bzhir klu rnams te/ /rlung me sa chung bum pa dang / /rdo rje pad+ma rin chen ldan/ /shar du pad+ma stobs rgyu dag /gshin rjer nor rgyas dung skyong dag /nub tu 'jog po pad chen te/ /byang du rigs ldan mtha' yas so/ /klu dbang rgyal ba rnam rgyal zhes/ /'di dag mkha' dang sa 'og tu//mkha' dang ye shes dkyil 'khor la/ /rnal 'byor dbang pos bsgom par bya/ /mgo bo rnams ni gdengs kas bkab/ /rang rang phyogs kyi mdog dang ldan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /thams cad rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas/ /dam pa'i bde slad khyi gdong ma/ /la sogs rab gtum phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /pad+ma la sogs 'di rnams kyang / /thabs kyi tshul ni ji lta bar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag rgya lnga/ /ldan zhing mi mgo'i phreng ba can/ /lus la mi rus phreng ba dang / /thod pa'i phreng ba dar dpyangs ldan/ /gos dang ldan zhing skra grol ma/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /rang gi bzhon pa'i steng rnams su/ /'khor lor rlum po'i stabs kyis gnas/ /me rlung 'khor yug bar gyi ni/ /dur khrod du ni bzhon pa rnams| /shar du bse dang ma mtshalas su/ /snye ruṇ+ḍa dang lho ru dom/ /bden bral khrung khrung nub phyogs su/ /seng ge rlung du mig sngon po/ /nor bdag phyogs su 'bri dang ni/ /dbang ldan du ni bshang lam gdong / /mdung gis 'bigs par khye gdong ma/ /lhag ma za bar khā gdong ma/ /ro bsregs par ni phag gdong ma/ /drag po'i g.yul du bya rgod gdong / /ce spyang gdong ma rnag gi drir/ /sbrul gyis zos par mkha' lding gdong / /rus pa bcas par stag gdong ma/ /byis pa shi 7—1279

bar lug gdong ma/ /sngon mo rdo rje mig ma dag /kun gyi steng gi nam mkha' dang //kun gyi 'og gi sa 'og tu/ /ani la dang rkang brgyad ba'i/ /shing rtar gnas pa bsgom par bya/ /kun nas rlung gi khor yug mthar/ /zhal mdog mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i/ /'byung po bye ba phyed dang bzhi'i/ /tshogs rnams sgrub pa po yis bsgom| /de ltar dpal ldan dus 'khor zhes/ /bsams nas dkyil 'khor gsum nang du/ /'gro drug gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /gsang mchog dkyil 'khor du bkug nas/ /rnam par snang mdzad sogs sangs rgyas/ /khams dang bcas pa snying gar gzhug /byang chub sems su zhu gyur pa/ /rdo rje nas ni yang dag spro/ /byang chub sems des dbang bskur bar/ /bsams te reg pa'i skad cig der/ /zhu ba'i sa bon sogs ngo bos/ /zhal mdog mtshon cha sna tshogs pa/ /lha yi gzugs kyi sku yis ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can/ /dga' chen bde bas gang gyur pa/ /rang lus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid gyur/ /gang phyir gsal byed sna tshogs pa/ /sa bon dbyangs dang ldan rnams te/ /gsal byed ma lus bdag nyid can/ /so sor bsdu ba'i tshul las k+ṣa/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis dbyangs ldan pa/ /de ni sa bon rnams su 'gyur/ /k+ṣa k+ṣi 1 gru k+ṣ-i/ k+ṣu spyi spyo klu 1/ k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣar khyo k+ṣal k+ṣe/ gru k+ṣe k+ṣur k+ṣiṃ lngal k+ṣu/ lha ྾ 1/ lnga kyā smyu : 1/ phung po khams dbang yul rnams dang / /las dbang dang ni bya ba rnams/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan du gyur/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las ji skad du/ /sangs rgyas zhing na sems can gang / /sku gsum dam tshig bdud rtsi yis/ /bskyed cing rdo rje'i dpal gyis reg /thams cad der ni de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes 'thob/ /'dir ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gyur/ /bsgoms te de nas de dag rnams/ /rang 7—1280

rang zhing du rab tu gzhug /ces gsungs so/ /srid pa'i yan lag srog spro ba/ /rdo rje'i gsung babyed btsa' ba brjod/ /gtsug tor dang ni lte ba hoḥ/ /dpral mgrin snying gar cha.ā hūṃ/ /lte ba'i hoḥyig 'od rnams kyis/ /dpal ldan bde chen pad+ma ru/ /shes rab dang bcas rdo rje can/ /shes rab chags pas khu bar zhu//de mthong yid mi bde ba yis/ /sgrol ma la sogs shas cher brtson/ /byams sogs mchog gi rang bzhin can/ /'gro ba'i don la rab 'jug phyir/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis stod byed cing / /ston pa la ni glu dag mdzad/ /spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā ma kri bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo kye| /rnal 'byor pa yoskyes bur gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis//dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams stsong nas//'gro ba gdon pa'i bsam pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces so/ /sgol ma byams pa'i rang bzhin te/ /mā ma tī ni brtse ba'i sku/ /gos dkar dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /spyan ma btang snyoms sku can no/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /thams cad la ni khyab bdag nyid/ /rim pas spyan ma la sogs glu/ /rgyu mthun 'bras sogs rim pa ste/ /thugs sku gsung dang ye shes bdag /rdo rje glu yis bathal gyur pa/ /de gsan nas 7—1281

ni srid pa gsum/ /mig 'phrul lta bur gzigs gyur nas/ /sngar bzhin sa bon sogs ngo bos/ /khyab bdag rdzogs par bsdom bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor spro ba'ang de bzhin no/ /zla ba bcu par mnga' bcas pa/ /rnam lnga mngon par rdzogs byang chub//sku babyed pa yi mtshan nyid can/ /bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang po 'di/ /phyis kyang de ltar bsgom par bya/ /chasu tha shurtse dharma dh+wa tu swa bhā lā kophohaṃ/ bsnyen pa'i yan lag gnyis pa ni/ /gsung babyed pa yi rgyu las 'gyur/ /hoḥyig gnyis kyi bar gnas pa'i/ /yi ge sum̐ ni sngar bzhin dgod/ /sku gsung thugs las yang dag byung / /zla nyi sgra gcan mtshan nyid can/ /'og dang steng du dus kyi me/ /de ni shes rab gsum po'o/ /de yi 'od kyis bdag nyid ni/ /zla ba bzhin du zhu bar blta—/ /mthong nas 'dir yang bskul ba dang / /cho ga thams cad sngar bzhin du//gcig ni srog 'byung ched du ste/ /gzhan ni brgyad gnyis lo yi mthar/ /bde bar byed pa'i ched du'o/ /mngal skyes rnams kyi srog rlung dang / /khams rnams ji bzhin babyed pa dang / /rnam shes rab tu sad byed pa/ /de bzhin spyan ma la sogs rnams/ /ye shes rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dung can ma la brten pa'i sems| /dkyil 'khor lnga ni 'bab don dang / /'gro ba'i don phyir rdo rje can/ /glu gsan rdo rje che ldan pa/ /khu ba'i gzugs ni dor nas kyang / /steng pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bab pa yi/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas/ /'ag tsam nyid kyis gzhon du ni/ /sna tshogs yum dang lhan cig bzhengs/ /byis pa rnams la srog la sogs| /rlung bcu nges par 'bab pa ste/ /'di ni dam tshig dkyil 'khor du/ /sku rdzogs pa yi mtshan nyid can/ /'di de dkyil 'khor rgyal po ni/ /mchog gi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya/ /nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag kyang / /ye shes sems 7—1282

dpa' gzhug pa ste/ /byes pa'i yul dang dbang po dgas /yang dag sad pa'i dbye ba las/ /gsung ni mngon du rdzogs gyur pa/ /rnam pa nyi shus rdzogs byang chub//babyed rim rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /sgong skyes dang ni mngal nas skyes/ /de ni 'jig rten khams babyed dang / /mi rnams babyed pa nyid kyang ngo / /skad cig gis ni babyed pa gang / /de ni rdzus te skyebar 'gyur/ /rgyal bas sems can bsam dbang las/ /de yang bskyed pa'i rim par gsungs/ /gang du babyed pa'i rim pa de'i/ /rtog pa'i dra ba spangs pa ni/ /nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /zhes sogs rnams kyis rab tu brjod/ /byis pa btsas pa'i srog gang dag /dbu ma ab byu tīr gnas/ /de las byung nas dbang po drug /rnam shes yul rnams dang lhan cig /rab 'jug des na 'od sngon po/ /rdo rje shugs ni mkhas pas spro/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta zhon/ /hūṃ yig rdo rje las byung ba/ /'od zer rnon pos nam mkha' khyab/ /srung 'khor las bsrungs mtshan nyid can/ /bdud dang nyon mongs mthar byed pa/ /gtso des ye shes 'khor lo dgug /lte bar lcags kyu bsgrun byas shing / /mtshon cha rnams kyis 'jigs byas te/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i phyag rnams kyang / /'di yi zhags pas rab bcings te/ /bsgrub par byas nas rang gnas su/ /'ong bar rnam par bsgom par bya/ /byis pa'i sna tshogs yul rnams ni//mtha' dag dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ /bskyong nas gnyug ma'i gnas su ni/ /rnam shes 'jug pa de ji bzhin/ /kun gzhi las skyes mig dang lus/ /lce dang sna yi dbang po rnams/ /rnam dag rmugs byed rengs byed dang / /khengs byed dang ni shin tu stobs/ /rim bzhin gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /de bzhin mnyes dang ro mnyam byed/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrim nyid dang / /lcags kyu rdo rje zhags pa dang / /dril 7—1283

bu chalas byung dbyug pa/ /de rnams sa bon mtshan ma nyid/ /de bzhin sngar bzhin legs mchod nas/ /ye shes 'khor lo stog bzhin/ /myur du dam tshig 'khor lo dang / /gcig tu gyur pa rnam bsgom bya/ /yab yum sa bon hūṃ dngaphre/ /phung po khams dang dbang po yul/ /thung ngu ring po yon tan sogs/ /'di ni r+shadang chos dbyings 'kho/ /haṃ haḥgatsug tor shin tu sngo/ /ha hā gnod mdzes drag ldan ma/ /yi ram̐ 47lo khro bo bzhi/ /'u bāḥrā lhagakhro mo rnams/ /ya ra la wa dbyug sngon dang / /'dod pa stobs chen mi g.yo'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhan du bshad//khā wā yā rā khro mo rnams/ /a maḥk+ṣiṃ.i ha haḥhā/ /haṃ rnams phyogs dang mtshams rim bzhin/ /nag mo 'bar sogs du ba sogs/ /rma.āḥhoḥhūṃ rim pa bzhin/ /yid bzhin nor bu la sogs rnams/ /nyi tī z-i dzo kṛ 2 hu/ /hūṃ rnams kum pa rnams kyi'o/ /ha k+ṣa haḥk+ṣaḥhā k+ṣu dang / /haṃ k+ṣe tsartsi ka sogs rim/ /phyogs kyi pad+ma'i mdun rgyab kyi/ /'dab ma gnyis la nyi tī dang / /n+d+ra : rmi 2 hu snu rnams/ /phyogs bral pad+ma'i mdun rgyab kyi/ /'dab ma gnyis su khri spyo dang / /1 k+ṣ-i spyo 1 k+ṣu khyu rnams/ /phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma ni/ /lhag ma rnams su ya la sogs/ /thung ngu'i dbyangs kyis phye ba drug /phyogs bral pad+ma'i 'dab ma ni/ /lhag ma rnams su ya la sogs/ /ring po'i dbyangs kyis bye ba drug /tsa sde la sogs sde pa drug /ya ṇa'i sde pa ha k+ṣa ldan/ /rnam bcad bcas dang thig ler bcas/ /'dod dang phyir 'dod tshogs kyi'o/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor pad+ma yi/ /lte ba bcu gnyis rnams su ni/ /bden bral sogs kyi rtsa nyaḥdang / /ṭi ṇaḥtai naḥpaṃ maḥrnams/ /khyab 'jug mthar byed dbang ldan dang / /nor sbyin ke ngaḥsaṃ rkaḥ'o/ /'dab ma rnams la nya nyi sogs| /ring dang thung ngus bye ba drug /phyi nas brtsams te dgod par bya/ /j-i 7—1284
